senses.english: hard; not easy; you need to work hard to do it
senses.exampleEnglish: Although the instructions looked difficult at first, we understood them once the teacher gave an example.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然说明起初看起来很难，但老师举了一个例子后，我们就理解了。

senses.english: you say this when you politely ask people for things
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you please check the address before we leave, so that we do not get lost?
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前你能检查一下地址吗，这样我们就不会迷路了？

senses.english: to make someone happy or satisfied
senses.exampleEnglish: The revised design will please customers who wanted a lighter bag without losing any useful storage space.
senses.exampleChinese: 修改后的设计会让那些希望包更轻、又不想减少实用收纳空间的顾客满意。

senses.english: small part of something; tiny fact
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained every detail of the route before our group began the mountain walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们的团队开始登山前，向导解释了路线的每一个细节。

senses.english: to describe something with all the important facts
senses.exampleEnglish: The letter will detail the changes to your booking so that you know exactly what has been agreed.
senses.exampleChinese: 这封信会详细说明你的预订变更，让你确切知道双方商定了什么。

phrases.english: with all the important facts included
phrases.exampleEnglish: The guide explained the route in detail before we left, including where we could stop if the weather changed.
phrases.exampleChinese: 出发前导游详细解释了路线，包括天气变化时可以在哪里停留。

senses.english: not of the same kind; unlike other things
senses.exampleEnglish: The main difference between the two courses is that one includes more opportunities to practise speaking.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两门课程的主要区别是，其中一门提供了更多练习口语的机会。

phrases.english: to have a useful or noticeable effect
phrases.exampleEnglish: A clearer sign could make a difference to visitors who have never tried to find this entrance before.
phrases.exampleChinese: 清楚一点的标牌，会帮助从没找过这个入口的访客。

senses.english: something that a person or thing does
senses.exampleEnglish: After several complaints about the broken gate, the school finally took action to repair it.
senses.exampleChinese: 在收到几次关于大门损坏的投诉后，学校终于采取了修理行动。

senses.english: the events or exciting activity in a story or film
senses.exampleEnglish: Most of the action takes place in a small village, where the characters gradually discover a shared secret.
senses.exampleChinese: 大部分情节发生在一个小村庄，角色们在那里逐渐发现一个共同的秘密。

phrases.english: not working or unable to be used
phrases.exampleEnglish: The lift is out of action until the repair team arrives, so staff will help visitors find another entrance.
phrases.exampleChinese: 维修团队到来前电梯停用，因此工作人员会帮游客找另一个入口。

senses.english: being in a good condition; being well
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular breaks can benefit your health, especially if your job involves sitting at a desk all day.
senses.exampleChinese: 经常休息对健康有益，尤其是当你的工作需要整天坐在办公桌前时。

senses.english: to put food in your mouth
senses.exampleEnglish: We usually eat together in the evening, even when everyone has had a particularly busy day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们通常晚上一起吃饭，即使大家当天都特别忙。

phrases.english: to have a meal in a restaurant rather than at home
phrases.exampleEnglish: We rarely eat out during the week, but we booked a table to celebrate finishing the difficult project.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们平时工作日很少外出吃饭，不过为庆祝完成难项目订了桌。

phrases.english: to gradually use up money, time, or another resource
phrases.exampleEnglish: The repeated delays began to eat into our holiday, leaving less time to explore the villages near the coast.
phrases.exampleChinese: 反复延误开始占去假期，让我们探索海边村庄的时间变少。

senses.english: flat horizontal piece that forms stairs
senses.exampleEnglish: The lowest step was covered in wet leaves, so I held the rail as I went down.
senses.exampleChinese: 最下面一级台阶盖着湿树叶，所以我下楼时扶着栏杆。

senses.english: one stage in a process or an action towards a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Checking the address is an important step before you pay, especially when the parcel is going abroad.
senses.exampleChinese: 付款前核对地址是重要的一步，尤其是包裹要寄往国外时。

senses.english: to move by lifting and placing your foot
senses.exampleEnglish: Please step onto the marked area when your name is called, then wait for the instructor's signal.
senses.exampleChinese: 叫到名字时请走到标记区域，然后等待教练的信号。

phrases.english: one stage at a time in a clear order
phrases.exampleEnglish: The instructions take you through the process step by step, so you do not need previous experience with the machine.
phrases.exampleChinese: 说明一步步引导整个流程，所以无需使用这台机器的经验。

phrases.english: to become involved in order to help or stop a problem
phrases.exampleEnglish: The teacher decided to step in when the group could no longer agree on how to share the materials.
phrases.exampleChinese: 小组无法就材料分配达成一致时，老师决定介入。

phrases.english: to leave an important job or position
phrases.exampleEnglish: She plans to step down as chair after the summer, although she will continue helping at the weekly meetings.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她计划夏天后卸任主席，不过仍会帮忙每周会议。

phrases.english: to increase an effort or activity
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need to step up our preparations because more families have registered than the hall can usually accommodate.
phrases.exampleChinese: 报名家庭比礼堂平时容纳的更多，所以我们需要加紧准备。

senses.english: agreeing with the facts; not false; real or actual
senses.exampleEnglish: The story sounded unlikely, but several people who were there confirmed that it was true.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个故事听起来不太可信，但几位当时在场的人证实了它是真的。

senses.english: loyal and reliable, especially as a friend
senses.exampleEnglish: A true friend will tell you honestly when something is wrong, even if you might feel disappointed.
senses.exampleChinese: 真正忠实的朋友会在事情有问题时坦诚告诉你，即使你可能会失望。

phrases.english: to happen as hoped or imagined
phrases.exampleEnglish: Her dream began to come true when the small bakery attracted enough regular customers to stay open all week.
phrases.exampleChinese: 小面包店有足够常客维持整周营业时，她的梦想开始成真。

phrases.english: accurately showing how things happen in real life
phrases.exampleEnglish: The story felt true to life because its characters disagreed about small decisions as well as important ones.
phrases.exampleChinese: 故事很贴近现实，因为角色既为大事，也为小决定意见不同。

senses.english: to talk to someone using a telephone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please phone the hotel before we arrive to ask whether our room will be ready early.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在我们到达前给酒店打电话，问问房间能否提前准备好。

senses.english: a device used to speak to people at a distance
senses.exampleEnglish: My phone ran out of power before we reached the station, so I could not check the platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 到车站前我的手机就没电了，所以无法查看站台信息。

phrases.english: to return a telephone call
phrases.exampleEnglish: I will phone back after checking the timetable, so we can decide whether the earlier train is worth taking.
phrases.exampleChinese: 查过时刻表后我会回电话，好决定是否值得坐早一班。

senses.english: reflexive form of they
senses.exampleEnglish: The children prepared the picnic themselves, although their parents helped them carry everything to the park.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们自己准备了野餐，不过父母帮他们把所有东西搬到了公园。

senses.english: to create an image using pen or pencil and paper
senses.exampleEnglish: Our teacher asked us to draw a building that we could see from the classroom window.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们画一栋从教室窗户能看到的建筑。

senses.english: to pull something gently or move it in a particular direction
senses.exampleEnglish: She began to draw the curtains when the afternoon sunlight made the screen too difficult to see.
senses.exampleChinese: 午后阳光让屏幕看不清时，她开始拉上窗帘。

senses.english: to attract people or their attention
senses.exampleEnglish: The new exhibition is expected to draw visitors who would not normally come to this part of town.
senses.exampleChinese: 新展览预计会吸引平时不会来城里这一带的游客。

senses.english: to reach a conclusion from facts or observations
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not draw a conclusion until we have checked whether the results are the same for everyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 在确认结果是否对每个人都相同之前，我们不该下结论。

senses.english: a result in which neither side wins
senses.exampleEnglish: The match ended in a draw after both teams missed good chances during the final few minutes.
senses.exampleChinese: 两队在最后几分钟都错失良机后，比赛以平局结束。

phrases.english: to prepare a written plan or agreement
phrases.exampleEnglish: The committee will draw up a new plan after hearing what residents think about the proposed playground location.
phrases.exampleChinese: 委员会听取居民对游乐场选址的意见后，将拟定新计划。

phrases.english: to use experience, knowledge, or a resource
phrases.exampleEnglish: She could draw on years of experience when helping younger colleagues deal with customers who were feeling frustrated.
phrases.exampleChinese: 帮助年轻同事应对受挫顾客时，她可以利用多年经验。

phrases.english: to gradually end
phrases.exampleEnglish: As the workshop began to draw to a close, each group chose one idea to explain to the others.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊接近尾声时，每组选了一个想法向其他人介绍。

senses.english: lightest color; the color of fresh snow and milk
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose white curtains because they made the small bedroom look brighter during the winter months.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选了白色窗帘，因为它们让小卧室在冬季看起来更明亮。

phrases.english: a small untrue statement intended to avoid hurting someone
phrases.exampleEnglish: He told a white lie about liking the cake because he did not want to upset the young baker.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他假装喜欢蛋糕，说了个善意谎言，因为不想让年轻烘焙者难过。

senses.english: a day in the calendar such as January 3rd
senses.exampleEnglish: We agreed on a date for the meeting after checking when everyone would be available.
senses.exampleChinese: 查看了大家什么时候有空之后，我们商定了会议日期。

senses.english: a meeting between people who are romantically interested in each other
senses.exampleEnglish: Their first date was at a small cafe, where they discovered that they enjoyed the same books.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们第一次约会在一家小咖啡馆，在那里发现彼此喜欢相同的书。

senses.english: to spend time with someone in a romantic relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: They began to date after meeting through friends, although their jobs often kept them in different cities.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们经朋友介绍认识后开始交往，虽然工作常让两人分处不同城市。

senses.english: to establish when something was made or when it began
senses.exampleEnglish: Experts will date the wooden frame before deciding whether the building is older than local records suggest.
senses.exampleChinese: 专家会先确定木框的年代，再判断建筑是否比地方记录显示的更古老。

phrases.english: containing the latest information or reflecting recent changes
phrases.exampleEnglish: Keep the contact list up to date so that volunteers can reach the right person if arrangements change suddenly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 保持联系名单最新，以便安排突变时志愿者找对人。

phrases.english: no longer current, valid, or suitable
phrases.exampleEnglish: The map was out of date, so it did not show the path that had opened beside the river.
phrases.exampleChinese: 地图过时了，没有标出河边新开放的小路。

phrases.english: to have existed since a particular time
phrases.exampleEnglish: The oldest parts of the house date back to the eighteenth century, although most windows were replaced much later.
phrases.exampleChinese: 房子最老的部分可追溯到十八世纪，不过大部分窗户很久以后才更换。

senses.english: to do something many times to improve a skill
senses.exampleEnglish: If you practice giving short talks regularly, you may feel more comfortable speaking in front of others.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果经常练习做简短演讲，你在别人面前说话时可能会更自在。

senses.english: repeated activity intended to improve a skill
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular practice made the difficult movements easier, although I still needed to concentrate when the music became faster.
senses.exampleChinese: 经常练习让困难动作变容易了，不过音乐加快时我仍需要集中注意力。

senses.english: the usual way something is done, or doing it in reality
senses.exampleEnglish: The school changed its practice of sending paper notices after many parents asked for messages by email.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多家长要求用电子邮件通知后，学校改变了寄纸质通知的做法。

senses.english: the work of a doctor, lawyer, or similar professional
senses.exampleEnglish: After years of working in a hospital, she opened a small medical practice close to her home.
senses.exampleChinese: 在医院工作多年后，她在家附近开设了一家小诊所。

senses.english: to work as a doctor, lawyer, or other professional; American spelling
senses.exampleEnglish: He returned to his hometown to practice medicine after completing his training in a much larger city.
senses.exampleChinese: 他在大城市完成培训后回到家乡行医。

phrases.english: in real situations rather than only in ideas
phrases.exampleEnglish: The plan looked simple on paper, but in practice the different groups needed more time to share the equipment.
phrases.exampleChinese: 计划纸上看很简单，但实践中不同小组共享设备需要更多时间。

phrases.english: less skilled because you have not done something recently
phrases.exampleEnglish: I was out of practice after the long break, so the first few exercises took more concentration than usual.
phrases.exampleChinese: 长时间中断后我生疏了，头几道练习比平时更需要专注。

phrases.english: to use an idea or skill in a real situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: The workshop gave us ideas to put into practice when we returned to the small gardens at our own homes.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊提供了能回家在自家小花园实践的想法。

senses.english: a copy that represents an object or standard
senses.exampleEnglish: The students built a model of their town to show how the new bridge would look.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们制作了一个城镇模型，展示新桥建成后的样子。

senses.english: a person who displays clothes or poses for pictures
senses.exampleEnglish: The model changed jackets several times while the photographer tried to find the best light near the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 摄影师尝试在窗边寻找最佳光线时，模特换了好几次夹克。

senses.english: someone or something that is a good example to follow
senses.exampleEnglish: Her calm handling of the disagreement became a model for younger colleagues who were learning to manage meetings.
senses.exampleChinese: 她冷静处理分歧的方式，成了正在学习主持会议的年轻同事的榜样。

senses.english: to demonstrate something or make a representation of it
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will model the first conversation before students practise asking for directions with their own partners.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生和搭档练习问路前，老师会先示范第一段对话。

senses.english: to increase a quantity, size, intensity or price
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe plans to raise its prices slightly because the cost of ingredients has increased.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于原料成本上涨，这家咖啡馆计划略微提价。

senses.english: to lift something to a higher position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please raise your hand if you cannot see the diagram, and we will move it closer to you.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果看不清图示，请举手，我们会把它移近一些。

senses.english: to care for children or animals until they grow
senses.exampleEnglish: Her grandparents helped raise the children while both parents were working long hours at the family restaurant.
senses.exampleChinese: 父母在家庭餐馆长时间工作时，祖父母帮忙抚养孩子。

senses.english: to collect money for a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The students hope to raise enough money to buy tools for the garden before the spring term begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们希望春季学期开学前筹到足够的钱购买园艺工具。

senses.english: to mention a subject or question for discussion
senses.exampleEnglish: You should raise the issue at the next meeting so that everyone has a chance to suggest improvements.
senses.exampleChinese: 你应该在下次会议上提出这个问题，让大家都有机会建议改进。

phrases.english: to surprise people or make them question something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The unusually low price may raise eyebrows, so the company should explain clearly what the offer actually includes.
phrases.exampleChinese: 价格低得异常可能引人怀疑，所以公司应说明优惠具体包含什么。

senses.english: someone who buys goods or services from a business
senses.exampleEnglish: A customer who had left her bag in the shop returned just before we closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位把包落在店里的顾客在我们关门前赶了回来。

senses.english: opposite of back; the forward part of an object
senses.exampleEnglish: Please use the front entrance, as the door at the back is being repaired today.
senses.exampleChinese: 请走前门，因为后门今天正在维修。

senses.english: the part or side that faces forward
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited at the front of the building because the side entrance was closed for repairs that morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 那天早晨侧门因维修关闭，所以我们在建筑前面等候。

phrases.english: in a position ahead of or before something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please leave the space in front of the entrance clear so that wheelchairs and pushchairs can pass safely.
phrases.exampleChinese: 请空出入口前的空间，让轮椅和婴儿车安全通过。

senses.english: to make clear or easy to understand by describing
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you explain how this machine works before I try using it for the first time?
senses.exampleChinese: 在我第一次尝试使用这台机器前，你能解释一下它如何运作吗？

senses.english: you walk through this when you go in a room
senses.exampleEnglish: I left a note on the door so that visitors would know where to find us.
senses.exampleChinese: 我在门上留了一张便条，好让访客知道去哪里找我们。

senses.english: area around or near something, such as a building
senses.exampleEnglish: The outside of the house needs painting, but the rooms inside are still in good condition.
senses.exampleChinese: 房子的外部需要粉刷，但里面的房间状况仍然很好。

senses.english: in or to a place that is not inside
senses.exampleEnglish: The children waited outside while their teacher checked whether there was enough room for the whole class.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师查看是否有足够空间容纳全班时，孩子们在外面等候。

senses.english: not within a place, group, or limit
senses.exampleEnglish: We left our muddy shoes outside the door so that the clean floor would not get dirty.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把沾泥的鞋留在门外，免得弄脏干净的地板。

senses.english: on the outer part, or coming from elsewhere
senses.exampleEnglish: The outside wall needs repairing before winter, but the rooms are still safe enough to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 外墙需要在冬天前修好，但房间仍足够安全，可以使用。

senses.english: in or toward the back
senses.exampleEnglish: We had almost reached the station when I noticed that my younger brother had fallen behind.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们快到车站时，我才注意到弟弟落在了后面。

senses.english: having to do with trade, industry, and money
senses.exampleEnglish: The report describes the economic changes that have affected small businesses over the past five years.
senses.exampleChinese: 这份报告描述了过去五年影响小企业的经济变化。

senses.english: present, former, or future location of something, such as a building
senses.exampleEnglish: Before the builders arrived, experts visited the site to check whether the ground was suitable.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑工人到来之前，专家去了工地，检查地面是否合适。

senses.english: a website or an online place containing related information
senses.exampleEnglish: The site lets visitors compare train times, although tickets must still be bought directly from the operator.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个网站让访客比较火车时刻，不过车票仍须直接向运营商购买。

phrases.english: at the place where an activity or work happens
phrases.exampleEnglish: A member of staff will be on site all afternoon if visitors need help using the new equipment.
phrases.exampleChinese: 整个下午都会有工作人员在现场，帮助使用新设备的访客。

senses.english: to get close to reaching something or somewhere
senses.exampleEnglish: As we approach the village, you will see an old stone bridge on the left.
senses.exampleChinese: 当我们接近村庄时，你会在左边看到一座古老的石桥。

senses.english: a way of dealing with a problem or task
senses.exampleEnglish: Her approach to learning new words includes writing short stories that connect them with situations she remembers.
senses.exampleChinese: 她学习新单词的方法之一，是写短篇故事，把单词与记得的情境联系起来。

senses.english: to begin dealing with a task in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to approach this problem carefully because a quick solution might create difficulties for other groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要谨慎处理这个问题，因为仓促解决可能给其他小组带来困难。

senses.english: the act or process of coming closer
senses.exampleEnglish: The approach of winter meant that the volunteers had little time left to repair the roof.
senses.exampleChinese: 冬季临近，意味着志愿者修屋顶所剩时间不多了。

senses.english: person who teaches others, especially in a school
senses.exampleEnglish: Our science teacher encouraged us to test our ideas instead of simply accepting the answers.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学老师鼓励我们检验自己的想法，而不是简单地接受答案。

senses.english: the earth; the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer bought the land beside the river because it was suitable for growing vegetables.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位农民买下了河边的土地，因为那里适合种蔬菜。

senses.english: to arrive on the ground after being in the air
senses.exampleEnglish: The plane will land at a smaller airport because strong winds have closed the main runway temporarily.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于大风使主跑道暂时关闭，飞机将在一座较小的机场降落。

senses.english: to successfully get something desirable, such as a job
senses.exampleEnglish: She managed to land a job at the museum after volunteering there throughout her final year at college.
senses.exampleChinese: 大学最后一年一直在博物馆做志愿者后，她成功获得了那里的一份工作。

senses.english: to ask for money as a price for a service or goods
senses.exampleEnglish: Some museums charge visitors an entrance fee, while others allow everyone to enter free of charge.
senses.exampleChinese: 有些博物馆向参观者收取门票费，而另一些允许所有人免费入内。

collocations.chinese: 向某人收取某物的费用

senses.english: to put electrical energy into a battery
senses.exampleEnglish: I need to charge my phone before we leave because we will use it to follow the walking route.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前我需要给手机充电，因为我们要用它查看徒步路线。

senses.english: to rush forward forcefully
senses.exampleEnglish: The excited dog began to charge towards the gate when it heard its owner returning along the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 听到主人沿小路回来的声音，那只兴奋的狗开始猛冲向大门。

senses.english: to formally accuse someone of an offence
senses.exampleEnglish: Police may charge the driver after examining the recordings that show what happened near the school entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 警方查看展示校门附近事发经过的录像后，可能会指控司机。

senses.english: the amount of money asked for a service
senses.exampleEnglish: There is no extra charge for breakfast, but guests who want a late checkout must pay more.
senses.exampleChinese: 早餐不额外收费，但想延迟退房的客人须多付钱。

senses.english: control of or responsibility for a person or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher put Mia in charge of the equipment because she knew where everything should be stored.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让米娅负责设备，因为她知道每件东西该存放在哪里。

senses.english: an official accusation that someone committed an offence
senses.exampleEnglish: The court dismissed the charge after new evidence showed that the bicycle had not actually been stolen.
senses.exampleChinese: 新证据表明自行车其实并未被盗后，法庭撤销了指控。

phrases.english: without requiring payment
phrases.exampleEnglish: The museum offers guided visits free of charge, although groups must book ahead because places are limited.
phrases.exampleChinese: 博物馆免费提供导览，不过团体须提前预约，因为名额有限。

phrases.english: to become responsible for controlling a situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: Someone needs to take charge of the preparations now that the organiser has had to leave unexpectedly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者不得不临时离开，现在需要有人接手准备工作。

senses.english: after a long time or some difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: After trying several different routes, we finally found a quiet path that led to the beach.
senses.exampleChinese: 尝试了几条不同的路线后，我们终于找到了一条通往海滩的安静小路。

senses.english: something such as a mark or event that shows that something exists, is true, is happening or will happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The first sign of trouble was a strange noise coming from the back of the car.
senses.exampleChinese: 出现问题的第一个迹象是汽车后部传来奇怪的响声。

senses.english: a written message or symbol giving information
senses.exampleEnglish: The sign near the entrance explains which paths are suitable for visitors who are using wheelchairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 入口附近的标牌说明了哪些小路适合使用轮椅的访客。

senses.english: to write your name to confirm or approve something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please sign the form after checking your contact details, then give it to the volunteer at the desk.
senses.exampleChinese: 核对联系信息后请在表格上签名，再交给服务台的志愿者。

senses.english: a movement used to communicate a message
senses.exampleEnglish: She made a sign for us to wait because another group was still coming through the narrow doorway.
senses.exampleChinese: 她打手势让我们等候，因为另一组人还在穿过狭窄门口。

senses.english: to communicate using gestures or sign language
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor will sign the explanation while another volunteer speaks, so that more visitors can follow the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练会用手语解释，同时另一位志愿者口述，让更多访客能跟上演示。

phrases.english: to register to join an activity or service
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can sign up for the course online, but please check the dates before paying the fee.
phrases.exampleChinese: 你可网上报名课程，但付费前请核查日期。

phrases.english: to record your arrival or access an account
phrases.exampleEnglish: Visitors should sign in at the desk before entering the workshop so that staff know who is inside.
phrases.exampleChinese: 访客进工作坊前应在服务台签到，让员工知道谁在里面。

phrases.english: to leave an account or record that you are leaving
phrases.exampleEnglish: Remember to sign out after using the shared computer, especially if you have opened messages or personal documents.
phrases.exampleChinese: 用过共享电脑记得退出，尤其是打开过消息或私人文件时。

phrases.english: to end a message or officially approve completed work
phrases.exampleEnglish: The engineer must sign off the repairs before visitors can use the stairs leading to the upper gallery.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工程师必须签署确认维修完成，游客才能使用通往楼上展厅的楼梯。

senses.english: to say something is true when others may not agree
senses.exampleEnglish: The makers claim that this bag is waterproof, although we have not tested it in heavy rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 制造商声称这个包防水，不过我们还没有在大雨中测试过。

senses.english: to ask for something you have a right to receive
senses.exampleEnglish: You can claim the cost of the replacement ticket if you keep the receipt and explain the delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果保留收据并说明延误情况，你可以申请报销补买车票的费用。

senses.english: a statement that something is true
senses.exampleEnglish: The report questions the claim that longer opening hours would necessarily increase the number of library visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告质疑了延长开放时间必然会增加图书馆访客数量的说法。

senses.english: an official request for money or something due
senses.exampleEnglish: She submitted a claim for the damaged bag after taking photographs and reporting the problem at the airport.
senses.exampleChinese: 她拍照并在机场报告问题后，为损坏的包提交了索赔申请。

senses.english: manner in which people, groups or countries behave toward one another
senses.exampleEnglish: Their relationship improved after they began discussing problems calmly instead of blaming each other for mistakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们开始冷静地讨论问题，而不是因错误互相指责之后，关系改善了。

senses.english: to go to a place that is far away
senses.exampleEnglish: We prefer to travel by train when possible because it gives us time to enjoy the scenery.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要可能，我们更喜欢乘火车旅行，因为这样有时间欣赏风景。

senses.english: the activity of going from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: Train travel gives us time to read and talk, although it is not always the cheapest option.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车出行让我们有时间阅读和交谈，虽然它并不总是最便宜的选择。

senses.english: to move or spread from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: News can travel quickly through a small community, even before anyone has checked whether the story is true.
senses.exampleChinese: 消息会在小社区迅速传开，甚至还没人核实事情是否属实。

phrases.english: to travel with little luggage
phrases.exampleEnglish: We decided to travel light because the island buses had limited space and our accommodation provided most essentials.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们决定轻装旅行，因为岛上公交空间有限，住处也提供大部分必需品。

senses.english: to take pleasure in something
senses.exampleEnglish: The children seemed to enjoy the museum visit more once they could try the activities themselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们能亲自动手尝试活动后，似乎更喜欢这次博物馆参观了。

senses.english: to have something good or useful available
senses.exampleEnglish: The village enjoys regular bus services now, which makes it easier for older residents to reach the hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄如今享有固定公交服务，老年居民去医院更方便了。

senses.english: when someone dies; the end of life
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer's death was announced yesterday, and readers shared memories of how her books had inspired them.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位作家去世的消息昨天公布了，读者纷纷分享她的书如何启发自己的回忆。

senses.english: good or enjoyable
senses.exampleEnglish: It was nice to meet the neighbours properly after living next door to them for several months.
senses.exampleChinese: 和邻居做了几个月的邻居后，能正式认识他们真令人高兴。

senses.english: quantity of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The amount of water we use each day depends partly on how long we spend showering.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们每天的用水量部分取决于淋浴时间有多长。

senses.english: to make, or become, something better
senses.exampleEnglish: You can improve your listening skills by following short recordings and checking the words you miss.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以跟着短录音听，并核对漏听的单词，来提高听力。

senses.english: painting, drawing or photograph on paper or screen
senses.exampleEnglish: The picture on the website looked different from the room we were actually given at the hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 网站上的照片与酒店实际给我们的房间看起来不同。

senses.english: an idea or description of what something is like
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey gives us a clearer picture of what visitors need, but we should still speak to local residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查让我们更清楚游客需要什么，但仍应与当地居民交谈。

senses.english: to imagine how something looks or could happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to picture the room without the large cupboard, and you may see how much space it takes.
senses.exampleChinese: 试着想象没有大柜子的房间，你可能会发现它占了多少空间。

senses.english: a young male person
senses.exampleEnglish: The boy who found the missing dog waited outside the library until its owner arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 找到那只走失狗的男孩在图书馆外等着，直到狗主人到来。

senses.english: to consider someone or something in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: We regard safety as our first concern whenever we organize an activity for younger children outdoors.
senses.exampleChinese: 每当为年幼的孩子组织户外活动时，我们都把安全视为首要考虑。

collocations.chinese: 以尊重的态度看待某人

senses.english: respect or consideration for someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach held her in high regard because she always helped younger players feel welcome in the team.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练很尊重她，因为她总会帮助年轻队员融入团队。

senses.english: friendly greetings, usually expressed in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: Please give my regards to your parents when you visit them, as I have not seen them for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 探望父母时，请代我问候他们，因为我们已经多年没见了。

phrases.english: concerning a particular subject
phrases.exampleEnglish: With regard to the new timetable, several parents have asked whether the last bus could leave a little later.
phrases.exampleChinese: 关于新时刻表，几位家长问末班车是否可以稍晚发车。

senses.english: formal group of people with a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The organization provides free books to families who cannot easily reach a library in their area.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个组织为无法方便地前往当地图书馆的家庭提供免费图书。

senses.english: the activity of arranging people or things effectively
senses.exampleEnglish: The successful trip required careful organization because several classes were travelling together and everyone needed different equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次旅行的成功需要精心组织，因为几个班一起出行，而且各自需要不同器材。

senses.english: feeling pleasure or joy; glad
senses.exampleEnglish: She was happy with the final design, even though it was quite different from her original idea.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对最终设计很满意，尽管它与最初的想法很不一样。

senses.english: willing to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: I am happy to help with the preparations, provided someone shows me where the materials should be kept.
senses.exampleChinese: 我很乐意帮忙准备，只要有人告诉我材料该放在哪里。

senses.english: two of something; two people; a pair
senses.exampleEnglish: A couple who live near the station offered us directions when they saw us studying the map.
senses.exampleChinese: 住在车站附近的一对夫妇看见我们研究地图，主动给我们指路。

senses.english: to join two things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The course will couple practical exercises with short discussions so that students can understand why each method works.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程会把实践练习与简短讨论结合，让学生理解每种方法为何有效。

phrases.english: two or a small number of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We have a couple of questions about the route before we decide which shoes and equipment to bring.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定带什么鞋和装备前，我们对路线还有几个问题。

senses.english: to behave in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to act calmly if the plan changes, because the rest of the group will follow your example.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果计划改变，尽量保持冷静，因为团队其他人会以你为榜样。

senses.english: to do something to deal with a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to act before the small leak becomes a bigger problem that damages the room below.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要在小漏水变成大问题、损坏楼下房间之前采取行动。

senses.english: to perform a role in a play or film
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to act at a local youth theatre before joining a group that performed in schools.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先在当地青年剧院学习表演，之后加入了一个到学校演出的团体。

senses.english: something that someone does
senses.exampleEnglish: His small act of kindness made the nervous new student feel more comfortable on her first day.
senses.exampleChinese: 他一个小小的善举，让紧张的新生第一天感觉自在了一些。

senses.english: a law passed by a legislature
senses.exampleEnglish: The new act requires public buildings to improve access so that more people can use their facilities safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 新法律要求公共建筑改善通行条件，让更多人能安全使用设施。

senses.english: one main part of a play or a short performance
senses.exampleEnglish: The first act introduces the family, while the second shows how they respond when their plans suddenly change.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一幕介绍这个家庭，第二幕展示计划突变时他们的反应。

phrases.english: to take action because of information or advice
phrases.exampleEnglish: The council agreed to act on the survey results rather than waiting for another year of complaints from residents.
phrases.exampleChinese: 市政委员会同意根据调查结果行动，而不是再等居民抱怨一年。

phrases.english: to perform a situation or express something through actions
phrases.exampleEnglish: The students will act out the conversation in pairs before writing their own version with a different ending.
phrases.exampleChinese: 学生先两人表演对话，再写一个结尾不同的版本。

phrases.english: to behave badly or stop working properly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The printer began to act up just before the meeting, so we shared the document on the screen instead.
phrases.exampleChinese: 开会前打印机出了毛病，所以我们改在屏幕上分享文件。

senses.english: limits within which something extends or varies
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop offers a wide range of equipment, from simple tools to machines for professional use.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家商店提供种类丰富的设备，从简单工具到专业机器应有尽有。

senses.english: a set of different products or things available
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop introduced a range of smaller backpacks after customers asked for bags suitable for short walks.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客希望有适合短途步行的包后，商店推出了一系列小背包。

senses.english: a line or group of connected mountains
senses.exampleEnglish: The mountain range protects the valley from strong winds, although snow sometimes closes the road in winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 山脉为山谷挡住强风，不过冬季积雪有时会封路。

senses.english: to vary between limits or include different kinds
senses.exampleEnglish: The activities range from gentle walks to longer climbs, so visitors can choose something that suits their experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动从轻松步行到长途攀爬都有，游客可以按经验选择。

senses.english: high level of worth or excellence
senses.exampleEnglish: The quality of the recording improved considerably after we moved the microphone closer to the speaker.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把麦克风移近说话的人之后，录音质量明显改善了。

senses.english: a feature that someone or something has
senses.exampleEnglish: Patience is a quality that helps teachers explain difficult ideas without making students feel embarrassed about their questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 耐心这种品质有助于老师解释难懂的概念，而不让学生为提问感到尴尬。

senses.english: a planned piece of work for specific purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: Our class started a project to discover how much food the school throws away each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们班开展了一个项目，调查学校每周丢弃多少食物。

senses.english: to calculate what may happen in the future
senses.exampleEnglish: Experts project that demand will rise next year, so the company is considering expanding its repair service.
senses.exampleChinese: 专家预计明年需求会上升，所以公司正考虑扩大维修服务。

senses.english: to send an image or light onto a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: We will project the map onto the wall so that everyone can see the route during the discussion.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会把地图投到墙上，让讨论时人人都能看清路线。

senses.english: to extend beyond a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The balcony will project slightly beyond the wall, giving guests a better view of the garden below.
senses.exampleChinese: 阳台会略微伸出墙外，让客人更好地欣赏下方花园。

senses.english: being in the shape of a circle or ball
senses.exampleEnglish: We sat at a round table so that everyone could see and hear each other easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们坐在一张圆桌旁，这样大家都能轻松看到和听到彼此。

senses.english: one stage in a series of activities or contests
senses.exampleEnglish: Our team reached the second round after winning a close match against a much more experienced group.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们队在与经验丰富得多的队伍险胜后，进入了第二轮。

senses.english: around something; especially British English
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked round the lake before stopping at a cafe that overlooked the old bridge on the far side.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们绕湖走了一圈，然后停在能俯瞰对岸老桥的咖啡馆。

senses.english: in a circular direction or towards nearby places
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide showed us round before explaining which areas would remain closed while the building was repaired.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游先带我们四处参观，再说明维修期间哪些区域仍会关闭。

senses.english: to change a number to a nearby simpler number
senses.exampleEnglish: For the first estimate, we can round each price to the nearest pound before calculating the total.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次估算时，我们可以先把各项价格取整到最接近的英镑，再计算总额。

phrases.english: to gather people or things, or increase a number to a whole amount
phrases.exampleEnglish: Please round up the remaining equipment before lunch so that we can check whether anything has been left outside.
phrases.exampleChinese: 午饭前请把剩余设备收齐，好检查是否有东西落在外面。

phrases.english: to finish something pleasantly or make a number simpler
phrases.exampleEnglish: We will round off the visit with a short walk through the garden before returning to the station.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们会用花园短途散步结束参观，再返回车站。

phrases.english: all day and all night
phrases.exampleEnglish: The rescue team worked round the clock until everyone who had been walking near the flooded river was safe.
phrases.exampleChinese: 救援队昼夜不停地工作，直到洪水河边徒步的人全部安全。

senses.english: time/situation when a thing might be done; chance
senses.exampleEnglish: The exchange programme gave her an opportunity to practise English with people from several different countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个交流项目给了她与来自几个不同国家的人练习英语的机会。

senses.english: long piece of hard land for cars to travel on
senses.exampleEnglish: The road to the village was closed after heavy rain, so we had to choose another route.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨过后，通往村庄的道路被封闭了，所以我们不得不另选路线。

phrases.english: at a later time
phrases.exampleEnglish: Buying a cheaper tool may create problems down the road if replacement parts are difficult to find locally.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果本地难找替换零件，买便宜工具将来可能带来问题。

senses.english: agreement or harmony
senses.exampleEnglish: The two towns signed an accord to share public transport services and reduce the cost of travel.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两个城镇签署了协议，共享公共交通服务并降低出行成本。

phrases.english: in agreement with something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The revised plan is in accord with the residents' main requests, although some details still need to be settled.
phrases.exampleChinese: 修订计划符合居民主要要求，不过一些细节仍待解决。

phrases.english: without being asked or forced
phrases.exampleEnglish: She stayed to help of her own accord after noticing that the younger volunteers still had several boxes to move.
phrases.exampleChinese: 她发现年轻志愿者还有几箱要搬，主动留下帮忙。

senses.english: series of written names, words or numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: Before we went shopping, I made a list of everything we needed for the weekend trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 购物之前，我列出了周末旅行所需所有物品的清单。

senses.english: to write or include things in a series
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice will list the materials students need, so parents can prepare everything before the course begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 通知会列出学生所需材料，家长就能在课程开始前准备齐全。

senses.english: to want something to happen or to become true
senses.exampleEnglish: I wish I had asked more questions when my grandparents told me stories about their childhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖父母给我讲童年故事时，我真希望自己当时多问一些问题。

senses.english: a desire for something, or a message expressing good hopes
senses.exampleEnglish: Her wish was to see the sea again, so the family arranged a short trip for her birthday.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的愿望是再看一次大海，所以家人为她生日安排了一次短途旅行。

senses.english: for that reason
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge is closed for repairs; therefore, all buses must take a longer route through the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座桥因维修而关闭；因此，所有公交车都必须走穿过城镇的较长路线。

senses.english: to have clothes, glasses, shoes, etc., on your body
senses.exampleEnglish: You should wear comfortable shoes because the tour includes a long walk through the old town.
senses.exampleChinese: 你应该穿舒适的鞋，因为行程包括长时间步行穿过老城区。

senses.english: to become damaged or thinner through use
senses.exampleEnglish: The steps wear unevenly because most visitors use the right side when they climb up to the tower.
senses.exampleChinese: 大多数游客上塔时走右边，所以台阶磨损得不均匀。

senses.english: damage caused by ordinary use
senses.exampleEnglish: The chair shows some wear along the edges, but its frame is still strong enough to repair.
senses.exampleChinese: 椅子边缘有些磨损，但框架依然结实，可以修复。

phrases.english: to become unusable through repeated use
phrases.exampleEnglish: These shoes will wear out quickly if we use them every day on the rough path behind the school.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果每天都走学校后面的粗糙小路，这些鞋很快会磨坏。

phrases.english: to make someone extremely tired
phrases.exampleEnglish: The long journey can wear out younger children, so we have planned several breaks before reaching the coast.
phrases.exampleChinese: 长途旅行会让幼儿筋疲力尽，所以到海边前我们安排了几次休息。

phrases.english: to gradually stop having an effect
phrases.exampleEnglish: The excitement began to wear off when the children realised that they would need to wait another hour.
phrases.exampleChinese: 孩子们发现还要再等一小时，兴奋开始减退。

senses.english: (v) to supply (n) money for something
senses.exampleEnglish: The school created a fund to help students who could not afford to join the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校设立了一项基金，帮助无力支付费用参加旅行的学生。

senses.english: to provide money for a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The council will fund the first stage of the project if local groups can find enough volunteers.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果当地团体能找到足够志愿者，市政委员会将资助项目第一阶段。

senses.english: time when one relaxes, sleeps, or is inactive
senses.exampleEnglish: After carrying the boxes upstairs, we needed a short rest before starting to unpack them carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 把箱子搬上楼后，我们需要稍作休息，再开始小心地拆箱。

senses.chinese: 其余部分；剩下的人或物
senses.english: the part or people that remain
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the first box carefully before opening the rest, because several items inside were extremely fragile.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仔细检查了第一个箱子才打开其余箱子，因为里面几件物品非常易碎。

senses.english: to stop being active in order to recover energy
senses.exampleEnglish: You can rest beside the river while the others explore the village, and we will meet you later.
senses.exampleChinese: 其他人探索村庄时，你可以在河边休息，我们稍后与你会合。

senses.english: to put something on a support or lean on it
senses.exampleEnglish: She will rest the ladder against the wall while we clear a safe space for it outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在外面清出安全空间时，她会把梯子靠在墙上。

phrases.english: to depend or be based on something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The success of the event will rest on clear communication between volunteers who are working at different entrances.
phrases.exampleChinese: 活动成功将依赖不同入口的志愿者之间清楚沟通。

senses.english: informal child or young person
senses.exampleEnglish: Every kid in the group was given a small task so that nobody felt left out.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组里的每个孩子都分到了一项小任务，这样就没有人觉得被冷落。

senses.english: to joke with someone or say something not seriously
senses.exampleEnglish: I thought he was trying to kid me when he said the tiny house had five bedrooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 他说这座小房子有五间卧室时，我以为他在逗我。

phrases.english: used to show surprise or stress that a statement is serious
phrases.exampleEnglish: No kidding, the little room can hold twenty people if we remove the tables and arrange the chairs carefully.
phrases.exampleChinese: 真没开玩笑，如果移走桌子、仔细摆椅子，小房间能容纳二十人。

senses.english: factories or businesses that make certain products
senses.exampleEnglish: The fishing industry provides many jobs in the town, although tourism is becoming increasingly important too.
senses.exampleChinese: 渔业为这个城镇提供了许多工作，尽管旅游业也变得日益重要。

senses.english: process of giving or receiving teaching
senses.exampleEnglish: Access to a good education can give young people more choices when they begin their working lives.
senses.exampleChinese: 获得良好教育能让年轻人在开始工作生涯时拥有更多选择。

senses.english: to calculate size, weight or temperature of
senses.exampleEnglish: Please measure the window carefully before ordering curtains, since the old ones were much too short.
senses.exampleChinese: 订购窗帘前，请仔细测量窗户，因为旧窗帘实在太短了。

senses.english: to judge the importance or effect of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot measure the success of the course simply by counting how many people attended each lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不能只靠统计每堂课有多少人参加来衡量课程成功与否。

senses.english: an action intended to achieve a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The new safety measure requires visitors to leave large bags outside before entering the narrow exhibition rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的安全措施要求游客进入狭窄展厅前，把大包留在外面。

senses.english: a unit or amount used to express a quantity
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe uses a small cup as a measure, so you do not need to weigh every ingredient.
senses.exampleChinese: 食谱用一只小杯子作量具，所以不必称量每种食材。

phrases.english: to be good enough when compared with a standard
phrases.exampleEnglish: The cheaper model did not measure up when we tested it on the tasks students would actually need.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们用学生实际需要的任务测试时，便宜型号没有达到标准。

senses.english: to end the life of a person or other living thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden frost can kill young plants, so the gardener covers them when cold nights are expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 突如其来的霜冻会使幼苗死亡，所以预计夜晚寒冷时，园丁会盖住它们。

phrases.english: to spend time doing something while waiting
phrases.exampleEnglish: We visited the small bookshop to kill time while waiting for the bus that would take us to the coast.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们等去海边的公交时，逛了小书店消磨时间。

senses.english: to give or provide something to another person
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers serve warm meals to visitors who have spent the whole morning walking in the cold.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者为整个上午都在寒冷中行走的访客提供热饭。

senses.english: to help customers or provide a service
senses.exampleEnglish: Only two assistants were available to serve customers, so a long queue formed near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 只有两位店员能接待顾客，所以入口附近排起了长队。

senses.english: to perform a purpose or be used in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: The old station will serve as a community centre once repairs make the building safe for visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 维修使建筑达到安全开放条件后，旧车站将作为社区中心使用。

senses.english: to spend a period doing a duty or receiving a punishment
senses.exampleEnglish: She will serve on the committee for two years, helping decide how the village hall should be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 她将在委员会任职两年，协助决定村礼堂的使用方式。

senses.english: to start play in tennis and similar games
senses.exampleEnglish: You must wait until your opponent is ready before you serve, even if the previous point ended quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 发球前必须等对手准备好，即使上一分很快结束也是如此。

phrases.english: to be a deserved result of careless or unkind behaviour
phrases.exampleEnglish: It would serve you right to miss the start if you ignored every reminder about leaving home early.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果无视所有早出门提醒而错过开场，那就是你自作自受。

senses.english: referring to the chance that something will actually happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The train is likely to be crowded because several large events are taking place this weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车很可能很拥挤，因为本周末会举行几场大型活动。

senses.english: probably; especially in American English
senses.exampleEnglish: We will likely need another table if all the families who booked decide to attend the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果所有预约的家庭都决定参加工作坊，我们大概还需要一张桌子。

senses.english: definitely true or is sure to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We certainly enjoyed the concert, although the journey home took much longer than we had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们确实很喜欢这场音乐会，尽管回家花的时间比预想长得多。

senses.english: concerning a nation as a whole
senses.exampleEnglish: The painting will remain in the national museum until the exhibition moves to another city next spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 这幅画将留在国家博物馆，直到展览明年春天移至另一座城市。

senses.english: a person who is a citizen of a particular country
senses.exampleEnglish: Foreign nationals should check the entry requirements carefully before making travel arrangements, because rules can differ between countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 外国公民在安排行程前应仔细核查入境要求，因为各国规定可能不同。

senses.english: referring to it
senses.exampleEnglish: The machine switches itself off when the water reaches the right temperature, which helps save energy.
senses.exampleChinese: 水达到适当温度时，这台机器会自动关闭，这有助于节能。

phrases.english: considered alone rather than with other factors
phrases.exampleEnglish: The delay was not a problem in itself, but it meant we would miss our connecting train later.
phrases.exampleChinese: 延误本身不算问题，却意味着之后会错过换乘火车。

senses.english: to help someone learn or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: My grandfather used to teach us how to repair simple tools rather than immediately buying new ones.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖父过去常教我们如何修理简单工具，而不是马上买新的。

senses.english: open area of land, especially without buildings
senses.exampleEnglish: We crossed a field of yellow flowers before reaching the narrow path that led towards the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们穿过一片开着黄花的田野，才到达通往湖边的狭窄小路。

senses.english: an area of study or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to work in the field of education after enjoying a summer spent helping younger students.
senses.exampleChinese: 一个夏天帮助年幼学生的愉快经历，让她决定进入教育领域工作。

senses.english: an area of ground used for a sport
senses.exampleEnglish: The players stayed off the field until the groundskeeper confirmed that the wet surface was safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 管理员确认湿滑的地面安全之前，队员们一直没有上场。

senses.english: a space for one kind of information in a form or database
senses.exampleEnglish: Please complete every required field before submitting the form, otherwise the system may ask you to start again.
senses.exampleChinese: 提交表格前请填完所有必填栏，否则系统可能要求重新开始。

senses.english: things done to protect people, buildings, a country, etc., from harm
senses.exampleEnglish: Airport security was unusually busy that morning, so we arrived earlier to allow enough time for checks.
senses.exampleChinese: 那天早晨机场安检异常繁忙，所以我们提早到达，留出足够的检查时间。

senses.english: financial assets such as shares and bonds, usually in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The course explains why different securities involve different risks, rather than telling students which investments they should buy.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程解释不同证券为何有不同风险，而不是告诉学生该买哪种投资。

senses.english: mixture of gases around the earth that we breathe
senses.exampleEnglish: Fresh air came through the open windows while we waited for the afternoon meeting to begin.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们等待下午会议开始时，新鲜空气从敞开的窗户吹了进来。

senses.english: a quality or manner that someone or something seems to have
senses.exampleEnglish: The empty classroom had an air of excitement because the students had left their colourful projects on display.
senses.exampleChinese: 空教室里展示着学生们色彩鲜艳的作品，洋溢着兴奋的气氛。

senses.english: to broadcast a programme on television, radio, or online
senses.exampleEnglish: The station will air the interview next week, after the team has checked the names and dates mentioned.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队核对采访中提及的姓名和日期后，电台将于下周播出采访。

senses.english: to let fresh air reach a room or object
senses.exampleEnglish: We should air the room before the guests arrive because it has been closed for several days.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人到来前我们应该给房间通通风，因为它已关了好几天。

senses.english: to express opinions or complaints openly
senses.exampleEnglish: The meeting gives residents a chance to air their concerns before the council makes a final decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议让居民有机会在市政委员会做最终决定前公开表达担忧。

phrases.english: being broadcast on radio or television
phrases.exampleEnglish: The presenter checked everyone's names before going on air so that the interview would begin smoothly and confidently.
phrases.exampleChinese: 主持人在开播前核对大家姓名，让采访顺利、自信地开始。

phrases.english: not yet decided or certain
phrases.exampleEnglish: The date is still up in the air because we have not found a weekend when the hall is available.
phrases.exampleChinese: 日期还未定，因为还没找到礼堂有空的周末。

senses.english: good result or effect, something advantageous
senses.exampleEnglish: One benefit of joining the club is that you can learn from people with more experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 加入这个俱乐部的一个好处是，你可以向经验更丰富的人学习。

senses.english: money paid to people who qualify for public support
senses.exampleEnglish: The adviser explained which benefit she could apply for while she was unable to return to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾问解释了她无法复工期间可以申请哪种补助。

senses.english: to help someone or gain an advantage
senses.exampleEnglish: The new timetable should benefit families who need to reach the hospital without changing buses in town.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表应该能让需要直达医院、无需进城换车的家庭受益。

phrases.chinese: 在证据不足时作善意判断
phrases.english: a decision to believe someone unless there is proof against them
phrases.exampleEnglish: We gave him the benefit of the doubt because nobody had checked whether the instructions were clear enough.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们姑且相信他，因为还没人查过说明是否足够清楚。

senses.english: to buy, sell and exchange goods in business
senses.exampleEnglish: The two villages used to trade goods at a weekly market before a road connected them.
senses.exampleChinese: 在一条道路将它们连接起来之前，这两个村庄过去每周在集市交易货物。

senses.english: the business of buying and selling goods or services
senses.exampleEnglish: Trade between the two towns increased after the bridge reduced the time needed to transport fresh food.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥梁缩短了运输生鲜食物的时间后，两镇之间的贸易增加了。

senses.english: a skilled job, especially one involving practical work
senses.exampleEnglish: He learned a trade while working with a local builder, then started his own small repair business.
senses.exampleChinese: 他跟随当地建筑工人学了一门手艺，随后开设了自己的小维修公司。

senses.english: to exchange one thing for another
senses.exampleEnglish: The children agreed to trade books after finishing them, so everyone could read more without buying new copies.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们约定读完后互换书，这样人人都不用买新书也能多读一些。

phrases.english: to give an old item as part payment for a new one
phrases.exampleEnglish: You can trade in your old bicycle if the shop agrees that its frame is still safe to reuse.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果商店认为旧自行车框架仍可安全再用，你就能以旧换新。

phrases.english: to accept less of one thing in order to gain another
phrases.exampleEnglish: We may need to trade off a little comfort against cost if we want the trip to remain affordable.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果想让旅行负担得起，可能需要在舒适与费用间取舍。

senses.english: to take the chance that you may do something dangerous
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided not to risk missing the last train, even though the concert had not finished.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管音乐会还没有结束，我们还是决定不冒错过末班火车的风险。

senses.english: the possibility of something harmful happening
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a risk of damage if the boxes get wet, so we should cover them before leaving.
senses.exampleChinese: 箱子淋湿就有损坏风险，所以离开前我们应该盖好它们。

phrases.english: in danger of being harmed or lost
phrases.exampleEnglish: The old documents are at risk if rain continues to enter through the damaged roof above the shelves.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果雨继续从架子上方的坏屋顶进来，旧文件就有危险。

senses.english: information about recent events
senses.exampleEnglish: The news about the new library pleased residents who had campaigned for better local services for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 有关新图书馆的消息让多年来争取改善当地服务的居民感到高兴。

senses.english: accepted level of quality; an official measurement
senses.exampleEnglish: The room includes all the standard equipment, but you must request a projector before the meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间包括所有标准设备，但你必须在会议前申请投影仪。

senses.english: a level of quality or a rule used for judging things
senses.exampleEnglish: The work did not meet the required standard, so the builders agreed to repair the uneven steps.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程没有达到规定标准，所以施工方同意修复高低不平的台阶。

senses.english: to make a choice for or against, as in an election
senses.exampleEnglish: Club members will vote on the proposal after everyone has had a chance to ask questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 待每个人都有机会提问后，俱乐部成员将对这个提议进行投票。

senses.english: an official choice made in an election or meeting
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal passed by a single vote after members discussed how the change would affect younger players.
senses.exampleChinese: 成员讨论了变化对年轻队员的影响后，提案以一票优势通过。

phrases.english: to reject a proposal by voting
phrases.exampleEnglish: The members may vote down the proposal if the organisers cannot explain how the extra cost will be covered.
phrases.exampleChinese: 如果组织者无法解释额外费用如何承担，成员可能投票否决提议。

senses.english: one one-hundredth of a whole
senses.exampleEnglish: Almost twenty percent of the students cycle to school, according to the survey we completed last month.
senses.exampleChinese: 根据我们上个月完成的调查，将近百分之二十的学生骑车上学。

senses.english: main purpose or center of interest or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The main focus of our discussion was how to make the school garden easier to maintain.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们讨论的重点是如何让学校花园更容易维护。

senses.english: to give your attention to one thing
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to focus on the main problem first, rather than discussing every small detail at this stage.
senses.exampleChinese: 现阶段我们需要先专注主要问题，而不是讨论每个小细节。

senses.english: to adjust a camera or your eyes to make an image clear
senses.exampleEnglish: The camera could not focus on the bird because branches kept moving between the lens and its nest.
senses.exampleChinese: 镜头与鸟巢之间的树枝不断晃动，所以相机无法对准那只鸟调焦。

phrases.english: not showing a clear or sharp image
phrases.exampleEnglish: The photograph was out of focus, so we could not tell which name was written above the entrance.
phrases.exampleChinese: 照片失焦了，我们看不清入口上方写的是哪个名字。

senses.english: place where actors or musician perform for others
senses.exampleEnglish: The musicians waited behind the stage until the audience had taken their seats and the lights dimmed.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐家们在舞台后等待，直到观众就座、灯光暗下。

senses.english: a particular part of a process or development
senses.exampleEnglish: At this stage of the project, we need feedback from the families who will actually use the playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 在项目这个阶段，我们需要实际使用游乐场的家庭提供反馈。

senses.english: to organize an event or present a performance
senses.exampleEnglish: The school plans to stage a concert in the garden if the weather remains dry next weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果下周末天气持续干燥，学校计划在花园举办一场音乐会。

senses.english: empty area with nothing in it
senses.exampleEnglish: We moved the desk beside the window to create more space in the middle of the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把书桌移到窗边，以便在房间中央腾出更多空间。

senses.english: the area beyond the earth's atmosphere
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how astronauts live in space, where everyday tasks become surprisingly difficult without normal gravity.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释了宇航员如何在太空生活，那里没有正常重力，日常任务都会变得出奇地困难。

senses.english: to arrange things with gaps between them
senses.exampleEnglish: Please space the chairs evenly along the table so that every visitor has enough room to sit comfortably.
senses.exampleChinese: 请沿桌子均匀摆放椅子，确保每位访客都有足够空间舒适就座。

senses.english: when one thing is replaced by another
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather was too wet for a picnic, so we invited everyone to our house instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气太湿，不适合野餐，所以我们改为邀请大家到我们家来。

phrases.english: in place of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We chose the quieter route instead of the main road, even though it added several minutes to the walk.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们选安静路线而非主路，虽然多走了几分钟。

senses.english: to become aware of or understand mentally
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not realize how much the town had changed until I visited my old school.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到参观了母校，我才意识到这个城镇变化有多大。

senses.english: to achieve something you hoped or planned for
senses.exampleEnglish: The course helped her realize her ambition of opening a bakery that also offered training to young people.
senses.exampleChinese: 这门课程帮助她实现了开面包店、同时为年轻人提供培训的抱负。

senses.english: normally; regularly
senses.exampleEnglish: We usually buy our vegetables at the market, although we sometimes use the supermarket when it rains.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们通常在市场买蔬菜，不过下雨时有时会去超市。

senses.english: facts or information used to calculate or analyze
senses.exampleEnglish: The team collected data from several schools before deciding which changes might improve students' learning experiences.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队在决定哪些改变可能改善学生的学习体验之前，收集了几所学校的数据。

senses.english: only, merely
senses.exampleEnglish: There was not a single empty seat when we entered the hall just before the performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 演出开始前，我们进入大厅时，一个空座位也没有。

senses.english: not married or in a romantic relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: Several single members joined the walking group simply because they wanted to meet people with similar interests.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位单身成员加入步行小组，仅仅因为想认识兴趣相投的人。

senses.english: a recorded song released separately rather than as part of an album
senses.exampleEnglish: The band's first single became popular after a local radio station played it during its evening programme.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地电台在晚间节目播放后，这支乐队的首张单曲流行起来。

senses.english: a ticket for travel in one direction; chiefly British English
senses.exampleEnglish: I bought a single to the coast because I planned to return by a different route the following day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我买了去海边的单程票，因为计划第二天走另一条路线返回。

phrases.english: to choose one person or thing for special attention
phrases.exampleEnglish: The teacher did not single out one student for praise because the whole group had contributed to the design.
phrases.exampleChinese: 老师没有只表扬一位学生，因为整个小组都为设计出力。

senses.english: exact street location of a place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please write your full address clearly so that the parcel can be delivered without any delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 请清楚地写下完整地址，以便包裹能毫无延误地送达。

senses.english: to deal with a problem or subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The new plan must address the shortage of safe crossings if more children are expected to walk to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果希望更多孩子步行上学，新计划就必须解决安全人行横道不足的问题。

senses.english: to speak formally to a person or group
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser will address the volunteers before the event begins, explaining which entrances they should help visitors find.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动开始前，组织者会向志愿者讲话，说明应帮游客找到哪些入口。

senses.english: to write a destination address on a letter or parcel
senses.exampleEnglish: Please address the parcel clearly before taking it to the post office, especially if it is going abroad.
senses.exampleChinese: 去邮局前请把包裹地址写清楚，尤其是要寄往国外时。

senses.english: a formal speech to an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: Her opening address welcomed the guests and explained why the museum wanted to work more closely with local schools.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的开幕演讲欢迎了来宾，并解释了博物馆为何希望更密切地与当地学校合作。

senses.english: activity done to entertain an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: Her performance was particularly impressive because she had only learned the difficult piece a few weeks earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的演出特别精彩，因为她仅在几周前才学会这首难曲。

senses.english: how well a person, machine, or organization does something
senses.exampleEnglish: The laptop's performance improved after we removed unused programmes, although it still struggled with large video files.
senses.exampleChinese: 删除不用的程序后，笔记本性能改善了，不过处理大视频文件仍然吃力。

senses.english: possibility that something will happen
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a good chance that we will finish early if everyone brings the materials we need.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果每个人都带齐所需材料，我们很有可能提前完成。

senses.english: an opportunity to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The visit gave students a chance to ask engineers questions that they could not easily answer in class.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次参观让学生有机会向工程师提出课堂上不易解答的问题。

senses.english: the way things happen without being planned
senses.exampleEnglish: We discovered the quiet beach by chance while looking for a place to stop and eat lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们找地方停下来吃午饭时，偶然发现了这片安静海滩。

phrases.english: because something unlikely might happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: We visited the ticket office on the off chance that someone had cancelled their booking for the afternoon tour.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们去售票处碰碰运气，希望有人取消下午导览预订。

senses.english: to agree to receive or take something offered
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to accept the offer after considering how the new role would affect her family.
senses.exampleChinese: 考虑了新职位对家庭的影响后，她决定接受这个录用邀请。

senses.english: to agree that something is true or can be allowed
senses.exampleEnglish: She found it hard to accept that the original plan would not work without a much larger budget.
senses.exampleChinese: 她很难接受这个事实：没有大得多的预算，原计划就无法实施。

senses.english: community of people living together
senses.exampleEnglish: Public libraries play an important role in society by giving people free access to information and ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 公共图书馆让人们免费获取信息和思想，在社会中发挥着重要作用。

senses.english: an organization for people sharing an interest or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The local history society invites residents to bring old photographs that might reveal how the town has changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地历史协会邀请居民带来可能展现城镇变迁的老照片。

senses.english: use or knowledge of science in industry, engineering, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: New technology allows us to share documents instantly, even when our colleagues are working in different countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 新技术让我们能够即时分享文件，即使同事们正在不同国家工作。

senses.english: to refer to or talk or write about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please mention any food allergies when you book, so that the restaurant can prepare a suitable meal.
senses.exampleChinese: 预订时请说明是否有食物过敏，以便餐馆准备合适的饭菜。

senses.english: a brief reference to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The article made no mention of the volunteers, although they had spent several weekends repairing the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章没有提到志愿者，虽然他们花了几个周末修路。

senses.english: decision between two or more possibilities
senses.exampleEnglish: We had a choice between taking the early bus and paying more for a direct train.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可以选择乘早班公交车，或多花钱坐直达火车。

senses.english: to rescue someone or something from a bad situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The quick response of the volunteers helped save several animals that had become trapped by the flood.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者的迅速反应帮助救出了几只被洪水困住的动物。

senses.english: to keep money or something else for future use
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to save a little money each month so that next year's trip would be easier to afford.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定每月存一点钱，让明年的旅行更容易负担。

senses.english: to use less of something or prevent wasted effort
senses.exampleEnglish: Booking online can save time at the entrance, especially when several groups arrive together during the busy season.
senses.exampleChinese: 网上订票能节省入口处的时间，旺季几个团体同时到达时尤其如此。

senses.english: to store computer information so it can be used later
senses.exampleEnglish: Remember to save your work before closing the programme, because changes may disappear if the battery runs out.
senses.exampleChinese: 关闭程序前记得保存工作，因为电池耗尽时修改内容可能丢失。

senses.english: an action that prevents an opponent from scoring
senses.exampleEnglish: The goalkeeper made an excellent save near the end, keeping the score level until the final whistle.
senses.exampleChinese: 守门员在快结束时精彩扑救，使比分直到终场哨响仍保持平局。

phrases.english: to gradually collect money for a purpose
phrases.exampleEnglish: They decided to save up for a longer holiday rather than paying for several short trips during the year.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他们决定攒钱去长假，而不是一年付几次短途游费用。

senses.english: typical, normal; not unusual
senses.exampleEnglish: It is common for visitors to get lost here because several streets have very similar names.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客在这里迷路很常见，因为几条街道的名字十分相似。

senses.english: shared by two or more people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The groups had a common goal, even though they disagreed about the best way to achieve it.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些团体有共同目标，尽管对最佳实现方法意见不一。

phrases.english: shared by two or more people or things
phrases.exampleEnglish: We discovered that we had a lot in common, despite having grown up in very different places.
phrases.exampleChinese: 尽管成长地方很不同，我们发现彼此有很多共同点。

phrases.english: practical good judgement in ordinary situations
phrases.exampleEnglish: Common sense suggests checking the weather before leaving, even if the route usually takes less than an hour.
phrases.exampleChinese: 即使路线通常不到一小时，常识也告诉我们出发前要看天气。

senses.english: beliefs and customs of a particular group
senses.exampleEnglish: Learning about another culture can help us understand why people communicate and celebrate in different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 了解另一种文化可以帮助我们理解，人们为什么以不同方式交流和庆祝。

senses.english: whole number or amount of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The total includes breakfast and transport, so you will not need to pay extra for those services.
senses.exampleChinese: 总价包括早餐和交通，所以你不必为这些服务额外付费。

senses.english: including everything
senses.exampleEnglish: The total price includes transport and meals, but you will need extra money if you want to buy souvenirs.
senses.exampleChinese: 总价包括交通和餐食，但如果想买纪念品，还需要额外的钱。

senses.english: to add amounts or have a particular total
senses.exampleEnglish: We will total the receipts after the trip and divide the cost equally among everyone who joined us.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅行后我们会合计收据费用，由所有参加者平均分担。

senses.english: to strongly request someone to do something; insist
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents demand better lighting along the path because several people have fallen there after dark this winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民强烈要求改善小路的照明，因为今年冬天已有几人在天黑后在那里摔倒。

senses.english: a firm request for something
senses.exampleEnglish: The parents' demand for safer roads became harder to ignore after more families began walking to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 更多家庭开始步行上学后，家长要求道路更安全的呼声更加难以忽视。

senses.english: the amount of something people want or need
senses.exampleEnglish: Demand for the evening course increased after workers said they could not attend classes during the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 上班族表示白天无法上课后，晚间课程的需求增加了。

phrases.english: whenever someone asks for it
phrases.exampleEnglish: The videos are available on demand, so students can review the instructions whenever they need help with a task.
phrases.exampleChinese: 视频可按需观看，学生做任务需要帮助时随时能复习说明。

senses.english: substance from which a thing is made of
senses.exampleEnglish: The designer chose a light material that would keep the jacket comfortable even in warm weather.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计师选了一种轻薄材料，让夹克即使在暖和天气里穿着也舒适。

senses.english: information or writing used for a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher selected material from several sources so that students could compare different views on the same issue.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师从几个来源选择资料，让学生比较同一问题上的不同观点。

senses.english: relating to physical things or possessions rather than ideas or feelings
senses.exampleEnglish: The story suggests that material success does not always bring happiness, especially when people lose contact with their families.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事表明，物质成功不总能带来幸福，尤其是当人们与家人失去联系时。

senses.english: point beyond which it is not possible to go
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a limit to how many visitors the island can welcome without damaging its natural environment.
senses.exampleChinese: 在不破坏自然环境的前提下，这座岛能接待的游客数量是有限的。

senses.english: to control the amount or extent of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We should limit the number of visitors inside the small room so that everyone can move safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该限制小房间内的访客数量，确保每个人都能安全走动。

senses.english: to use your ears to hear and understand things
senses.exampleEnglish: If you listen carefully to the instructions, you will find the activity much easier to complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果仔细听说明，你会发现完成这项活动容易得多。

senses.english: when something is required or expected
senses.exampleEnglish: The final report is due on Friday, so we need to check all the figures before then.
senses.exampleChinese: 最终报告周五到期，所以我们需要在那之前核对所有数字。

senses.english: owed, deserved, or needing to be given
senses.exampleEnglish: Please give the proposal due consideration before voting, because the change could affect how every group uses the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 投票前请对提案给予应有考虑，因为变化可能影响各组使用大厅的方式。

phrases.english: because of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The museum will close early due to building work, but the outdoor display will remain open until evening.
phrases.exampleChinese: 博物馆因施工提前关闭，不过户外展区仍开放到晚上。

senses.english: not right, incorrect; not true; bad
senses.exampleEnglish: We took the wrong turning after the bridge, which added another twenty minutes to our journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 过桥后我们拐错了弯，这使行程又增加了二十分钟。

senses.english: morally bad or unfair
senses.exampleEnglish: It seemed wrong to blame the youngest student when the instructions had been unclear for the whole group.
senses.exampleChinese: 全组都没看懂说明时，却责怪最小的学生，似乎不公平。

senses.english: in an incorrect way
senses.exampleEnglish: I wrote the address wrong on the first envelope, so I checked the second one much more carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 我在第一个信封上把地址写错了，因此第二个就核对得仔细得多。

senses.english: an unfair or morally bad action
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion helped them understand that correcting a wrong can require more than simply saying sorry afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论让他们明白，纠正不公正行为可能不只是事后道歉就够了。

phrases.english: to develop a problem or fail
phrases.exampleEnglish: If anything begins to go wrong during the demonstration, stop the machine and ask the instructor for help.
phrases.exampleChinese: 演示中若开始出问题，就停机器并向教练求助。

phrases.english: responsible for an unfair act or mistake
phrases.exampleEnglish: She admitted that she was in the wrong after reading the message she had overlooked before the meeting.
phrases.exampleChinese: 读过开会前漏看的消息后，她承认自己有错。

senses.english: lowest part of the leg we use to stand on
senses.exampleEnglish: She hurt her foot during the walk, so we stopped at a cafe while she rested.
senses.exampleChinese: 她步行时伤了脚，所以我们停在咖啡馆，让她休息。

senses.english: a unit of length equal to twelve inches
senses.exampleEnglish: The shelf is nearly a foot wider than the doorway, so we may need to carry it sideways.
senses.exampleChinese: 架子比门口宽近一英尺，所以可能需要侧着搬。

senses.english: the lower end or base of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We left our bicycles at the foot of the hill and followed the narrow path towards the tower.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把自行车留在山脚下，沿窄路朝塔走去。

phrases.english: by walking rather than using transport
phrases.exampleEnglish: We explored the old town on foot because the narrow streets were easier to reach without a car.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们步行探索老城，因为不开车反而更容易进入窄街。

phrases.english: to pay the cost of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organisers agreed to foot the bill for extra transport after changing the venue at very short notice.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者临时更改场地后，同意支付额外交通费。

senses.english: amount of work used trying to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The whole team made an effort to finish the display before the first visitors arrived that morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个团队努力赶在那天早晨首批访客到来前完成展品布置。

senses.english: focus of your thoughts on something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide asked for our attention before explaining which parts of the castle were open to visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游请大家注意听，然后解释城堡哪些部分对游客开放。

senses.english: care or action given to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The broken steps need immediate attention because visitors may not see the loose stones when the light is poor.
senses.exampleChinese: 破损台阶需要马上处理，因为光线不好时，访客可能看不到松动石块。

senses.english: more formal term for on
senses.exampleEnglish: Upon entering the room, we noticed a handwritten message resting upon the table beside the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 一进房间，我们就注意到窗边桌子上放着一张手写便条。

phrases.english: a traditional opening for a story set in the past
phrases.exampleEnglish: The storyteller began with once upon a time, then invited the children to imagine a village beside a forest.
phrases.exampleChinese: 讲故事的人以从前开头，让孩子想象森林旁的村庄。

senses.english: to confirm the details of something are correct
senses.exampleEnglish: We should check whether the tickets include luggage before we decide which train service to book.
senses.exampleChinese: 在决定预订哪班火车前，我们应该核实票价是否包含行李费用。

senses.english: to stop or limit the growth or progress of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The fence should check the spread of the climbing plant before it begins to cover the neighbouring windows.
senses.exampleChinese: 围栏应该能限制攀缘植物扩散，免得它开始覆盖邻居的窗户。

senses.english: an examination to make sure something is correct or safe
senses.exampleEnglish: A quick check of the equipment revealed that one helmet was damaged and should not be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 快速检查设备后发现，一顶头盔已损坏，不能使用。

senses.english: a written order asking a bank to pay money; American spelling
senses.exampleEnglish: She sent a check with the application because the small club did not yet accept payments online.
senses.exampleChinese: 她随申请寄了张支票，因为这个小俱乐部尚不接受网上付款。

senses.english: a pattern of crossing lines that forms squares
senses.exampleEnglish: The small blue check on the fabric made it easy to notice when two pieces were not aligned.
senses.exampleChinese: 布料上的小蓝方格，让两块布没有对齐时很容易被发现。

phrases.english: to register your arrival at a hotel or airport
phrases.exampleEnglish: We can check in after two o'clock, but the hotel will keep our bags while we explore the town.
phrases.exampleChinese: 两点后才能入住，不过探索城镇期间酒店可以保管行李。

phrases.english: to leave a hotel after paying, or examine something
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need to check out before eleven, so we should pack our bags before going downstairs for breakfast.
phrases.exampleChinese: 十一点前需退房，所以应该下楼早餐前收好行李。

phrases.english: to find out whether someone or something is doing as expected
phrases.exampleEnglish: I will check up on the young plants tomorrow because the forecast suggests another unusually warm afternoon.
phrases.exampleChinese: 明天我会查看幼苗情况，因为预报下午又会异常温暖。

senses.english: to finish or reach the end of doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The students worked in pairs to complete the experiment before comparing their results with another group.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们两人一组完成实验，然后与另一组比较结果。

senses.english: having every part, or completely finished
