senses.exampleEnglish: The set is not complete without the final booklet, which explains how to use the more advanced equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 没有最后那本介绍高级设备使用方法的小册子，这套资料就不完整。

senses.english: to say something that you know is not true
senses.exampleEnglish: He decided not to lie about the broken window because he knew someone else might be blamed.
senses.exampleChinese: 他决定不为打破窗户的事撒谎，因为他知道别人可能会受到责怪。

senses.english: something said that the speaker knows is untrue
senses.exampleEnglish: The lie seemed harmless at first, but it made the later explanation much harder for anyone to believe.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个谎言起初似乎无害，却让之后的解释更加难以让人相信。

senses.english: to be in a resting or particular position; past lay, participle lain
senses.exampleEnglish: You can lie on the grass while we unpack the picnic, provided the ground has dried after last night's rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 昨晚雨后的地面如果已干，你可以躺在草地上，等我们拿出野餐食物。

phrases.english: to stay in bed later than usual; chiefly British English
phrases.exampleEnglish: We planned to lie in on Sunday, but the noise from the market woke us much earlier than expected.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们原想周日睡懒觉，市场噪声却比预想早得多把我们吵醒。

phrases.english: to exist in a particular cause or feature
phrases.exampleEnglish: The main difficulty may lie in the instructions, rather than in the ability of the students trying the activity.
phrases.exampleChinese: 主要困难可能在说明，而不是做活动的学生能力。

phrases.english: to be expected in the future
phrases.exampleEnglish: We discussed the challenges that lie ahead before deciding how much time each volunteer could realistically offer.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定每位志愿者实际能投入多少时间前，我们讨论了未来挑战。

senses.english: to decide on a thing from various choices; select
senses.exampleEnglish: You can pick a topic that interests you, provided there is enough information available for your research.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以选择自己感兴趣的话题，前提是有足够的信息可用于研究。

senses.english: to remove flowers, fruit, or similar things from a plant
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer showed us how to pick the fruit without damaging the branches that would grow again next year.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民教我们如何摘果子，而不伤害明年还会生长的树枝。

senses.english: the person or thing chosen, especially as the best
senses.exampleEnglish: The blue design was the children's pick, although the adults preferred a quieter colour for the classroom wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们选了蓝色设计，虽然大人更喜欢给教室墙用柔和的颜色。

senses.english: a small pointed tool, including one used to play a guitar
senses.exampleEnglish: He dropped his guitar pick during the concert, but another musician quickly handed him a spare one.
senses.exampleChinese: 演出时他的吉他拨片掉了，但另一位乐手很快递来一片备用的。

phrases.english: to collect someone or something
phrases.exampleEnglish: I will pick up the tickets after work so that we do not have to queue on Saturday morning.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我下班后取票，让我们周六早晨不用排队。

phrases.english: to learn something informally through experience
phrases.exampleEnglish: She began to pick up useful phrases while helping visitors, even though she had never taken a formal language course.
phrases.exampleChinese: 帮游客时她自然学会了实用短语，尽管从没上过正式语言课。

phrases.english: to improve or increase
phrases.exampleEnglish: Business should pick up when the bridge reopens and customers can reach the shops without taking a long detour.
phrases.exampleChinese: 桥重开、顾客不用绕远后，生意应该会好转。

phrases.english: to choose or recognize one thing among others
phrases.exampleEnglish: Can you pick out our village on the map before we start discussing which route would be shortest?
phrases.exampleChinese: 讨论哪条路最短前，你能在地图上认出我们村吗？

phrases.english: to repeatedly criticize or treat someone unfairly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The teacher reminded the group not to pick on beginners who were still learning how to use the tools.
phrases.exampleChinese: 老师提醒大家不要针对还在学用工具的初学者。

senses.english: to make something smaller or use less of it
senses.exampleEnglish: We hope to reduce food waste by planning meals carefully and using ingredients that are already available.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们希望通过仔细安排餐食并利用现有食材来减少食物浪费。

senses.english: of or about a particular person
senses.exampleEnglish: She prefers to keep her personal photographs off public websites, although she shares them with close friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 她倾向于不把私人照片放到公开网站上，不过会与好友分享。

senses.english: directed at a person rather than the matter being discussed
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion became personal when members criticised each other's character instead of explaining their objections to the plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 成员不解释对计划的反对理由，反而批评彼此性格，讨论变成了人身攻击。

senses.english: the solid surface of the earth
senses.exampleEnglish: The ground was still wet from the overnight rain, so we spread a waterproof sheet beneath the picnic blanket.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜雨过后地面仍然湿着，所以我们在野餐毯下面铺了一张防水布。

senses.english: a reason or basis for an opinion or action
senses.exampleEnglish: There is no ground for assuming the course is easy simply because it has no written examination.
senses.exampleChinese: 不能只因为课程没有笔试，就认定它很容易；这种判断没有根据。

senses.english: land used for a purpose or surrounding a building, often plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The school grounds are open to residents at weekends, although the classrooms themselves remain locked for security.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校场地周末向居民开放，不过教室本身出于安全考虑仍会上锁。

senses.english: to prevent an aircraft or person from flying
senses.exampleEnglish: Thick fog may ground the smaller aircraft until conditions improve enough for pilots to see the runway clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 浓雾可能让小型飞机停飞，直到天气好转、飞行员能看清跑道。

senses.english: to forbid a child from going out as a punishment
senses.exampleEnglish: His parents decided to ground him for the weekend after he returned home much later than they had agreed.
senses.exampleChinese: 他回家比约好的时间晚了很多，父母决定周末罚他禁足。

senses.english: reduced to small particles by crushing or grinding
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe uses ground almonds instead of flour, so we checked whether any guests had a nut allergy.
senses.exampleChinese: 食谱用杏仁粉代替面粉，所以我们确认了客人是否有人坚果过敏。

phrases.english: shared beliefs or interests that make agreement possible
phrases.exampleEnglish: The discussion helped both groups find common ground, even though they still preferred different locations for the new playground.
phrases.exampleChinese: 讨论让两组找到共识，虽然仍偏好不同游乐场选址。

phrases.english: to begin to succeed after planning
phrases.exampleEnglish: The project will only get off the ground if enough volunteers can commit to helping for several weekends.
phrases.exampleChinese: 只有足够志愿者承诺帮几个周末，项目才能启动。

senses.english: a living creature that is not a plant or person
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide reminded us not to approach any animal that appeared nervous or was protecting its young.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游提醒我们，不要靠近显得紧张或正在保护幼崽的动物。

senses.english: to reach the place you are travelling to
senses.exampleEnglish: If we arrive before the museum opens, we can have breakfast at the cafe across the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果在博物馆开门前到达，我们可以在马路对面的咖啡馆吃早餐。

senses.english: not getting annoyed when things take a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: Our instructor remained patient while we practised the difficult movement, even though we kept making mistakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们练习那个困难动作时，教练一直很有耐心，尽管我们总是犯错。

senses.english: someone receiving medical care
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained the procedure to each patient before asking whether they had questions about the appointment.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士先向每位病人解释流程，再询问他们对这次就诊是否有疑问。

senses.english: happening or being in the present time
senses.exampleEnglish: The current timetable leaves little time for discussion, so we are considering making each session longer.
senses.exampleChinese: 目前的时间表几乎没有留讨论时间，所以我们正考虑延长每场活动。

senses.english: a continuous flow of water, air, or electricity
senses.exampleEnglish: The current was stronger near the bridge, so the instructor kept the boats close to the sheltered bank.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥附近水流更强，所以教练让船靠近有遮挡的岸边。

senses.english: period of 100 years
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge was built over a century ago, yet it still carries traffic through the town every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前，但每天仍有车辆从桥上穿城而过。

senses.english: factual proof that helps to establish the truth
senses.exampleEnglish: The team needed more evidence before they could explain why the river water had changed colour.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队需要更多证据，才能解释河水为什么变了颜色。

senses.english: to be present, alive or real
senses.exampleEnglish: Some traditional skills still exist in this village because older residents continue to teach them to children.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄仍保留着一些传统技艺，因为年长居民一直把它们传授给孩子。

senses.english: nearly the same
senses.exampleEnglish: The two paintings look similar from a distance, but their colours are quite different when viewed closely.
senses.exampleChinese: 远看这两幅画像很相似，但近看时，它们的颜色差别很大。

senses.english: act of trying to hurt someone by hitting them
senses.exampleEnglish: A fight broke out after the match, but the players quickly helped the coach calm everyone down.
senses.exampleChinese: 比赛后发生了一场打斗，但队员们很快帮助教练让所有人冷静下来。

senses.english: a determined effort to achieve something or stop something bad
senses.exampleEnglish: Their fight for a safer crossing continued until the council agreed to include one in the road plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们为安全人行横道争取了很久，直到市政委员会同意把它纳入道路计划。

senses.english: to use physical force against someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher separated the children before they could fight and asked each one to explain what had happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师在孩子们动手前把他们分开，请每个人说说发生了什么。

senses.english: to try very hard to achieve something or oppose something bad
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents will fight to keep the library open because many families depend on its free books and computers.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民将争取保留图书馆，因为很多家庭依赖其免费图书和电脑。

senses.english: person who is in charge of a group or task
senses.exampleEnglish: A good leader listens to different opinions before deciding how the group should deal with a problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 优秀的领导者会先听取不同意见，再决定团队该如何处理问题。

senses.english: a person or organization ahead of others in a field
senses.exampleEnglish: The small company became a leader in repair services by making old equipment easier for customers to reuse.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家小公司让顾客更容易重新使用旧设备，从而成为维修服务领域的领军者。

senses.english: good, acceptable or satisfactory
senses.exampleEnglish: The room was small but perfectly fine for our needs, since we spent most of the day outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间虽小，但完全能满足需求，因为我们一天大部分时间都在外面。

senses.english: very small, thin, or delicate
senses.exampleEnglish: A fine layer of dust covered the shelves, so we wiped them carefully before putting the books back.
senses.exampleChinese: 架子上覆着一层细灰，所以放回图书前我们仔细擦拭了它们。

senses.english: of very good quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displays fine examples of local pottery, including pieces made long before the railway reached the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆展示当地陶器的精品，其中有铁路通到镇上之前很久制作的作品。

senses.english: dry and pleasant when describing weather
senses.exampleEnglish: We expected fine weather for the picnic, but still packed a waterproof sheet in case the forecast was wrong.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们预计野餐会遇上好天气，但还是带了防水布，以防预报不准。

senses.english: money paid as a punishment for breaking a rule or law
senses.exampleEnglish: Drivers who block the entrance may receive a fine because emergency vehicles need to reach the building quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 堵住入口的司机可能被罚款，因为应急车辆需要迅速到达建筑。

senses.english: to make someone pay money as a punishment
senses.exampleEnglish: The council can fine businesses that leave rubbish on the pavement after their shops have closed for the night.
senses.exampleChinese: 市政委员会可以对夜间关店后仍把垃圾留在人行道上的商家罚款。

collocations.chinese: 因停车违规对某人罚款

senses.english: well or in a satisfactory way
senses.exampleEnglish: The old printer works fine for simple documents, although it cannot produce the detailed colour images we need.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧打印机打印简单文件没问题，但无法印出我们需要的精细彩色图像。

senses.english: road in a city with buildings and places to walk
senses.exampleEnglish: The street becomes quieter in the evening, when the market stalls close and most visitors leave.
senses.exampleChinese: 到了晚上，市场摊位关闭、大多数游客离开时，这条街就安静下来。

senses.english: having a particular position or quality in the past but not now
senses.exampleEnglish: A former teacher returned to the school to describe how the neighbourhood had changed over the years.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位前任教师回到学校，讲述这个社区多年来如何变化。

senses.english: the first of two people or things mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: We can travel by train or coach, but the former would give us more time in the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可以乘火车或长途客车，但前者能让我们在城里多待些时间。

senses.english: to get in touch with someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please contact the organiser if your plans change, so that your place can be offered to someone else.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果计划有变，请联系组织者，以便把你的名额让给别人。

senses.english: communication with someone, or a person who can provide help
senses.exampleEnglish: The club keeps regular contact with former members, who often return to help organise events for new students.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部定期与老成员保持联系，他们常回来帮助为新学生组织活动。

senses.english: the state of physically touching something
senses.exampleEnglish: Avoid direct contact with the painted surface until it has dried, even if the colour already looks even.
senses.exampleChinese: 油漆干透前不要直接接触表面，即使颜色看上去已经均匀。

senses.english: specially; more than others
senses.exampleEnglish: The path is particularly beautiful in autumn, when the leaves turn gold and fewer visitors are around.
senses.exampleChinese: 秋天树叶变成金色、游客减少时，这条小路尤其美丽。

senses.english: married woman
senses.exampleEnglish: His wife suggested taking the earlier train because it would give them more time to explore the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 他的妻子建议坐更早的火车，因为这样能给他们更多时间探索城市。

senses.english: game or physical exercise with rules
senses.exampleEnglish: Trying a new sport can be a good way to meet people, even if you are not competitive.
senses.exampleChinese: 尝试一项新运动可以是结识朋友的好方法，即使你并不好胜。

senses.english: to make something ready for use
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to prepare a few questions before the interview so that we can use the time well.
senses.exampleChinese: 面试前我们需要准备几个问题，以便充分利用时间。

senses.english: to talk about something seriously or in great detail
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee will discuss the proposal next week, after members have had time to read the full report.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员们有时间阅读完整报告之后，委员会将于下周讨论这个提案。

senses.english: something said or written as an answer to something
senses.exampleEnglish: We have not received a response to our invitation, although the event is now less than a week away.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然距离活动已不到一周，我们仍未收到邀请的回复。

senses.english: sound made when you speak or sing
senses.exampleEnglish: She lowered her voice when she entered the library, where several students were preparing for an exam.
senses.exampleChinese: 她进入图书馆时压低了声音，那里有几名学生正在准备考试。

senses.english: an opinion or the ability to influence decisions
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey gives younger residents a voice in decisions about spaces that they will use every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查让年轻居民能对每天要使用的空间表达意见、参与决策。

senses.english: to express an opinion or feeling
senses.exampleEnglish: Several parents chose to voice their concerns after discovering that the new route crossed two busy roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位家长发现新路线要穿过两条繁忙道路后，决定表达担忧。

senses.english: a verb form showing whether the subject acts or receives an action
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to change the sentence into the passive voice without losing any important information.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师要求我们把句子改成被动语态，同时保留所有重要信息。

senses.english: small part that of something larger
senses.exampleEnglish: Each student chose a piece of coloured paper and folded it into a shape of their own design.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个学生选了一张彩纸，把它折成自己设计的形状。

senses.english: one work of music, writing, or art
senses.exampleEnglish: The orchestra performed a piece that the composer had written while living in a small village nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐团演奏了一首作品，那是作曲家住在附近小村庄时写的。

senses.english: end of something; completion
senses.exampleEnglish: The race had a surprising finish, as the youngest runner passed two experienced competitors near the end.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场比赛的结局出人意料，最年轻的选手在接近终点时超过了两名经验丰富的对手。

senses.english: to complete something or reach its end
senses.exampleEnglish: We should finish the first set of repairs before ordering materials for the next stage of the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该先完成第一批维修，再为项目下一阶段订购材料。

senses.english: the final appearance or coating of a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The table has a smooth finish that makes it easy to clean after children have used it for painting.
senses.exampleChinese: 桌子表面光滑，孩子们用来画画后也很容易清洁。

senses.english: to imagine or guess what might happen
senses.exampleEnglish: I suppose we could move the meeting online if the weather prevents people from travelling safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果天气使大家无法安全出行，我想我们可以把会议改为在线举行。

senses.english: to imagine a situation in order to consider it
senses.exampleEnglish: Suppose the last bus is cancelled; we need another plan that does not depend on finding a taxi.
senses.exampleChinese: 假设末班公交取消了，我们就需要一个不依赖叫到出租车的备用计划。

senses.english: to ask formally for (a job, building permission, etc.)
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to apply for the training course after discovering that it included several practical workshops.
senses.exampleChinese: 得知培训课程包含几场实践工作坊后，她决定申请参加。

senses.english: to use a method, rule, or knowledge in a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: You can apply the same method to a different problem once you understand why each step is necessary.
senses.exampleChinese: 明白每一步为何必要后，你就能把同样的方法用到另一个问题上。

senses.english: to put something on a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: Apply the paint in thin layers and let each one dry before adding more to the wooden frame.
senses.exampleChinese: 把油漆薄薄地涂上一层，等每层干了再给木框涂下一层。

senses.english: to be relevant or have an effect in a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The discount does not apply to weekend tickets, although families can still get a reduced price by booking together.
senses.exampleChinese: 折扣不适用于周末票，不过家庭一起预订仍能享受优惠价格。

senses.english: person in charge of a country, company, or organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The club president welcomed the new members before explaining how they could take part in future events.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部会长先欢迎新成员，然后解释他们可以如何参加今后的活动。

senses.english: heat and the flame produced when burning
senses.exampleEnglish: We kept the fire small because there was little dry wood left after the rainstorm.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴雨过后剩下的干木头不多了，所以我们把火控制得很小。

senses.english: to dismiss someone from a job
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager refused to fire the new assistant without first checking whether unclear training had caused the mistake.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理拒绝在查明是否因培训不清而出错前，就解雇新助理。

senses.english: to shoot a gun or send out a projectile
senses.exampleEnglish: The historical display explains how sailors used to fire a small cannon as a signal to the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史展览解释水手过去如何用小炮向港口发出信号。

senses.english: to consider how similar and different things are
senses.exampleEnglish: Before buying a new laptop, compare the features that matter most to the work you actually do.
senses.exampleChinese: 购买新笔记本电脑之前，比较一下对你实际工作最重要的那些功能。

senses.english: large, flat area, to play tennis or basketball
senses.exampleEnglish: The basketball court behind the school is open to local families when lessons have finished for the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校后面的篮球场在当天课程结束后向当地家庭开放。

senses.english: a place or institution where legal cases are decided
senses.exampleEnglish: The court asked both sides to provide written evidence before deciding who was responsible for the damage.
senses.exampleChinese: 法院要求双方提供书面证据，再决定谁应对损坏负责。

senses.english: the ruler's household and people associated with it
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how musicians at the royal court created performances for visitors from other countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示宫廷乐师如何为来自其他国家的访客创作演出。

senses.english: people, often in uniforms, who solve crimes
senses.exampleEnglish: The police asked anyone who had seen the missing bicycle to contact the local station directly.
senses.exampleChinese: 警方请所有见过那辆丢失自行车的人直接联系当地警察局。

senses.english: to keep order or make sure rules are obeyed
senses.exampleEnglish: Volunteers cannot police every part of the park, so visitors must take responsibility for following the rules.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者无法监督公园每个角落，所以访客须自觉守规。

senses.english: place where you can go to buy things
senses.exampleEnglish: The store stays open later on Fridays so that people can shop after they finish work.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家商店周五营业到更晚，方便人们下班后购物。

senses.english: to keep something so it can be used later
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to store the tools somewhere dry so that they remain safe to use next spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要把工具存放在干燥处，确保来年春天仍能安全使用。

senses.english: a supply of something kept for future use
senses.exampleEnglish: The centre keeps a store of spare blankets for visitors who arrive after long journeys in cold weather.
senses.exampleChinese: 中心储备了一些备用毛毯，给寒冷天气里长途跋涉而来的访客使用。

senses.english: without money; not rich
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity works with poor families who need help buying school clothes and other essential items.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家慈善机构帮助需要资助购买校服等必需品的贫困家庭。

senses.english: not good in quality or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The poor lighting made the map difficult to read, so we moved closer to the station entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 光线不好，地图难以看清，所以我们移近了车站入口。

senses.english: deserving sympathy because of an unhappy situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The poor child had lost her ticket and was worried that she would not be allowed to join the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 那个可怜的孩子丢了车票，担心无法参加旅行。

senses.english: information, understanding, or skill
senses.exampleEnglish: Her knowledge of local history made the walk more interesting than simply following a map would have been.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对当地历史的了解，让这次步行比单纯照着地图走更有趣。

senses.english: to make a happy sound when something is funny
senses.exampleEnglish: We could not help but laugh when the dog proudly carried our empty picnic basket back home.
senses.exampleChinese: 狗得意地提着空野餐篮回家时，我们都忍不住笑了。

senses.english: the sound or act of laughing
senses.exampleEnglish: Her cheerful laugh helped everyone relax after a nervous start to the first meeting of the course.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程第一次会议开始时大家很紧张，她爽朗的笑声让所有人放松下来。

senses.english: part of your body from your shoulder to your hand
senses.exampleEnglish: She carried the books under one arm while using her other hand to open the classroom door.
senses.exampleChinese: 她一只胳膊夹着书，另一只手用来打开教室门。

senses.english: to provide someone with weapons or useful equipment
senses.exampleEnglish: The history book explains why the leaders chose to arm the guards after the borders became less secure.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史书解释了边境不再安全后，领导者为何决定给守卫配武器。

senses.english: a part of a larger organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The research arm of the company tests new materials before they are used in products sold to customers.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司的研究部门在新材料用于对外销售的产品前，先对其测试。

senses.english: part of the body that pumps blood
senses.exampleEnglish: During the science lesson, we learned how the heart pumps blood around the body throughout the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学课上，我们学习了心脏如何全天将血液泵送到全身。

senses.english: a person's feelings, courage, or kindness
senses.exampleEnglish: She has a kind heart and often notices when someone needs help before they ask for it.
senses.exampleChinese: 她心地善良，常在别人开口前就察觉对方需要帮助。

senses.english: the most important or central part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The library is at the heart of the village, both on the map and in everyday community life.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆既位于村庄的地理中心，也处在日常社区生活的核心。

senses.english: produces or provides what is wanted or needed
senses.exampleEnglish: The village well used to be the main source of drinking water before pipes reached every house.
senses.exampleChinese: 在管道通到每家每户之前，村里的水井曾是主要饮用水来源。

senses.english: to find or obtain something from a supplier
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe tries to source vegetables locally so that deliveries are shorter and customers know where their food comes from.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆尽量采购本地蔬菜，让运输距离更短，也让顾客知道食物来源。

senses.english: person who works for someone else for payment
senses.exampleEnglish: Every new employee attends a short course that explains the company's safety rules and working procedures.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位新员工都会参加一门短期课程，了解公司的安全规则和工作流程。

senses.english: to run or operate a business by directing others
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to manage the cafe by working alongside her aunt, who had run it for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 她与经营咖啡馆多年的姑姑一起工作，从而学会了如何管理咖啡馆。

senses.english: to succeed in doing something difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: We managed to finish before the rain arrived, although several volunteers had to stay later than planned.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们设法在下雨前完成，不过几位志愿者不得不比计划多留一会儿。

senses.english: to deal with a situation or live with what is available
senses.exampleEnglish: Can you manage without the car tomorrow, or should I ask someone to give you a lift?
senses.exampleChinese: 明天没有车你能应付吗，还是要我请人捎你一程？

senses.english: in an easy or clear manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions explain the process simply, so you do not need any previous experience to follow them.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明用简单的方式解释了流程，所以无需任何经验也能照着操作。

senses.english: only or merely
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not cancel because of the price; we simply could not find a date when everyone was free.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不是因价格而取消，只是找不到大家都有空的日期。

senses.english: used to emphasize a description or statement
senses.exampleEnglish: The view from the tower was simply wonderful, especially when the evening light reached the mountains beyond the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 塔上的景色简直太美了，尤其当夕阳照到湖那边的群山时。

senses.english: a financial institution that keeps or lends money
senses.exampleEnglish: We went to the bank to ask which account would be suitable for saving money regularly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们去银行询问哪种账户适合定期储蓄。

senses.english: the land beside a river or lake
senses.exampleEnglish: We sat on the bank and watched the boats pass while waiting for the rest of the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们坐在河岸边，看着船只经过，等候小组其他人。

senses.english: to put money into a bank account
senses.exampleEnglish: The club will bank the money after the event, once two volunteers have checked that the total is correct.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动后，两位志愿者核对总额无误，俱乐部就会把钱存入银行。

senses.english: fairly hard or solid, not soft
senses.exampleEnglish: The mattress was too firm for my sister, so the hotel offered her a softer one.
senses.exampleChinese: 床垫对我姐姐来说太硬了，所以酒店给她换了一张更软的。

senses.english: strongly decided or not easily changed
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher was firm about the safety rules but happy to listen when students suggested different activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师严格坚持安全规则，但乐意倾听学生提出不同活动的建议。

senses.english: a business, especially one providing professional services
senses.exampleEnglish: The local firm offered free advice to the school when it was planning repairs to the old hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校计划修缮旧礼堂时，当地公司提供了免费建议。

senses.english: short for 'cellphone'
senses.exampleEnglish: My cell phone had no signal inside the building, so I stepped outside to call the driver.
senses.exampleChinese: 我的手机在楼里没有信号，所以我走到外面给司机打电话。

senses.english: the smallest basic unit of a living organism
senses.exampleEnglish: The microscope allowed students to see the cell walls clearly after they prepared a very thin piece of onion.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生准备好一片很薄的洋葱后，显微镜让他们清楚看到了细胞壁。

senses.english: a small room where a prisoner is kept
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum preserved one old prison cell so that visitors could understand how people had once been confined there.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆保留了一间旧牢房，让游客了解人们过去如何被关押。

senses.english: one box in a spreadsheet for a piece of information
senses.exampleEnglish: Enter the total in the final cell, then check whether the formula has included every row above it.
senses.exampleChinese: 在最后一个单元格输入总数，再检查公式是否包含上方每一行。

senses.english: piece of writing about a particular subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The article explains why some birds return to the same garden every year, despite travelling enormous distances.
senses.exampleChinese: 这篇文章解释了为什么有些鸟尽管迁徙很远，每年仍返回同一个花园。

senses.english: a word such as a, an, or the used before a noun
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained why the definite article was needed when we referred to the same book a second time.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师解释了第二次提到同一本书时，为什么需要定冠词。

senses.english: one item, especially of clothing or equipment
senses.exampleEnglish: Each article of clothing must be labelled clearly so that lost items can be returned after the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 每件衣服都必须清楚标注姓名，以便旅行后归还遗失物品。

senses.english: moving or able to move quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: The river was too fast for our small boat, so the instructor chose a calmer section.
senses.exampleChinese: 河水流速对我们的小船来说太快，所以教练选了一段更平缓的河道。

senses.english: quickly or at high speed
senses.exampleEnglish: The river was moving too fast for beginners, so the instructor chose a calmer area near the bank.
senses.exampleChinese: 河水流得太快，不适合初学者，所以教练选了靠岸较平缓的区域。

senses.english: to go without food for a period
senses.exampleEnglish: She was asked to fast before the test, and the clinic gave her clear instructions about drinking water.
senses.exampleChinese: 检查前她被要求禁食，诊所清楚说明了能否喝水。

senses.english: a period when someone does not eat
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained that the community meal marked the end of a fast that many families had observed.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释，这顿集体餐标志着许多家庭遵守的一段禁食期结束。

senses.english: to try to destroy, beat, or injure
senses.exampleEnglish: The smaller animal will only attack if it cannot escape or thinks its young are in danger.
senses.exampleChinese: 这种较小的动物只有在无法逃走或认为幼崽有危险时才会攻击。

senses.english: an act of using force against someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The history display describes an attack on the harbour and how local residents helped rebuild it afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史展览讲述了对港口的一次袭击，以及当地居民事后如何帮助重建。

senses.english: to criticize someone or something strongly
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker chose to attack the proposal rather than the people who had worked hard to develop it.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言者选择批评提案，而不是攻击为提出它付出努力的人。

senses.english: a sudden period of illness or severe discomfort
senses.exampleEnglish: The article describes how an asthma attack affected the athlete's training and why she later changed her routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章讲述一次哮喘发作如何影响运动员训练，以及她后来为何调整日常安排。

senses.english: being of a different place or country
senses.exampleEnglish: Studying a foreign language can help you understand everyday customs when you travel to another country.
senses.exampleChinese: 学习外语可以帮助你在去另一个国家旅行时理解当地日常习俗。

senses.english: strange or not familiar to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Working alone was foreign to her at first, because every previous job had involved a large team.
senses.exampleChinese: 独自工作起初对她很陌生，因为她以前的每份工作都涉及大团队。

senses.english: to do something that another person didn't expect
senses.exampleEnglish: The children hoped to surprise their teacher by decorating the classroom before she arrived that morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们希望在老师那天早晨到来前装饰好教室，给她一个惊喜。

senses.english: an unexpected event or the feeling it causes
senses.exampleEnglish: The visit was a pleasant surprise because she had not expected her old friends to come so far.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次来访是一个愉快的惊喜，因为她没想到老朋友会远道而来。

senses.english: distinctive or important point of something
senses.exampleEnglish: One useful feature of the app is that it saves your work even without an internet connection.
senses.exampleChinese: 这款应用的一项实用功能是，即使没有网络连接也能保存你的工作。

senses.english: to include someone or something as an important part
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition will feature work by local students alongside paintings that have been borrowed from the national collection.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览将重点展出当地学生的作品，以及从国家馆藏借来的画作。

senses.english: a special newspaper article or broadcast about a subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The newspaper published a feature about the volunteers who had restored the riverside path over several weekends.
senses.exampleChinese: 报纸刊发专题文章，介绍几个周末持续修复河边步道的志愿者。

senses.english: something that influences a result
senses.exampleEnglish: Cost was an important factor in our decision, but we also considered how long the equipment would last.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用是我们决策中的重要因素，但我们也考虑了设备能使用多久。

senses.english: a number that divides another number exactly
senses.exampleEnglish: The students listed every factor of twelve before explaining why some numbers had fewer possible divisions than others.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们列出十二的所有因数，然后解释为何一些数字可整除的方式比其他数字少。

senses.english: being attractive to the eye in a simple way
senses.exampleEnglish: The village square looked particularly pretty when the evening lights came on around the old stone fountain.
senses.exampleChinese: 傍晚，古老石喷泉周围的灯亮起时，村庄广场显得格外漂亮。

senses.english: fairly or quite; informal
senses.exampleEnglish: The walk was pretty easy until we reached the steep steps that led up to the old tower.
senses.exampleChinese: 步行相当轻松，直到我们走到通往老塔的陡阶。

senses.english: just a while ago; not long ago
senses.exampleEnglish: The library recently introduced longer opening hours after students asked for somewhere quiet to study after school.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们希望放学后有个安静的学习场所，因此图书馆最近延长了开放时间。

senses.english: to do something that changes something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The roadworks may affect your journey to school, particularly if you usually travel during the morning rush hour.
senses.exampleChinese: 道路施工可能影响你上学的路程，尤其是当你通常在早高峰出行时。

senses.english: to let something fall from your hand
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to drop the glass bowl while you carry it across the wet kitchen floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 端着玻璃碗走过湿漉漉的厨房地板时，小心别把它掉在地上。

senses.english: to fall or let something fall
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to drop the equipment while carrying it upstairs because the replacement parts are difficult to obtain locally.
senses.exampleChinese: 上楼搬设备时当心别摔了，因为更换零件在当地难买。

senses.english: a reduction in something or a small rounded amount of liquid
senses.exampleEnglish: A small drop in temperature made the evening walk more comfortable after the unusually hot weather earlier in the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 白天天气异常炎热，气温小幅下降使傍晚散步更舒适。

senses.english: happening or beginning not long ago
senses.exampleEnglish: The recent changes to the timetable have made it easier for people to reach the hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 最近的时刻表调整让人们更容易到达医院。

senses.english: to make, find, or show a connection between two or more things
senses.exampleEnglish: The exercise asks us to relate the ideas in the article to problems in our own community.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项练习要求我们把文章中的观点与自己社区的问题联系起来。

collocations.chinese: 将某事与某事联系起来

senses.english: to tell a story or describe events
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will relate the story of the rescue while we walk past the old harbour buildings.
senses.exampleChinese: 经过旧港口建筑时，导游会讲述那次救援的故事。

senses.english: of or done by someone in authority; formal
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited for an official announcement before telling our customers that the event had been postponed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们等到正式公告发布后，才告诉顾客活动已延期。

senses.english: a person with a position of authority
senses.exampleEnglish: An official checked our booking before directing us to the entrance reserved for groups visiting the exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位工作人员先核查预订，再指引我们去专供参观团体使用的入口。

senses.english: involving money
senses.exampleEnglish: The group needs financial support to repair the old hall and keep it open for community activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个团体需要资金支持，以修缮旧礼堂并让它继续用于社区活动。

senses.english: to be too late to ride on something (e.g., train or bus)
senses.exampleEnglish: We left the exhibition early because we did not want to miss the last bus home.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们提前离开展览，因为不想错过回家的末班公交车。

senses.english: to fail to notice, hear, or understand something
senses.exampleEnglish: I missed the final instruction because someone opened the noisy door just as the teacher was explaining it.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师解释最后一条说明时，有人打开吵闹的门，所以我没听清。

senses.english: to feel sad because someone or something is absent
senses.exampleEnglish: She began to miss her old neighbours after moving, although the new area was quieter and closer to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬家后她开始想念老邻居，虽然新住处更安静、离工作地点也更近。

senses.english: to fail to hit or reach a target
senses.exampleEnglish: The ball missed the window by a few centimetres, which reminded us to play further from the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 球差几厘米就撞上窗户，这提醒我们要离建筑远一点玩。

senses.english: a creative skill using the imagination (e.g., painting)
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition combines art and science by showing how artists use light to create surprising effects.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场展览展示艺术家如何利用光线创造惊人效果，将艺术与科学结合起来。

senses.english: to work in an organized and active way toward a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Local residents campaign for safer crossings because many children walk along the main road to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地居民为更安全的人行横道开展活动，因为许多孩子沿主路步行上学。

senses.english: a planned series of actions to achieve a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The campaign encouraged families to walk to school by showing them routes that avoided the busiest roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场活动向家庭介绍避开繁忙主路的路线，鼓励他们步行上学。

senses.english: personal; not to be seen by everyone
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel has a private garden where guests can relax away from the noise of the main street.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家酒店有一座私家花园，客人可以远离主街噪声，在那里放松。

senses.english: owned by individuals rather than the government
senses.exampleEnglish: The private company runs the service, but the council checks whether it meets the standards promised to residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项服务由私营公司经营，但市政委员会检查它是否达到向居民承诺的标准。

senses.english: to stop doing for a while before continuing
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker decided to pause for a moment so that the audience could study the diagram carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 演讲者决定暂停片刻，让观众能仔细研究图示。

senses.english: a short stop before continuing
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a brief pause while everyone checked the map and decided which path looked safest after the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家查看地图、判断雨后哪条路最安全时，短暂停了一会儿。

senses.english: every person; everybody
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone who joined the trip was asked to bring water, as there were no shops along the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 所有参加旅行的人都被要求带水，因为沿途没有商店。

senses.english: to not remember something
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not forget to save your work before leaving, especially if the computer is shared with other students.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前别忘了保存工作，尤其是当这台电脑与其他学生共用时。

senses.english: one side of a sheet of paper
senses.exampleEnglish: On the last page of the booklet, you will find a map showing all the walking routes.
senses.exampleChinese: 在小册子的最后一页，你会找到一张标有所有步行路线的地图。

senses.english: to call someone over a public-address system
senses.exampleEnglish: The receptionist will page the visitor if we cannot find her before the coach is ready to leave.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果大巴出发前还找不到那位访客，接待员会广播呼叫她。

senses.english: (v) to cause (n) the feeling that something bad or unpleastant might happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Try not to worry about making mistakes, because they can help you notice what you need to practise.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽量别担心犯错，因为错误可以帮助你发现需要练习什么。

senses.english: a feeling of concern or something that causes it
senses.exampleEnglish: Her main worry was that the children might not understand the safety instructions before trying the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 她最担心的是，孩子们尝试活动前可能没听懂安全说明。

senses.english: part of the year when the weather is hot
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent the summer helping our grandparents repair their house before they moved back in that autumn.
senses.exampleChinese: 那个夏天，我们帮祖父母修房子，之后他们在秋天搬了回去。

senses.english: to put water in your body through your mouth
senses.exampleEnglish: After walking for several hours in warm weather, we stopped to drink water in the shade.
senses.exampleChinese: 在暖和的天气里走了几个小时后，我们停在阴凉处喝水。

senses.english: a liquid for drinking or one serving of it
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped for a drink at the station cafe because the next part of the journey would take several hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在车站咖啡馆喝了点东西，因为下一段路程要花几个小时。

senses.english: an alcoholic drink or alcohol in general
senses.exampleEnglish: They decided to serve food without drink at the school celebration, since most guests were families with young children.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们决定学校庆祝活动只供食物不供酒，因为来宾大多是带幼儿的家庭。

senses.english: a person's thoughts on a topic
senses.exampleEnglish: In my opinion, the best part of the course was being able to practise with other learners.
senses.exampleChinese: 我认为，这门课程最棒的地方是能够与其他学习者一起练习。

senses.english: to leave a vehicle in a particular place for a time
senses.exampleEnglish: You can park behind the library, provided you leave enough space for the delivery van to pass.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以把车停在图书馆后面，前提是留下足够的空间让送货车通过。

senses.english: a public area for walking, playing, and relaxing
senses.exampleEnglish: The park includes a quiet garden where visitors can sit away from the football pitches and playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 公园内有一处安静花园，访客可以远离足球场和游乐区坐着休息。

senses.english: to stand in the place or to act the part of
senses.exampleEnglish: Two students will represent our class at the meeting and explain the changes we would like to see.
senses.exampleChinese: 两名学生将代表我们班参加会议，说明我们希望看到的改变。

senses.english: to stand for or show something in an image or symbol
senses.exampleEnglish: The blue line will represent the river on our map, while small circles mark the bridges and crossing points.
senses.exampleChinese: 蓝线在我们的地图上表示河流，小圆圈则标出桥梁和过河点。

senses.english: to make up an amount or be equivalent to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The extra cost would represent nearly half our budget, so we need to consider a cheaper option.
senses.exampleChinese: 额外费用将占预算近一半，所以我们需要考虑更便宜的选择。

senses.english: something you use to open a lock or start a car
senses.exampleEnglish: I gave my neighbour a spare key so that she could water the plants while we were away.
senses.exampleChinese: 我给邻居一把备用钥匙，方便她在我们外出时给植物浇水。

senses.english: very important or necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: Clear instructions are a key part of the activity because each group will work without constant help.
senses.exampleChinese: 清楚的说明是活动关键部分，因为各组不会一直得到帮助。

senses.english: something that explains, solves, or makes success possible
senses.exampleEnglish: The key to the exercise is understanding why the speaker changes her plan halfway through the conversation.
senses.exampleChinese: 这道练习的关键，是明白说话者为何在谈话中途改变计划。

senses.english: one part pressed to operate a keyboard or instrument
senses.exampleEnglish: One key on the keyboard stopped working, so I could not type the address without copying the missing letter.
senses.exampleChinese: 键盘一个键失灵了，我得复制缺少的字母才能打出地址。

senses.english: the set of notes on which a piece of music is based
senses.exampleEnglish: The singer asked to change the key because the highest notes were uncomfortable for her voice that evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 那晚最高几个音唱得不舒服，所以歌手要求换调。

senses.english: being in something
senses.exampleEnglish: The inside pockets are large enough to hold a phone, which makes the jacket useful for travelling.
senses.exampleChinese: 内侧口袋大到足以装下手机，这让这件夹克很适合旅行。

senses.english: the inner part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The inside of the box was lined with soft fabric to protect the glass bowl during transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 盒子内部衬着软布，用于在运输时保护玻璃碗。

senses.english: within a place or object
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep the tickets inside your bag until we reach the gate, where a volunteer will check them.
senses.exampleChinese: 到门口前把票放在包里，那里会有志愿者检票。

senses.english: in or into an enclosed place
senses.exampleEnglish: We moved inside when the wind grew stronger, although we could still see the garden through the windows.
senses.exampleChinese: 风变大时我们移到室内，不过仍能透过窗户看到花园。

senses.english: person who controls and runs a business or group
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager asked the team for suggestions before deciding how to improve the shop's opening hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理在决定如何调整商店营业时间前，向团队征求了建议。

senses.english: done or relating to several countries, not just your own
senses.exampleEnglish: The town hosts an international music festival that attracts performers and visitors from many different countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个城镇举办国际音乐节，吸引来自许多不同国家的表演者和游客。

senses.english: to hold something inside something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The box may contain fragile items, so please keep it upright while carrying it upstairs carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 箱内可能装有易碎品，所以小心往楼上搬时请保持竖直。

senses.english: to stop something from spreading or becoming stronger
senses.exampleEnglish: The team worked quickly to contain the leak before water reached the shelves where old documents were stored.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队迅速行动控制漏水，防止水流到存放旧文件的架子。

senses.english: to become aware by sight, touch, or hearing
senses.exampleEnglish: Did you notice the new sign near the entrance, which explains where bicycles should be left?
senses.exampleChinese: 你注意到入口附近那块新指示牌了吗？上面说明了自行车应停在哪里。

senses.english: a written or printed announcement
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice on the door explains why the library will close early and when normal hours will return.
senses.exampleChinese: 门上的告示解释图书馆为何提前关闭，以及何时恢复正常开放时间。

senses.english: information given before something happens or ends
senses.exampleEnglish: We received very little notice of the change, so several families arrived before anyone could explain the new arrangements.
senses.exampleChinese: 变更通知来得很晚，所以几家人到达时还没人来得及说明新安排。

senses.english: surprise caused by experiencing something amazing
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched in wonder as the butterfly slowly opened its wings and flew towards the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们惊奇地看着蝴蝶慢慢展开翅膀，飞向窗户。

senses.english: to think about something because you want to know more
senses.exampleEnglish: I wonder whether the museum has enough space for our group, or if we should book separate visits.
senses.exampleChinese: 我想知道博物馆是否有足够空间接待我们，还是应该分批预约。

senses.chinese: 奇观；令人赞叹的人或物
senses.english: something that causes admiration or amazement
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide called the old bridge an engineering wonder because it had survived so many floods without major repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游称老桥为工程奇迹，因为它经历多次洪水却无需大修。

senses.english: physical world, including plants, animals, rocks
senses.exampleEnglish: Spending time in nature helps me relax, especially after a week of working inside a busy office.
senses.exampleChinese: 在大自然中度过时光有助于我放松，尤其是在繁忙办公室工作一周之后。

senses.english: the basic character or qualities of a person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: Her generous nature meant she often offered help before anyone in the group realised that support was needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她生性慷慨，常在组员意识到需要支持前就主动帮忙。

senses.english: the type or basic features of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to understand the nature of the problem before deciding whether more staff or better equipment would help.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们得先弄清问题的性质，再决定增加人员还是改善设备更有帮助。

senses.english: way something is built, arranged, or organized
senses.exampleEnglish: The structure of the building allows plenty of light to enter without making the rooms too hot.
senses.exampleChinese: 这栋建筑的结构让大量光线进入，同时不会使房间过热。

senses.english: something built from connected parts
senses.exampleEnglish: The stone structure beside the river once stored grain, but it is now used for small exhibitions.
senses.exampleChinese: 河边那座石建筑过去储存谷物，如今用于小型展览。

senses.english: to arrange parts in an organized way
senses.exampleEnglish: We will structure the course around practical tasks so that students can use each new skill immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将围绕实践任务安排课程，让学生能立即使用每项新技能。

senses.english: one of the parts that form something
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the final section carefully because it explains what to do if the machine stops working.
senses.exampleChinese: 仔细阅读最后一节，因为它解释了机器停止运转时该怎么做。

senses.english: same person as did the action mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: I made the shelves myself, although a friend showed me how to use the tools safely first.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些架子是我自己做的，不过一位朋友事先教我如何安全使用工具。

senses.english: no more and no less than; precisely
senses.exampleEnglish: Please tell me exactly where you left the bag, so that I can help you look for it.
senses.exampleChinese: 请准确告诉我你把包放在哪里了，这样我才能帮你找。

senses.english: living thing with leaves and roots growing in soil
senses.exampleEnglish: The plant beside my window grows towards the light, so I turn its pot every few days.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗边的植物朝着光线生长，所以我每隔几天就转动一下花盆。

senses.english: a factory or large industrial facility
senses.exampleEnglish: The new recycling plant will process material that local shops previously had to send outside the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的回收厂将处理当地商店过去不得不送到外地的材料。

senses.english: to put seeds or plants into the ground to grow
senses.exampleEnglish: We will plant the young trees after the path is repaired, so visitors do not damage their roots.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会在小路修好后种幼树，免得访客损坏它们的根。

senses.english: to put something somewhere secretly, often to mislead or harm
senses.exampleEnglish: The detective suspected that someone had tried to plant false evidence before the police arrived at the empty house.
senses.exampleChinese: 侦探怀疑有人在警方到空屋前，试图放置假证据。

senses.english: to apply something; coat
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to paint the walls a lighter colour because the room receives little natural light.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定把墙刷成较浅的颜色，因为房间里的自然光很少。

senses.english: a coloured substance spread over a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The paint was still wet when the visitors arrived, so we blocked the doorway with a temporary sign.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客到来时油漆还没干，所以我们用临时标牌挡住门口。

senses.english: to create a picture using coloured substances
senses.exampleEnglish: She likes to paint places she has visited, using photographs only when she cannot remember the colours clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 她喜欢画去过的地方，只有记不清颜色时才参考照片。

senses.english: person who works
senses.exampleEnglish: Each worker received training before using the new equipment, even if they had done similar jobs before.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位工人在使用新设备前都接受了培训，即使以前做过类似的工作。

senses.english: to push something against something else
senses.exampleEnglish: Press the green button once the light stops flashing, and the machine will begin printing your ticket.
senses.exampleChinese: 指示灯停止闪烁后按绿色按钮，机器就会开始打印你的车票。

senses.english: to try strongly to persuade someone or obtain something
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents continue to press the council for safer crossings, especially near schools where traffic is heavy in the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民继续敦促市政委员会改善人行横道，尤其是早晨交通繁忙的学校附近。

senses.english: newspapers and other organizations reporting news
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum invited the press to see the restored paintings before the exhibition opened to the public.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆在展览向公众开放前，邀请媒体观看修复后的画作。

senses.english: a machine that prints or applies pressure
senses.exampleEnglish: The old printing press still works, although volunteers turn its handle slowly during demonstrations for school groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 这台老印刷机仍能使用，不过志愿者给学生团体演示时会慢慢转动把手。

senses.english: anything or everything needed; no matter what
senses.exampleEnglish: You can choose whatever materials you need, as long as you put the unused ones away afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以选择任何需要的材料，只要事后把没用的收好。

senses.english: anything or everything that is needed or possible
senses.exampleEnglish: You can bring whatever you need for the activity, provided it fits safely inside your own bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以带活动所需的任何东西，只要能安全装进自己的包里。

senses.english: an informal response showing that you do not care; sometimes rude
senses.exampleEnglish: When he replied with whatever, she explained that ignoring the question would not help them agree on a plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 他回答随便后，她说明不理会问题无助于两人商定计划。

senses.english: needed or required; unavoidable
senses.exampleEnglish: It is necessary to book a place in advance because the workshop can only accommodate twelve people.
senses.exampleChinese: 有必要提前预约，因为这个工作坊只能容纳十二个人。

senses.english: part of a country, of the world, area, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The region is famous for its fruit farms, which supply fresh produce to markets across the country.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个地区以果园闻名，向全国各地的市场供应新鲜农产品。

senses.english: act of growing
senses.exampleEnglish: The growth of the town has increased demand for housing and put pressure on local transport services.
senses.exampleChinese: 城镇的发展增加了住房需求，也给当地交通服务带来了压力。

senses.english: last part of the day and early part of the night
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent the evening planning our trip, although we still could not agree on which route to take.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们花了一个晚上规划旅行，不过仍未能就路线达成一致。

senses.english: to affect what happens; change something (indirectly)
senses.exampleEnglish: The books we read as children can influence the way we understand the world many years later.
senses.exampleChinese: 童年读过的书会影响我们多年后理解世界的方式。

senses.english: the power to affect people or events
senses.exampleEnglish: Her influence helped the group consider quieter activities that families with very young children could enjoy together.
senses.exampleChinese: 在她的影响下，小组开始考虑适合带幼儿的家庭一起参与的安静活动。

senses.english: to think very highly of another person because of what they do
senses.exampleEnglish: I respect her ability to stay calm when everyone else is worried about finishing the work on time.
senses.exampleChinese: 当其他人都担心能否按时完工时，她还能保持冷静，我敬佩她这种能力。

senses.english: admiration or considerate treatment
senses.exampleEnglish: The students showed respect for the guide by listening carefully and waiting until she finished before asking questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们认真听讲，等导游说完再提问，以此表示尊重。

senses.english: a particular aspect of something, often used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The two courses are similar in many respects, although one offers much more practical work than the other.
senses.exampleChinese: 两门课程在很多方面相似，不过其中一门的实践内容多得多。

senses.english: to follow a rule or take someone's rights or wishes seriously
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors must respect the quiet areas so that people who came to study can concentrate without constant interruptions.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客必须遵守安静区规定，让来学习的人能专心，不被不断打扰。

senses.english: several; consisting of different things or types
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum offers various activities that allow visitors to discover how people lived several hundred years ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供各种活动，让访客了解几百年前人们如何生活。

senses.english: use your hands to stop and hold something flying
senses.exampleEnglish: I managed to catch the ball before it rolled under a car parked beside the school gate.
senses.exampleChinese: 球滚到校门旁停着的汽车下面之前，我设法接住了它。

senses.english: to reach a bus, train, or other transport in time
senses.exampleEnglish: If we leave the museum now, we should catch the last bus without having to hurry through the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果现在离开博物馆，我们应该能赶上末班公交，无须匆忙穿城。

senses.english: to become ill with a disease
senses.exampleEnglish: Several students caught a cold during the holiday, so the teacher moved their presentations to the following week.
senses.exampleChinese: 几名学生假期感冒了，所以老师把他们的展示安排到下一周。

senses.english: to hear or understand something said
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not catch the guide's last instruction because a coach passed just as she began explaining the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游刚开始解释路线时一辆大巴驶过，所以我没听清最后一条说明。

senses.english: to discover someone doing something, especially something wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher caught him using the wrong tool and stopped the task before any damage could occur.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师发现他用了不合适的工具，赶在损坏发生前停下任务。

senses.english: a hidden difficulty in something that looks attractive
senses.exampleEnglish: The price seemed unusually low, so we checked the conditions carefully to find out whether there was a catch.
senses.exampleChinese: 价格低得异常，所以我们仔细检查条件，看看是否暗藏问题。

senses.english: the fish or other animals caught on an occasion
senses.exampleEnglish: The fishermen brought their catch into the harbour early so that the market could sell it while still fresh.
senses.exampleChinese: 渔民一早把渔获带进港口，让市场能趁新鲜出售。

senses.english: therefore; so; as a result
senses.exampleEnglish: The new path avoids the main road, thus making the journey to school safer for children.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条新小路避开了主路，因此让孩子们上学的路程更加安全。

senses.english: ability to do something well
senses.exampleEnglish: Learning a practical skill can increase your confidence, especially when you use it to help someone else.
senses.exampleChinese: 学习一项实用技能可以增强信心，尤其是当你用它帮助别人的时候。

senses.english: to try to do something challenging or difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not attempt to move the heavy cupboard alone, because it could damage the floor or injure you.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要试图独自搬动这个重柜子，因为它可能损坏地板或使你受伤。

senses.english: an effort to do something difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: Her first attempt was not successful, but the feedback helped her understand which part needed more practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 她第一次尝试没有成功，但反馈让她明白哪部分需要更多练习。

senses.english: male child; friendly way of addressing a boy
senses.exampleEnglish: Their son chose to study in another city, although he still returns home most weekends to visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的儿子选择去另一座城市读书，不过大多数周末仍回家探望。

senses.english: not hard to understand or do; not complex
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions are simple enough for beginners, but the final task still requires patience and careful planning.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明足够简单，初学者也能懂，但最后的任务仍需要耐心和仔细规划。

senses.english: plain and without unnecessary decoration
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a simple dress because the event was informal and she wanted something comfortable to wear all evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选了条朴素连衣裙，因为活动不正式，而且她想整晚穿得舒适。

senses.english: a middle size, especially in clothing
senses.exampleEnglish: The jacket in a medium fitted my shoulders, but I needed a large to wear a thick jumper underneath.
senses.exampleChinese: 这件夹克中码的肩部合适，但要在里面穿厚毛衣就需要大码。

senses.english: between small and large or between low and high
senses.exampleEnglish: Cook the vegetables over medium heat while you prepare the sauce, following the timing suggested in the recipe.
senses.exampleChinese: 按食谱建议的时间，用中火烹调蔬菜，同时准备酱汁。

senses.english: a means of communication or artistic expression
senses.exampleEnglish: Radio remains an important medium for reaching people who spend long hours travelling without a reliable internet connection.
senses.exampleChinese: 对那些长时间出行、网络不稳定的人而言，广播仍是重要传播媒介。

senses.english: typical or normal; usual; ordinary
senses.exampleEnglish: An average family in the area spends more on transport than families living near the city centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个地区的普通家庭花在交通上的钱比住在市中心附近的家庭多。

senses.english: the sum of quantities divided by how many there are
senses.exampleEnglish: We calculated the average after checking all the measurements, because one unusually high result could change the figure.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们核对全部测量值后计算平均数，因为一个异常高值就可能改变结果。

senses.english: to have a particular mean value
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey times average about forty minutes, although traffic near the school can make the morning trip longer.
senses.exampleChinese: 行程平均约四十分钟，不过学校附近的交通会让早晨花更久。

senses.english: calculated as a mathematical mean
senses.exampleEnglish: The average score improved after the extra lessons, although some students still needed individual help with listening.
senses.exampleChinese: 补课后平均分提高了，不过一些学生仍需要个别听力帮助。

senses.english: goods that a business keeps available for sale or use
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop keeps extra stock during the holiday season because deliveries can take longer than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 假日季节这家商店会保留额外库存，因为送货可能比平时更慢。

senses.english: shares in a company
senses.exampleEnglish: The article explains why buying stock involves uncertainty, even when a company has reported strong results recently.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章解释了为何买股票有不确定性，即使公司最近业绩强劲。

senses.english: liquid made by cooking meat or vegetables in water
senses.exampleEnglish: Add the vegetable stock gradually while stirring, so that the rice absorbs the liquid without sticking to the pan.
senses.exampleChinese: 一边搅拌一边慢慢加入蔬菜高汤，让米饭吸收汤汁而不粘锅。

senses.english: to keep a supply of goods available
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop will stock spare parts for older bicycles because many residents prefer repairing them to buying new ones.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店会储备旧自行车的零件，因为很多居民更愿意维修而不是买新的。

senses.english: regularly used without being adapted to a particular situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The stock answer did not explain our problem, so we asked someone to look at the individual details.
senses.exampleChinese: 那个套话没解释我们的问题，所以我们请人查看具体细节。

senses.english: the people responsible for controlling a business or organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The management agreed to change the rota after staff explained why the current arrangements were difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 员工解释了现有安排的困难后，管理层同意更改轮班表。

senses.english: the activity of controlling or organizing something
senses.exampleEnglish: Good management of the equipment means fewer delays when several groups need to use the same materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 妥善管理设备意味着几个小组共用材料时，等待会更少。

senses.english: your personality or nature
senses.exampleEnglish: Her patient character makes her a good person to work with when a task becomes unexpectedly difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 她耐心的性格让她在任务意外变难时，仍是一位很好的合作伙伴。

senses.english: a person in a story, film, or play
senses.exampleEnglish: The main character changes her opinion after listening to people whose lives are very different from her own.
senses.exampleChinese: 主角听了生活与自己截然不同的人们的经历后，改变了看法。

senses.english: a letter, number, or symbol used in writing
senses.exampleEnglish: The password must contain at least one number, and every character should be entered exactly as shown.
senses.exampleChinese: 密码必须至少包含一个数字，而且每个字符都应按显示准确输入。

senses.english: a piece of furniture that people sleep on
senses.exampleEnglish: I left the book beside the bed so that I could finish reading it before going to sleep.
senses.exampleChinese: 我把书放在床边，以便睡前读完。

senses.english: the bottom of a river, lake, or sea
senses.exampleEnglish: The clear water allowed us to see stones on the river bed before the afternoon wind disturbed the surface.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午风吹皱水面前，清澈的水让我们看见河床石块。

senses.english: a prepared area of soil for growing plants
senses.exampleEnglish: The children planted a flower bed beside the path so that visitors could enjoy colour throughout the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们在路边种了花坛，让游客整个夏天都能欣赏色彩。

senses.english: to fight, attack or damage something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The ball hit the window with such force that everyone in the classroom turned towards the noise.
senses.exampleChinese: 球用力撞上窗户，教室里所有人都朝响声转过头。

senses.english: someone or something very popular or successful
senses.exampleEnglish: The simple outdoor game was a hit with families because children of different ages could play together.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个简单户外游戏很受家庭欢迎，因为不同年龄的孩子可以一起玩。

senses.english: an act of striking something
senses.exampleEnglish: One strong hit damaged the wooden frame, although the glass inside somehow remained in a single piece.
senses.exampleChinese: 一次重击损坏了木框，里面的玻璃却不知怎么仍然完整。

senses.english: to reach a particular amount, level, or point
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitor numbers hit a new record when the museum introduced free evening sessions for local families last summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 去年夏天博物馆为当地家庭开设免费晚间场次后，访客人数创了新高。

senses.english: to affect someone or something badly
senses.exampleEnglish: The long road closure hit small businesses near the bridge because customers found it difficult to reach them.
senses.exampleChinese: 长期封路使桥附近的小商户受到冲击，因为顾客很难前往。

senses.english: to set or create something to last for a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: The group hopes to establish a regular meeting place where residents can share ideas and solve local problems.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个团体希望建立一个固定会面场所，让居民分享想法、解决当地问题。

senses.english: to discover or prove a fact clearly
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to establish who owns the land before asking permission to create a path across it.
senses.exampleChinese: 在请求开辟穿过土地的小路之前，我们需要查明土地属于谁。

senses.english: actually; in fact; in reality
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey was tiring indeed, but the view from the mountain made every step feel worthwhile.
senses.exampleChinese: 这趟旅程的确很累，但山顶的景色让每一步都显得值得。

senses.english: being the last thing in a series
senses.exampleEnglish: The final version of the report includes several changes that were suggested during our meeting last week.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告的最终版本包含几处上周会议中提出的修改。

senses.english: the last and deciding stage of a competition or examination course
senses.exampleEnglish: The team reached the final after weeks of training, but their coach reminded them to enjoy the experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 几周训练后球队进入决赛，不过教练提醒他们享受这段经历。

senses.english: total of all the goods, services, and wages in an area
senses.exampleEnglish: Tourism supports the local economy, but residents are concerned about the number of visitors arriving each summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅游业支撑着当地经济，但居民担心每年夏季到访的游客数量。

senses.english: careful use that avoids wasting money or resources
senses.exampleEnglish: The design combines comfort with economy of space, making the small flat suitable for a young family.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项设计兼顾舒适与空间节约，使小公寓适合年轻家庭居住。

senses.english: the least expensive class of travel
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose economy for the short flight so that more of our budget could go towards activities after arrival.
senses.exampleChinese: 短途航班我们选了经济舱，把更多预算留给到达后的活动。

senses.english: proper or acceptable; morally or socially correct
senses.exampleEnglish: The old hall is no longer fit for public use because its roof needs extensive repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧礼堂已经不适合向公众开放，因为屋顶需要大规模维修。

senses.english: healthy and physically strong
senses.exampleEnglish: She became fitter by walking regularly, rather than trying to complete difficult workouts that she did not enjoy.
senses.exampleChinese: 她靠经常步行增强体能，而不是勉强做不喜欢的困难训练。

senses.english: to be the right shape or size
senses.exampleEnglish: The cupboard will not fit through the doorway unless we remove its doors and turn it onto its side.
senses.exampleChinese: 除非拆下柜门再把柜子侧过来，否则它过不了门口。

senses.english: to put equipment or a part into position
senses.exampleEnglish: A local company will fit the new windows while the museum is closed to visitors next Monday.
senses.exampleChinese: 下周一博物馆闭馆时，一家当地公司会安装新窗。

senses.english: a sudden period of coughing, laughter, or another condition
senses.exampleEnglish: A fit of coughing interrupted his explanation, so he paused for water before continuing with the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 一阵咳嗽打断了说明，他停下来喝水后才继续演示。

senses.english: informal man; boy; any person
senses.exampleEnglish: The guy at the information desk showed us a quieter route that avoided the busy shopping streets.
senses.exampleChinese: 咨询台那位男子给我们指了一条较安静、避开繁忙商业街的路线。

senses.english: what something is intended to be used for; purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The main function of the roof is to keep rain out, although it also helps control temperature.
senses.exampleChinese: 屋顶的主要功能是挡雨，不过它也有助于调节温度。

senses.english: to work or perform a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The heating system cannot function properly until the damaged pipe has been repaired and the water pressure checked.
senses.exampleChinese: 受损管道修好、水压检查完之前，供暖系统无法正常运转。

senses.english: an organized social event, often formal
senses.exampleEnglish: The hall is used for a variety of functions, from family celebrations to meetings for local businesses.
senses.exampleChinese: 礼堂用于多种活动，从家庭庆祝到本地企业会议都有。

senses.english: day before today
senses.exampleEnglish: We were planning to leave yesterday, but the storm forced us to stay for another night.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们原计划昨天离开，但暴风雨迫使我们多留了一晚。

senses.english: the day before today
senses.exampleEnglish: Yesterday was the first time we had managed to bring all the volunteers together since the project began.
senses.exampleChinese: 昨天是项目开始以来，我们第一次成功让所有志愿者聚到一起。

senses.english: picture, sculpture, or painting of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The image on the poster shows how the town might look once the building work is complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 海报上的图片展示了工程完成后，这个城镇可能的样子。

senses.english: the impression people have of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The company hopes to improve its image by making repairs easier and reducing the amount of packaging it uses.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司希望通过便于维修、减少包装来改善形象。

senses.english: how big or small a thing is
senses.exampleEnglish: Check the size of the cupboard carefully before buying it, because the doorway is rather narrow.
senses.exampleChinese: 购买前请仔细检查柜子的尺寸，因为门口相当窄。

senses.english: way a person or thing acts; manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained that respectful behavior was expected throughout the visit, especially inside the quiet exhibition rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师解释说，参观全程都要举止有礼，尤其是在安静的展厅内。

senses.english: fact of adding something; thing that is added
senses.exampleEnglish: The addition of a small table made the kitchen a much more comfortable place to spend time.
senses.exampleChinese: 添了一张小桌子后，厨房成了一个舒适得多的活动空间。

senses.english: the process of adding numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: The game gives children practice in addition while they work out how many counters each player has collected.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个游戏让孩子计算各玩家收集多少筹码，同时练习加法。

senses.english: to control exactly how something will be or act
senses.exampleEnglish: The amount of space available will determine how many tables we can put in the hall safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 可用空间的大小将决定我们能在大厅内安全摆放多少张桌子。

senses.english: to discover something by examining evidence
senses.exampleEnglish: The team will determine whether the water is safe by testing samples from several points along the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队将测试河流沿岸几个位置的样本，确定水质是否安全。

senses.english: to decide firmly to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: She determined to finish the course despite the long journey she had to make after work each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管每周下班后都要长途赶路，她仍决心完成课程。

senses.english: place where you can catch a train or a bus
senses.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet outside the station, where there would be enough room for everyone to wait.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们约定在车站外见面，那里有足够的地方供大家等候。

senses.english: an organization broadcasting radio or television programmes
senses.exampleEnglish: The radio station invited students to describe their project so that more local families would hear about it.
senses.exampleChinese: 电台邀请学生介绍项目，让更多当地家庭了解它。

senses.english: a building or place where a particular service operates
senses.exampleEnglish: The fire station welcomed visitors for an afternoon, allowing families to see the equipment without interrupting emergency work.
senses.exampleChinese: 消防站开放了一个下午，让家庭在不妨碍应急工作的情况下参观设备。

senses.english: to place a person somewhere for a particular duty
senses.exampleEnglish: We will station a volunteer beside each entrance so that visitors can easily ask for directions when they arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会在每个入口安排志愿者，让游客到达时方便问路。

senses.english: number of people who live in a country, area, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The population of the town has grown since a new railway line made travel to the city easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 新铁路线让进城更方便后，这个城镇的人口增加了。

senses.english: to not achieve a goal, or to go wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: Even careful plans can fail if people do not understand what they are expected to do.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使计划周密，如果人们不明白自己该做什么，计划也可能失败。

senses.english: to stop working properly or become weaker
senses.exampleEnglish: The lights may fail during the repairs, so the staff have prepared torches and clearly marked the exits.
senses.exampleChinese: 维修期间照明可能失灵，所以工作人员准备了手电筒，并清楚标出了出口。

senses.english: natural world in which plants and animals live
senses.exampleEnglish: The students studied how plastic waste affects the environment before suggesting ways to reduce it at school.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们先研究塑料废弃物如何影响环境，然后提出在学校减少塑料垃圾的方法。

senses.english: the conditions or surroundings in which someone lives or works
senses.exampleEnglish: A quiet learning environment can help students concentrate, particularly when they are trying to understand unfamiliar information.
senses.exampleChinese: 安静的学习环境有助于学生专注，尤其是在理解陌生信息时。

senses.english: process of making something on a large scale
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory reduced production during the winter because fewer customers were ordering its outdoor furniture than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 工厂在冬季减少了生产，因为订购户外家具的顾客比平时少。

senses.english: a play, film, or show prepared for an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: The school production involved students from several year groups, who helped with costumes as well as performing.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场学校演出涉及几个年级的学生，他们不仅表演，也帮忙准备服装。

senses.english: legal agreement (e.g., for doing work for money)
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the contract carefully before signing, especially the section that explains when either side can end the agreement.
senses.exampleChinese: 签字前仔细阅读合同，尤其是说明任何一方何时能终止协议的部分。

senses.english: to become smaller or cause something to become smaller
senses.exampleEnglish: Some materials contract as they cool, so the builders leave small gaps that allow the frame to move.
senses.exampleChinese: 一些材料冷却时会收缩，因此建筑工人留了小缝，让框架能活动。

senses.english: to become infected with a disease
senses.exampleEnglish: The report explains how people can contract the illness, but it does not replace advice from a qualified doctor.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告解释人们如何感染这种病，但不能替代专业医生的建议。

senses.english: to make a formal agreement to do work or provide something
senses.exampleEnglish: The council will contract a local firm to repair the roof while volunteers repaint the rooms inside.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者粉刷室内时，市政委员会将与一家本地公司签约修屋顶。

senses.english: person who plays sports
senses.exampleEnglish: Every player on the team helped defend the goal when their opponents attacked in the final minutes.
senses.exampleChinese: 对手在最后几分钟进攻时，队里每位球员都参与防守球门。

senses.english: someone who plays a musical instrument
senses.exampleEnglish: The youngest violin player joined the rehearsal early so that she could practise the difficult passage with the conductor.
senses.exampleChinese: 最年轻的小提琴手提早参加排练，以便和指挥一起练习难段。

senses.english: a device or program for playing recorded sound or video
senses.exampleEnglish: The old music player still works, although we need an adaptor to connect it to the new speakers.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧音乐播放器仍能用，不过连接新音箱需要转接器。

senses.english: a person or organization involved in an important activity or market
senses.exampleEnglish: The small firm has become a major player in local transport by providing routes that larger companies had ignored.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家小公司提供大企业忽视的线路，成了当地交通的重要参与者。

senses.english: something you say; give an opinion; remark
senses.exampleEnglish: Her comment about the confusing map led us to add clearer directions to the information sheet.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对地图难以看懂的评论，促使我们在信息表上添加了更清楚的指引。

senses.english: to express an opinion or make a remark
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can comment on the plans before the council decides whether the new building should be approved.
senses.exampleChinese: 市政委员会决定是否批准新建筑前，访客可以对规划发表意见。

senses.english: to go into a room
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors must show their tickets before they enter the building, even if they have already booked online.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客进入大楼前必须出示门票，即使已经在线预订。

senses.english: to join a competition or similar event
senses.exampleEnglish: You can enter the competition online, but your design must reach the organisers before the closing date.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以网上报名参赛，但设计必须在截止日期前送达组织方。

senses.english: to put information into a computer or written record
senses.exampleEnglish: Please enter your name exactly as it appears on your ticket so that the booking can be found quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 请按票面准确输入姓名，方便快速找到预订。

senses.english: to come to pass or to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Small delays often occur at this station because trains from several different routes share the same platforms.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个车站经常出现小幅延误，因为几条不同线路的火车共用站台。

senses.english: without anyone or anything else
senses.exampleEnglish: Although she travelled alone, she met several friendly people who were following the same walking route.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然她独自旅行，却结识了几位走同一条徒步路线的友好旅伴。

senses.english: not with other people
senses.exampleEnglish: She was alone in the classroom when the caretaker arrived to check whether anyone still needed the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 管理员前来查看是否还有人使用教室时，里面只有她一人。

senses.english: used to emphasize that one thing is sufficient or excluded from others
senses.exampleEnglish: The entrance fee alone would use most of our budget, so we looked for a cheaper activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 仅入场费就会花掉大部分预算，所以我们找了更便宜的活动。

senses.english: large enough to be noticed or have an effect; important
senses.exampleEnglish: The new crossing has made a significant difference to families who walk to school along this road.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的人行横道给沿这条路步行上学的家庭带来了明显改变。

senses.english: chemical used as a medicine
senses.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains how the drug should be stored, so the pharmacist asked her to read it carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明书解释了这种药物该如何保存，因此药剂师让她仔细阅读。

senses.english: a substance used illegally to change feelings or awareness
senses.exampleEnglish: The youth centre offers clear information about drugs and provides a safe place for teenagers to ask questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 青年中心提供清楚的毒品相关信息，也给青少年一个安全提问的场所。

senses.english: to give a person or animal a substance that changes their condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The vet may drug the animal briefly so that the injured leg can be examined without causing more distress.
senses.exampleChinese: 兽医可能给动物短时用药，以便检查受伤腿部而不增加痛苦。

senses.english: high, flat side of a room or building
senses.exampleEnglish: We hung the map on the wall where everyone could see it while discussing the next day's route.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把地图挂在人人都能看见的墙上，讨论第二天的路线。

senses.english: number of things that happen one after another
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum is holding a series of evening talks about how the city developed over the centuries.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆正在举办一系列晚间讲座，介绍这座城市几个世纪以来的发展。

senses.english: to tell someone to do something in a straight-talking way
