senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will direct visitors towards the side entrance while workers repair the steps outside the main door.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作人员维修正门外的台阶时，导游会引导游客走向侧门。

senses.english: to be responsible for how a film or play is performed
senses.exampleEnglish: A former student will direct the play, while the teachers help younger children prepare costumes and scenery.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位校友将执导这出戏，老师们则帮助年幼学生准备服装和布景。

senses.english: going straight to a place without intermediate stops or connections
senses.exampleEnglish: There is no direct bus to the village on Sundays, so we need to change in the town centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 周日没有直达村庄的公交，所以我们要在镇中心换车。

senses.english: clear and honest without avoiding the point
senses.exampleEnglish: Her direct question helped the group understand the problem that everyone had been trying not to mention.
senses.exampleChinese: 她直截了当的问题，帮助团队认识到大家一直回避提及的难题。

senses.english: straight to a place without stopping or changing
senses.exampleEnglish: The new train travels direct to the airport, which makes early flights easier for families without a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 新列车直达机场，让没车的家庭更容易赶早班航班。

senses.english: achievement of a desired purpose or goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The success of the event depended on volunteers who worked quietly behind the scenes for several weeks.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动的成功依赖于那些连续几周在幕后默默工作的志愿者。

senses.english: day after today
senses.exampleEnglish: We will decide tomorrow whether to continue with the walk, once we have checked the latest weather forecast.
senses.exampleChinese: 明天查看最新天气预报后，我们将决定是否继续徒步。

senses.english: the day after today, or the future more generally
senses.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow will be our last chance to visit the exhibition before the paintings return to their owners.
senses.exampleChinese: 明天是画作归还主人前，我们参观展览的最后机会。

senses.english: senior person who manages part of an organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The director of the museum explained why some rooms would remain closed until the repairs were complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆馆长解释了为什么有些房间要等维修完成后才开放。

senses.english: the person responsible for how a film or play is made
senses.exampleEnglish: The director asked the actors to repeat the scene because the afternoon light had changed during filming.
senses.exampleChinese: 导演请演员重拍那场戏，因为拍摄过程中午后光线变了。

senses.english: in a way that is easy to understand; obviously
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions clearly state that children must be accompanied by an adult when using the climbing wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明清楚地写明，儿童使用攀岩墙时必须有成人陪同。

senses.english: to not have, or not have enough, of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Some villages lack regular bus services, which makes it difficult for residents without cars to reach the hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 有些村庄缺乏固定的公交服务，使没有汽车的居民很难去医院。

senses.english: not having enough of something
senses.exampleEnglish: A lack of clear signs made the station confusing for visitors who did not know the area.
senses.exampleChinese: 缺乏明确标牌，让不熟悉该地区的游客在车站感到困惑。

senses.english: to carefully look at the quality of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We will review the arrangements after the first month to see whether the new opening hours are working well.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一个月结束后，我们会评估安排，看看新的开放时间效果如何。

senses.english: an opinion or article evaluating a book, product, or performance
senses.exampleEnglish: The review praised the actors but suggested that the second half of the play was longer than necessary.
senses.exampleChinese: 评论赞赏演员表现，但认为戏剧后半段过长。

senses.english: a careful examination of something to consider changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The timetable is under review because several families have said the last bus leaves before school activities finish.
senses.exampleChinese: 几家人表示末班公交早于学校活动结束，所以时间表正在重新审查。

senses.english: to describe and judge a book, product, or performance
senses.exampleEnglish: She was asked to review the new exhibition for the local newspaper after attending its opening evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 参加开幕晚会后，她受邀为当地报纸评论新展览。

senses.english: to study material again to remember or understand it better
senses.exampleEnglish: We will review the main ideas tomorrow before trying a new activity that builds on what we learned.
senses.exampleChinese: 明天尝试基于已学知识的新活动前，我们会复习主要概念。

senses.english: to need (someone or something) for support, help, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Whether we can hold the concert outdoors will depend on how quickly the field dries after the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会能否在户外举行，将取决于雨后场地有多快干燥。

senses.english: to be decided or affected by something
senses.exampleEnglish: The cost will depend on how many people attend and whether we need to hire extra equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用将取决于参加人数，以及是否需要额外租器材。

senses.english: contest between people, animals, or vehicles, to determine which is the fastest
senses.exampleEnglish: The race was postponed because strong winds made the final section of the course unsafe for runners.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于大风使赛道最后一段对跑者不安全，比赛延期了。

senses.english: a large group of people linked by shared ancestry or perceived features
senses.exampleEnglish: The school welcomes families of every race and works to ensure that all children feel equally included.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校欢迎所有种族的家庭，并努力确保每个孩子都感到同样受到接纳。

senses.english: to compete to see who is fastest
senses.exampleEnglish: The children will race across the field after the instructor has checked that the ground is safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练检查地面安全后，孩子们会穿过田野赛跑。

senses.english: to move or work very quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to race back to the station when we realised that the last train left earlier on Sundays.
senses.exampleChinese: 意识到周日末班火车更早后，我们不得不赶回车站。

senses.english: to remember because you have met it before
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not recognize my old classmate at first because we had not seen each other for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 我起初没有认出老同学，因为我们已多年未见。

senses.english: to accept that something is true, important, or officially valid
senses.exampleEnglish: The report should recognize the volunteers' contribution rather than suggesting that the organisers did all the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告应该认可志愿者的贡献，而不是暗示所有工作都由组织者完成。

senses.english: opening in a wall or door to let in light
senses.exampleEnglish: We opened the window slightly so that fresh air could enter without making the classroom too cold.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把窗户稍微打开，让新鲜空气进来，同时不让教室太冷。

senses.english: a separate area on a computer screen showing a document or program
senses.exampleEnglish: Open the map in another window so that you can compare the route with the written instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 在另一个窗口打开地图，方便把路线与文字说明对照。

senses.english: reason for which something is done; aim; goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The purpose of the meeting is to hear residents' concerns before the council makes its final decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议的目的是在市政委员会做出最终决定前，听取居民的担忧。

senses.english: division of a larger part or organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The science department has borrowed equipment from a nearby college so that students can try more experiments.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学系向附近一所学院借了设备，让学生能尝试更多实验。

senses.english: (v) to get (n) something wanted, needed, or valued
senses.exampleEnglish: Volunteering at the centre helped her gain experience that later proved useful when she applied for work.
senses.exampleChinese: 在中心做志愿服务帮助她积累了经验，后来申请工作时证明这些经验很有用。

senses.english: an increase or benefit obtained
senses.exampleEnglish: The small gain in time was not worth the extra cost of taking a taxi across town.
senses.exampleChinese: 穿城乘出租车节省的那点时间，不值得额外花费。

senses.english: to increase in amount, speed, weight, or strength
senses.exampleEnglish: The bicycle began to gain speed on the hill, so she used the brakes before reaching the bend.
senses.exampleChinese: 自行车下坡时开始加速，所以她在弯道前用了刹车。

senses.english: tall green plants in a forest
senses.exampleEnglish: The tree outside our kitchen window provides shade in summer, but its leaves block the gutter every autumn.
senses.exampleChinese: 厨房窗外的树在夏天提供荫凉，但每到秋天树叶就会堵住排水槽。

senses.english: school or educational institution for adults
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a college close to home because it offered the practical course she wanted to study.
senses.exampleChinese: 她选了一所离家近的学院，因为那里有她想读的实践课程。

senses.english: to give reasons for or against an idea or point of view
senses.exampleEnglish: Some residents argue that the new playground should include equipment suitable for older children as well.
senses.exampleChinese: 一些居民主张，新游乐场还应配备适合年龄较大孩子的设施。

senses.english: to disagree angrily with someone
senses.exampleEnglish: They began to argue about who should carry the equipment until the teacher suggested sharing the heavier bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们为谁搬器材争吵起来，直到老师建议分担重包。

senses.english: surface for posting or showing information
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice on the board explains which rooms are available and who to contact about booking them.
senses.exampleChinese: 公告板上的通知说明了哪些房间可用，以及预订时该联系谁。

senses.english: a group of people who control an organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The board will decide whether to extend the opening hours after hearing feedback from staff and visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 理事会将听取员工和访客反馈后，决定是否延长开放时间。

senses.english: to get onto a bus, train, plane, or ship
senses.exampleEnglish: Passengers should board the train through the doors nearest their seat numbers so that the platform clears quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 乘客应从靠近座位号的车门上车，让站台尽快畅通。

senses.english: meals supplied as part of accommodation
senses.exampleEnglish: The fee includes room and board, but students need their own money for travel and weekend activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用含住宿和伙食，但学生须自付交通和周末活动费用。

senses.english: day when people don't go to work or school
senses.exampleEnglish: We are planning a holiday in the mountains, where we can walk without using the car every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计划去山里度假，那里可以徒步，不必每天开车。

senses.english: to make or leave a visible sign on something; a writing symbol
senses.exampleEnglish: Please mark any errors you find in pencil so that the writer can correct them before printing.
senses.exampleChinese: 请用铅笔标出发现的错误，方便作者在打印前改正。

senses.english: a visible spot or symbol
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a dark mark on the wall where the old notice board had hung for many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 老公告板挂了多年的墙面上，留着一道深色痕迹。

senses.english: a score given for work or an examination
senses.exampleEnglish: Her final mark improved after she learned to read the questions carefully before writing down her answers.
senses.exampleChinese: 学会仔细读题再作答后，她的最终成绩提高了。

senses.english: to judge and give a score to work
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will mark the first exercise before asking students to correct their mistakes in a different colour.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师会先批改第一道练习，再请学生用另一种颜色订正。

senses.english: to celebrate or indicate an important event or time
senses.exampleEnglish: The village will mark the library's anniversary with a display of photographs showing how the building has changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 村庄会展出建筑变迁照片，纪念图书馆周年。

senses.english: building where religious people gather and pray
senses.exampleEnglish: The old church is open to visitors on weekdays, although services take place there every Sunday morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座老教堂工作日对游客开放，不过每周日早晨那里都会举行礼拜。

senses.english: an organized Christian religious community
senses.exampleEnglish: The church helped organise meals for residents after the storm damaged several kitchens in the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨损坏村里几户厨房后，教会帮忙为居民安排餐食。

senses.english: piece of equipment used to do work
senses.exampleEnglish: The machine stops automatically if the cover is opened, which prevents people from touching the moving parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果盖子被打开，机器就会自动停止，以防人们触碰活动部件。

senses.english: to succeed in doing something good, usually by working hard
senses.exampleEnglish: She worked steadily towards her goal and managed to achieve it earlier than anyone had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 她稳步朝目标努力，设法比所有人预想的更早实现了它。

senses.english: distinct, individual thing, often part of a group
senses.exampleEnglish: Each item on the list must be checked before the boxes are loaded onto the delivery van.
senses.exampleChinese: 在把箱子装上送货车前，清单上的每件物品都必须核对。

senses.english: to demonstrate truth by providing evidence
senses.exampleEnglish: The experiment helped prove that the amount of light affected how quickly the young plants grew.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次实验有助于证明，光照量影响了幼苗的生长速度。

senses.english: to be found to have a particular quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The spare map proved useful when our phones lost signal near the woods and we needed another route.
senses.exampleChinese: 手机在树林附近失去信号、我们需要另一条路线时，备用地图证明很有用。

senses.english: 100th of the basic unit of money (e.g., there are 100 of these in a dollar)
senses.exampleEnglish: The children saved every cent they earned because they wanted to buy equipment for their school garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们把挣来的每一分钱都存起来，因为他们想为学校花园买工具。

senses.english: one of the four parts of the year determined mainly by the weather during that time
senses.exampleEnglish: Spring is the best season to visit the valley because the paths are quiet and the flowers are blooming.
senses.exampleChinese: 春季是游览山谷的最佳季节，因为小路安静，鲜花盛开。

senses.english: a period when a particular activity happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The walking season starts later in the mountains because snow can remain on the higher paths until spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 山区徒步季开始较晚，因为高处小路上的积雪可能一直留到春天。

senses.english: to add salt, herbs, or spices to food
senses.exampleEnglish: Taste the soup before you season it, because the stock may already contain enough salt for the recipe.
senses.exampleChinese: 给汤调味前先尝尝，因为高汤可能已含食谱所需的盐。

senses.english: part of a room on which you stand
senses.exampleEnglish: We covered the floor before painting the ceiling so that any falling paint would not damage the wood.
senses.exampleChinese: 刷天花板前，我们盖住地板，防止滴落的油漆损坏木材。

senses.english: one level in a building
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition is on the second floor, but visitors who cannot use the stairs can take the lift.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览在二楼，不能走楼梯的访客可以乘电梯。

senses.english: generic description for things, materials, objects
senses.exampleEnglish: We packed all the camping stuff into the car before checking whether there was room for our bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把所有露营用品装进车里后，才检查行李包是否还有地方放。

senses.english: to fill something tightly or put something in roughly
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not stuff the books into the bag, because bending the covers could damage the pages inside.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要把书硬塞进包里，因为折弯封面可能损坏内页。

senses.english: having a great distance from one side to the other
senses.exampleEnglish: The doorway is wide enough for a wheelchair, although the short ramp outside still needs repairing.
senses.exampleChinese: 门口足够宽，能让轮椅通过，不过外面那段短坡道仍需维修。

senses.english: any person
senses.exampleEnglish: If anyone needs help with the application, a volunteer will be available at the library this afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果有人需要填写申请方面的帮助，今天下午图书馆会有一名志愿者提供协助。

senses.english: organized and planned way of doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher demonstrated a method for checking calculations that did not require us to use a calculator.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师演示了一种不需要计算器的计算结果检查方法。

senses.english: careful study to better understand something
senses.exampleEnglish: Our analysis of the survey showed that most visitors wanted more information about the walking routes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们对调查的分析表明，大多数游客希望得到更多步行路线信息。

senses.english: process of choosing someone by voting
senses.exampleEnglish: Candidates visited local schools before the election to explain how they would improve services for young people.
senses.exampleChinese: 选举前，候选人走访当地学校，说明他们将如何改善面向年轻人的服务。

senses.english: the armed forces of a country
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how the military helped build roads that later became important routes for local trade.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆解释了军队如何帮助修建道路，而这些道路后来成了当地贸易的重要路线。

senses.english: relating to a country's armed forces
senses.exampleEnglish: The old military road is now a walking route, although some original stone markers remain beside the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧军用道路如今成了徒步路线，不过路旁仍留着一些原始石标。

senses.english: place where people can stay when traveling
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a hotel near the station so that we would not need a taxi after arriving late.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了车站附近的酒店，以便晚到时不必叫出租车。

senses.english: group of people who share an interest, as in sport
senses.exampleEnglish: The club welcomes beginners and provides equipment for people who want to try the sport before buying their own.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部欢迎初学者，并为想先尝试运动再购买自用器材的人提供设备。

senses.english: a place where people go to dance or hear music
senses.exampleEnglish: The club moved its live music events earlier so that visitors could still catch the last train home.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐俱乐部把现场演出提前，让访客还能赶上末班火车回家。

senses.english: a heavy stick used in a sport or as a weapon
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor showed us how to hold the golf club before anyone tried hitting a ball towards the practice net.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家试着向练习网击球前，教练教了我们如何握高尔夫球杆。

senses.english: in a lower position, place, or level
senses.exampleEnglish: The temperature dropped below freezing during the night, so the paths were still icy in the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜间气温降到冰点以下，所以早晨小路上仍然结着冰。

senses.english: lower than a place, level, or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The shelves below the window are easier for children to reach without standing on chairs or asking for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗户下方的架子让孩子更容易够到，不必站在椅子上或求人帮忙。

senses.english: motion picture; film
senses.exampleEnglish: The movie follows a family who move to a new country and gradually learn to feel at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部电影讲述一个家庭移居异国并逐渐找到归属感的故事。

senses.english: a professional who is trained and licensed to treat sick or injured people; a person who has the highest degree given by a university
senses.exampleEnglish: The doctor asked several questions about her daily routine before suggesting that she keep a sleep diary.
senses.exampleChinese: 医生问了几个关于她日常作息的问题，然后建议她记录睡眠日记。

senses.english: to alter information dishonestly to deceive people
senses.exampleEnglish: The investigation found that someone had tried to doctor the photographs so that the damage would appear less serious.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查发现有人试图篡改照片，让损坏看起来没那么严重。

senses.english: any long communication about some particular topic
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion became more useful once everyone had a chance to describe the problems they were facing.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都有机会描述自己面临的问题之后，讨论变得更有帮助了。

senses.english: what you say to admit you were wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: I am sorry that we kept you waiting, but the earlier meeting took longer than we expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 很抱歉让你久等了，但之前的会议比我们预计的更长。

senses.english: feeling sadness, sympathy, or regret
senses.exampleEnglish: I was sorry to hear that the course had been cancelled, especially after everyone had prepared so carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 听说课程取消了，我很遗憾，尤其是大家都准备得那么仔细。

senses.english: an activity you wish to try that may be hard to do
senses.exampleEnglish: Designing a bridge from paper was a challenge that encouraged the students to test several different ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 用纸设计一座桥是一项挑战，鼓励了学生们测试多种不同想法。

senses.english: a demand that someone prove or justify something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her challenge to the decision made the committee explain why it had rejected the residents' preferred design.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对决定的质疑，促使委员会解释为何否决居民更喜欢的设计。

senses.english: to test someone's ability or invite them to compete
senses.exampleEnglish: The activity will challenge older students without making beginners feel that they have no useful part to play.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项活动会考验年长学生，又不让初学者觉得自己毫无作用。

senses.english: to question whether something is right or true
senses.exampleEnglish: The students were encouraged to challenge the explanation if they could suggest evidence that supported another idea.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果能提出支持其他观点的证据，学生们就被鼓励质疑这个解释。

senses.english: area or region controlled by a government and army
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival brings together performers from across the nation to celebrate music that is rarely heard elsewhere.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个节日汇聚了全国的表演者，庆祝在其他地方很少听到的音乐。

senses.english: not completely; almost
senses.exampleEnglish: We had nearly finished packing when we discovered that one of the bags was too heavy to carry.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们快打包完时，才发现其中一个包重得搬不动。

senses.english: act or process of saying something formally
senses.exampleEnglish: The council released a statement explaining why the bridge would remain closed until engineers completed their checks.
senses.exampleChinese: 市政委员会发表声明，解释为什么桥梁要等工程师完成检查后才会开放。

senses.english: a document showing payments or the state of an account
senses.exampleEnglish: She checked her bank statement before contacting the shop about a payment that appeared twice on the same day.
senses.exampleChinese: 她核查银行对账单后，就同一天出现两次的付款联系了商店。

senses.english: to join or connect together
senses.exampleEnglish: The new cycle path will link the station to the park, making the journey easier for local families.
senses.exampleChinese: 新自行车道将连接车站和公园，让当地家庭出行更方便。

senses.english: a connection between people, places, or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey found a link between clearer instructions and fewer mistakes, although more research is needed to explain it.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查发现说明更清楚与错误更少有关联，不过仍需更多研究解释。

senses.english: a clickable connection to another online page or resource
senses.exampleEnglish: The email contains a link to the booking page, where you can choose a date and check the price.
senses.exampleChinese: 电子邮件包含预订页链接，你可以在那里选日期并核查价格。

senses.english: without being affected by something; in spite of
senses.exampleEnglish: Despite the heavy rain, the volunteers arrived on time and helped move the equipment into the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管下着大雨，志愿者们仍准时赶到，帮忙把设备搬进大厅。

senses.english: to make someone known to another by name
senses.exampleEnglish: Before we begin the workshop, I would like to introduce the people who will be helping us today.
senses.exampleChinese: 在工作坊开始前，我想介绍一下今天将协助我们的几位工作人员。

senses.english: to bring something into use for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: The library will introduce longer opening hours if the trial shows that enough residents would use the extra time.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果试行表明足够多居民会利用额外时段，图书馆就会推行更长开放时间。

senses.english: to present a topic or explain it for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: The first lesson will introduce the main ideas before students try the practical tasks in small groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一课会先介绍主要概念，再让学生分小组尝试实践任务。

senses.english: thing making the chance of success higher
senses.exampleEnglish: One advantage of living near the station is that we can reach the city without driving.
senses.exampleChinese: 住在车站附近的一个好处是，我们不开车也能进城。

senses.english: prepared to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please have your tickets ready before you reach the entrance, so that everyone can get inside quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 到达入口前请准备好门票，方便大家快速入场。

senses.english: to become the husband or wife of someone
senses.exampleEnglish: They decided to marry in the village where they first met, although neither of them lived there anymore.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们决定在初次见面的村庄结婚，尽管两人都已不再住在那里。

senses.english: to perform the ceremony that makes two people spouses
senses.exampleEnglish: The couple asked the same minister to marry them who had conducted the ceremony for their parents years earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 这对伴侣请多年前为父母主持婚礼的同一位牧师为他们证婚。

senses.english: to hit something
senses.exampleEnglish: A loose branch could strike the window during the storm, so we moved the table away from the glass.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨中，一根松动的树枝可能撞上窗户，所以我们把桌子移离了玻璃。

senses.english: to happen suddenly and cause harm or difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: The storm could strike before the visitors return, so we should contact the guide and suggest a shorter route.
senses.exampleChinese: 风暴可能在游客回来前袭来，所以应联系导游，建议走短些的路线。

senses.english: to enter your mind suddenly or make an impression
senses.exampleEnglish: It did not strike me as unusual until I realised that every other house on the street was empty.
senses.exampleChinese: 起初我不觉得奇怪，直到发现街上其他房子都空着。

senses.english: to stop work together in order to demand changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The workers voted to strike after several meetings failed to resolve their concerns about changing shifts without notice.
senses.exampleChinese: 多次会议未解决临时换班的担忧后，工人们投票决定罢工。

senses.english: a collective refusal to work in order to demand changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The rail strike meant that many families had to change their travel plans for the holiday weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 铁路罢工使许多家庭不得不更改假日周末的出行计划。

senses.english: unit of distance; 1.6 kilometers
senses.exampleEnglish: The nearest shop is over a mile away, so we usually buy everything we need in one visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 最近的商店有一英里多远，所以我们通常一次买齐所需物品。

senses.english: to search for; to try to find; look for
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers will seek advice from local residents before deciding where the new playground should be built.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者将在决定新游乐场建在哪里之前，向当地居民征求意见。

senses.english: power, money, knowledge, or skill to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her ability to explain complicated ideas clearly made the training session useful for people with little experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 她能清楚解释复杂概念，这让经验不多的人也能从培训中受益。

senses.english: single thing or person; a part of something larger
senses.exampleEnglish: Each unit in the course builds on the previous one, so it is worth completing them in order.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程的每个单元都建立在前一个单元的基础上，因此值得按顺序完成。

senses.english: a standard amount used to measure something
senses.exampleEnglish: Make sure both measurements use the same unit before comparing them, otherwise the result could be misleading.
senses.exampleChinese: 比较前要确保两个测量值使用同一单位，否则结果可能误导。

senses.english: small piece of paper or plastic used as i.d.
senses.exampleEnglish: You must show your membership card at the desk before borrowing equipment from the sports centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 在体育中心借用器材前，你必须在服务台出示会员卡。

senses.english: one piece in a set used for a game
senses.exampleEnglish: Each player takes a card before deciding whether to keep it or exchange it for another one.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位玩家拿一张牌，再决定保留还是换一张。

senses.english: a piece of stiff paper carrying a greeting or message
senses.exampleEnglish: The class made a card for their former teacher, who was leaving the school after many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 全班为在校任教多年、即将离开的老师做了一张贺卡。

senses.english: building for sick people, with doctors and nurses
senses.exampleEnglish: The hospital opened a new entrance so that visitors could reach the children's ward more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家医院开设了一个新入口，让访客能更容易到达儿科病房。

senses.english: without taking a lot of time; fast
senses.exampleEnglish: We moved the chairs quickly when the rain started, but managed to keep most of the cushions dry.
senses.exampleChinese: 下雨时我们迅速搬走了椅子，设法让大多数坐垫没有淋湿。

senses.english: to formally ask questions about a given topic
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will interview older residents to discover how the town has changed since they were young.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们将采访年长居民，了解这个城镇自他们年轻时起发生了哪些变化。

senses.english: a formal conversation to ask questions for a job or information
senses.exampleEnglish: The interview gave her a chance to explain how her experience would help the team develop its training programme.
senses.exampleChinese: 面试让她有机会说明，她的经验将如何帮助团队开发培训项目。

senses.english: when you share the same opinion or reach a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: We reached an agreement on the route after everyone explained which places they most wanted to visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人说明自己最想游览哪些地方后，我们就路线达成了一致。

senses.english: a formal arrangement accepted by two or more sides
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement allows local groups to use the hall free of charge if they clean it afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议允许本地团体免费使用礼堂，前提是事后打扫干净。

senses.english: to allow to leave jail, cage, prison, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The rescue centre will release the bird once its wing has healed and it can fly safely again.
senses.exampleChinese: 等鸟的翅膀痊愈、能够再次安全飞行后，救助中心就会放归它。

senses.english: to make a film, recording, product, or information available
senses.exampleEnglish: The band will release its new album next month, after sharing two songs with listeners online first.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐队先在网上分享两首歌，下个月再发行新专辑。

senses.english: to let a substance, pressure, or energy escape
senses.exampleEnglish: Opening the valve will release some pressure, but only trained staff should carry out this part of the inspection.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开阀门会释放一些压力，不过这部分检查只能由受训人员进行。

senses.english: a product, recording, or version newly made available
senses.exampleEnglish: The latest release includes clearer menus and a way to keep your settings when the device is offline.
senses.exampleChinese: 最新版本增加了更清楚的菜单，并能在设备离线时保留设置。

senses.english: the act of letting someone or something go free
senses.exampleEnglish: The bird's release was delayed until the rescue team was sure it could find food and fly safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 救助团队确认鸟能觅食并安全飞行后，才安排放归。

senses.english: money taken by a government from its people
senses.exampleEnglish: The price on the label includes tax, so you will not pay anything extra at the checkout.
senses.exampleChinese: 标签上的价格含税，所以结账时不用再额外支付。

senses.english: to require a tax to be paid on something
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal would tax certain products more heavily, although supporters disagree about how the extra money should be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案会对某些产品征更高的税，不过支持者对新增收入用途意见不一。

senses.english: something that ends a problem
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a solution that allowed both groups to use the hall without changing their regular meeting times.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们找到一个解决办法，让两个小组都能使用大厅，而不用改变各自固定的会面时间。

senses.english: a liquid in which another substance has dissolved
senses.exampleEnglish: The students mixed a salt solution before comparing how quickly it evaporated in warm and cool places.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们先配制盐溶液，再比较它在温暖与凉爽处蒸发的速度。

senses.english: very important or serious; a formal use
senses.exampleEnglish: The capital city attracts visitors throughout the year, although many prefer to explore its quieter neighbourhoods in spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座首都全年都吸引着游客，不过许多人更喜欢在春天探索其较安静的街区。

senses.english: the main city where a government is based
senses.exampleEnglish: The capital is busy throughout the year, but smaller towns often offer a quieter way to discover the country.
senses.exampleChinese: 首都全年繁忙，不过小城镇通常能让人更安静地了解这个国家。

senses.english: money or other assets used to start or support a business
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe needed more capital before it could replace the old equipment and employ another member of staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆要先获得更多资金，才能更换旧设备、再雇一位员工。

senses.english: an uppercase letter
senses.exampleEnglish: Write your name in capitals if the instructions ask for it, so that the letters are easy to read.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果说明要求，请用大写字母写姓名，方便辨认。

senses.english: liked or enjoyed by many people
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe has become popular with students because it provides quiet tables and stays open until late.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家咖啡馆提供安静的桌位并营业至深夜，因此很受学生欢迎。

senses.english: intended for ordinary people rather than specialists
senses.exampleEnglish: The popular science magazine explains recent discoveries using examples that readers can connect with everyday experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本大众科学杂志用能联系日常经验的例子解释新发现。

senses.english: special or particular; clearly presented or stated
senses.exampleEnglish: Please give a specific example when you explain the problem, so that we know what needs changing.
senses.exampleChinese: 解释问题时请举出具体例子，以便我们知道需要改变什么。

senses.english: having very attractive or appealing physical qualities
senses.exampleEnglish: The garden is especially beautiful in early spring, when flowers appear beneath the trees beside the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 早春时，湖边树下开出鲜花，花园格外美丽。

senses.english: unpleasant feeling caused by being aware of danger
senses.exampleEnglish: Her fear of deep water gradually decreased after she practised swimming with an instructor she trusted.
senses.exampleChinese: 她跟随信任的教练练习游泳后，对深水的恐惧逐渐减轻了。

senses.english: to feel afraid of something or worry it may happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents fear that the new road will make traffic faster without providing a safe place for children to cross.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民担心新路会使车速更快，却没有给孩子提供安全过路处。

senses.english: the act or ability of directing something towards a target
senses.exampleEnglish: His aim improved after the coach showed him how to hold the bow without moving his shoulders.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练教他如何在不移动肩膀的情况下持弓后，他瞄得更准了。

senses.english: something you hope or plan to achieve
senses.exampleEnglish: The main aim of the workshop is to help beginners feel confident enough to repair simple things themselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊主要目标是让初学者有信心自己修理简单物品。

senses.english: to intend or plan to achieve something
senses.exampleEnglish: We aim to finish the repairs before the school holidays, when the hall will be needed for daily activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们打算在学校假期前修好，因为届时礼堂每天都要用于活动。

senses.english: to point something towards a target
senses.exampleEnglish: Aim the torch towards the path rather than into people's eyes, especially when they are coming downhill.
senses.exampleChinese: 把手电筒照向小路，不要照别人眼睛，特别是对方下坡时。

senses.english: device that broadcasts programs, movies, or show
senses.exampleEnglish: We turned off the television during dinner so that everyone could talk about what had happened that day.
senses.exampleChinese: 吃晚饭时我们关掉电视，让大家都能聊聊当天发生的事。

senses.english: needing thought or concentration; important; in a sober manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The shortage of water became a serious problem after the region went several weeks without rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个地区连续数周没有下雨后，缺水成了一个严重问题。

senses.english: sincere and not joking
senses.exampleEnglish: I thought she was joking about moving abroad, but she was serious and had already applied for a job.
senses.exampleChinese: 我以为她说移居国外是玩笑，但她是认真的，已申请了工作。

senses.english: a goal or amount you are trying to achieve
senses.exampleEnglish: The team reached its target earlier than expected, so it decided to spend more time checking the quality.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队比预期更早达到目标，于是决定花更多时间检查质量。

senses.english: a person or thing that an action is directed towards
senses.exampleEnglish: The bright target was easy to see from a distance, but hitting its centre still required careful practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 远处很容易看见明亮靶子，但击中靶心仍需认真练习。

senses.english: to direct an activity towards a particular person or group
senses.exampleEnglish: The new course will target beginners who want practical experience rather than people preparing for advanced examinations.
senses.exampleChinese: 新课程面向想要实践经验的初学者，而不是准备高级考试的人。

senses.english: unit for measuring temperature or angles
senses.exampleEnglish: Even a difference of one degree can affect the results, so we checked the thermometer before each test.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使相差一度也会影响结果，所以每次测试前我们都检查温度计。

senses.english: a university qualification awarded after completing a course
senses.exampleEnglish: She studied for a degree while working part time, so she learned to organise her evenings very carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 她半工半读攻读学位，因此学会了仔细安排晚间时间。

senses.english: the amount or level of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The degree of difficulty increases gradually, so beginners can build confidence before attempting the most demanding tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 难度逐渐增加，让初学者能先建立信心，再尝试最有挑战的任务。

senses.english: to hold something and move it toward you
senses.exampleEnglish: Pull the handle gently towards you until the door opens, then keep it clear of the passing trolley.
senses.exampleChinese: 把手柄轻轻拉向自己，直到门打开，然后别让门挡住经过的手推车。

senses.english: a force that draws something or makes something attractive
senses.exampleEnglish: The pull of the current was stronger than expected, so the instructor kept everyone close to the river bank.
senses.exampleChinese: 水流拉力比预想强，所以教练让大家留在河岸附近。

senses.english: being the color of blood
senses.exampleEnglish: She tied a red ribbon around her suitcase handle so that she could recognize it at the airport.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在行李箱把手上系了一条红丝带，以便在机场认出它。

senses.english: married man
senses.exampleEnglish: Her husband offered to collect the children so that she could stay and finish the training session.
senses.exampleChinese: 她丈夫主动提出去接孩子，让她能留下来完成培训。

senses.english: an entrance to a place; a way in
senses.exampleEnglish: The building has step-free access at the side, which makes it easier for visitors using wheelchairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑侧面设有无台阶通道，方便使用轮椅的访客。

senses.english: the right or opportunity to use or obtain something
senses.exampleEnglish: The library gives students access to information that they might not be able to find freely at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆让学生获取一些在家不一定能免费找到的信息。

senses.english: to reach or use information, a service, or a place
senses.exampleEnglish: You can access the saved stories without an internet connection, provided they were downloaded before you left home.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要离家前下载过，保存的故事没有网络也能访问。

senses.english: a change in the position of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The camera detects movement near the entrance and switches on a light when someone approaches after dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 摄像头检测入口附近的移动，天黑后有人靠近时就会开灯。

senses.english: an organized effort by people sharing a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The movement began with a few neighbours who wanted safer streets and gradually gained support across the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场运动始于几个想让街道更安全的邻居，逐渐在全镇获得支持。

senses.english: one main section of a long piece of music
senses.exampleEnglish: The final movement was faster than the others, giving the concert an energetic ending that the audience clearly enjoyed.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一个乐章比其他部分更快，以充满活力、明显让观众喜欢的方式结束音乐会。

senses.english: to act in a certain way toward someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We should treat new members kindly, especially when they are unsure how the group usually works.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该友善地对待新成员，尤其是在他们还不熟悉团队惯例时。

senses.english: to give medical care to a person or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The vet will treat the injured bird before deciding whether it needs to remain at the rescue centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 兽医会先治疗受伤的鸟，再决定它是否需留在救助中心。

senses.english: to give someone something enjoyable, often by paying
senses.exampleEnglish: I would like to treat you to lunch as a thank-you for helping me move the heavy furniture.
senses.exampleChinese: 我想请你吃午饭，感谢你帮我搬重家具。

senses.english: something enjoyable that is unusual or special
senses.exampleEnglish: The boat ride was a special treat for the children, who had never seen the town from the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 乘船对从未从河上看过城镇的孩子们来说，是特别的享受。

senses.english: to indicate who or what someone or something is
senses.exampleEnglish: The labels help visitors identify the plants, even when the flowers that usually make them recognizable have disappeared.
senses.exampleChinese: 标签帮助游客辨认植物，即使那些通常用于识别的花朵已经凋谢。

collocations.chinese: 根据名字确认某人身份

senses.english: experience or state of failing to have or keep
senses.exampleEnglish: The loss of the old playground upset families who had used it regularly for many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 失去旧游乐场让多年来经常在那里活动的家庭感到难过。

senses.english: a failure to win a game or contest
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow loss disappointed the team, but the coach praised how much their passing had improved during the season.
senses.exampleChinese: 惜败让球队失望，但教练表扬了他们本赛季传球上的进步。

senses.english: expressing the future tense, to expect to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We shall send you the final details once the venue has confirmed how many people it can accommodate.
senses.exampleChinese: 场地确认可以容纳多少人之后，我们将把最终详情发送给你。

senses.chinese: 要不要；用于提议或征求意见
senses.english: used with I or we to make an offer or suggestion
senses.exampleEnglish: Shall we meet outside the station, where there is enough space for everyone to wait without blocking the entrance?
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在车站外见面好吗？那里空间足够，大家等候也不会堵入口。

senses.english: of the present time; up to date; contemporary
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum combines a modern entrance with the original building, allowing easier access without hiding its history.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆将现代入口与原有建筑结合，让出入更方便，同时保留其历史特色。

senses.english: force/weight when pressing against a thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The pressure inside the tyre was too low, so we stopped to put more air into it.
senses.exampleChinese: 轮胎内的气压太低，因此我们停下来补气。

senses.english: stress or attempts to make someone do something
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt under pressure to finish quickly, although the teacher said that understanding the method was more important.
senses.exampleChinese: 她觉得必须很快完成，压力很大，不过老师说理解方法更重要。

senses.english: to try to force someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Nobody should pressure new members into joining activities before they feel comfortable with the group and its routines.
senses.exampleChinese: 新人熟悉团队及其惯例前，不应有人逼迫他们参加活动。

senses.english: a large road vehicle used for carrying many people
senses.exampleEnglish: We caught an earlier bus because the next service would not arrive until after the museum opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们乘了更早的一班公交车，因为下一班要在博物馆开门后才到。

senses.english: to transport people by bus
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers will bus visitors from the station because the narrow road cannot safely accommodate many private cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织方会用大巴从车站接送游客，因为窄路无法安全容纳很多私家车。

senses.english: the way someone behaves towards another person
senses.exampleEnglish: Her treatment of the new volunteers made them feel welcome, even though they had little experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对待新志愿者的方式让他们感到受欢迎，尽管他们没什么经验。

senses.english: medical care for an illness or injury
senses.exampleEnglish: The doctor discussed the treatment with her carefully so that she understood what would happen at the next appointment.
senses.exampleChinese: 医生仔细与她讨论治疗，让她知道下次就诊会做什么。

senses.english: a process applied to improve or protect a material
senses.exampleEnglish: The wood needs treatment before it is used outside, where rain could damage the surface over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 木材用于户外前需要处理，因为雨水可能逐渐损坏表面。

senses.english: an event where people exchange ideas
senses.exampleEnglish: The conference brought together teachers from different countries to discuss ways of making science lessons more practical.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次会议汇聚了来自不同国家的教师，讨论如何让科学课更注重实践。

senses.english: reflexive form of 'you', used for an emphasis
senses.exampleEnglish: You can try the activity yourself after watching the demonstration, but ask for help if anything feels unsafe.
senses.exampleChinese: 看过演示后，你可以自己试试这个活动，但如果觉得哪里不安全，请寻求帮助。

senses.english: to give or sell goods to others for their use
senses.exampleEnglish: Local farms supply fresh vegetables to the school, which helps children learn where their food comes from.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地农场给学校供应新鲜蔬菜，帮助孩子们了解食物来自哪里。

senses.english: an amount of something available for use
senses.exampleEnglish: The centre keeps a supply of spare batteries because several activities depend on equipment that cannot be charged quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 中心备有备用电池，因为几项活动依赖无法迅速充电的设备。

senses.english: small town in the country
senses.exampleEnglish: The village has only one shop, but a regular bus connects it with the nearest town.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄只有一家商店，不过有固定公交连接最近的城镇。

senses.chinese: 相当于某数量或价值的东西
senses.english: an amount of something that has a particular value or lasts for a particular time
senses.exampleEnglish: She brought several days' worth of food because the nearest shop would be too far away.
senses.exampleChinese: 她带了够吃几天的食物，因为最近的商店实在太远。

senses.english: having a particular value or enough benefit to justify something
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition is worth visiting even if you have only an hour, because the main collection is clearly organised.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览即使只有一小时也值得看，因为主要藏品布置得很清楚。

senses.english: not made by humans; without human intervention
senses.exampleEnglish: The path follows the natural shape of the valley, rather than cutting directly through the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条小路顺着山谷的天然地形延伸，而不是直接穿过森林。

senses.english: normal and understandable in a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: It is natural to feel nervous before trying a new skill, especially when other people are watching.
senses.exampleChinese: 尝试新技能前感到紧张很正常，特别是有人观看时。

senses.english: existing from birth rather than learned
senses.exampleEnglish: Her natural sense of rhythm helped her learn the dance, although the complicated steps still required regular practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 天生的节奏感帮助她学舞，不过复杂舞步仍需经常练习。

senses.english: a person who is naturally good at something
senses.exampleEnglish: He is a natural at explaining machines, using simple comparisons that make the most complicated parts seem clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 他天生擅长解释机器，用简单类比把最复杂的部分讲清楚。

senses.english: to state or show what you think or how you feel
senses.exampleEnglish: She used a letter to express her thanks because she wanted the volunteers to know how much their help mattered.
senses.exampleChinese: 她用信表达谢意，因为想让志愿者知道他们的帮助有多重要。

senses.english: fast or making fewer stops than a regular service
senses.exampleEnglish: We booked the express train because the earlier service stopped at every village and took much longer.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们订了快车，因为更早那班每个村都停，耗时多得多。

senses.english: to show something, direct attention to, or point out
senses.exampleEnglish: The arrows indicate which way visitors should walk, helping to prevent crowds from blocking the narrow entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 箭头指明游客应往哪边走，有助于防止人群堵住狭窄入口。

senses.english: to be present at an event
senses.exampleEnglish: If you cannot attend the meeting in person, you can still share your suggestions by email beforehand.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果无法亲自出席会议，你仍然可以提前通过电子邮件分享建议。

senses.english: to give attention to a task, person, or problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager asked someone to attend to the visitors while she checked why their booking had not appeared in the system.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理请人接待游客，自己检查预约为何没有出现在系统中。

senses.english: a boy or man who shares a parent with you
senses.exampleEnglish: My brother offered to repair the bicycle after noticing that I was having trouble changing the gears.
senses.exampleChinese: 哥哥注意到我换挡有困难后，主动提出帮我修自行车。

senses.english: something purchased hoping its value will increase
senses.exampleEnglish: The new equipment was a considerable investment, but the cafe hoped it would reduce waste over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 新设备是一笔可观的投资，不过咖啡馆希望它能逐渐减少浪费。

senses.english: time or effort spent to obtain a future benefit
senses.exampleEnglish: The course requires a considerable investment of time, but the skills can be used in many different jobs.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程需要投入大量时间，不过所学技能可用于多种工作。

senses.english: to get points in a sport such as kicking a ball into a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Our team failed to score until the final minute, when a substitute finally found space near the goal.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们队直到最后一分钟才得分，当时一名替补终于在球门附近找到空当。

senses.english: the number of points achieved in a game or test
senses.exampleEnglish: The score stayed level until the last minute, when the youngest player finally found space near the goal.
senses.exampleChinese: 比分一直持平，直到最后一分钟，最年轻的队员终于在球门附近找到空当。

senses.english: written music showing the parts to be performed
senses.exampleEnglish: The conductor marked the score carefully so that each section knew exactly when the music should become quieter.
senses.exampleChinese: 指挥仔细标注乐谱，让各声部明确何时降低音量。

senses.english: to arrange and plan things (e.g., a party)
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to organize the equipment before the workshop starts, so that each group has everything it needs.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊开始前，我们需要整理器材，让每组都有所需物品。

senses.english: going from one place to another for fun or business
senses.exampleEnglish: The trip gave the students a chance to see how the ideas from their lessons worked in practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次旅行让学生有机会看到课堂中的知识如何在实践中运用。

senses.english: to catch your foot and almost fall, or cause this
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to trip over the cable while carrying the projector towards the table near the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 往窗边桌子搬投影仪时，小心别被电缆绊倒。

senses.english: on or to the farther side; in addition to
senses.exampleEnglish: Beyond the village, the road becomes narrower and passes through fields where visitors rarely stop to explore.
senses.exampleChinese: 过了村庄，道路变窄，穿过游客很少驻足探索的田野。

senses.english: further than a place or outside a limit
senses.exampleEnglish: The longer route goes beyond the village before turning back towards the river through a sheltered area of woodland.
senses.exampleChinese: 较长的路线穿过村庄后，还会继续前行，再经避风的林地折回河边。

senses.english: to rest your body in bed, as at night time
senses.exampleEnglish: I find it easier to sleep when the room is cool and there is no light from screens.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间凉爽、没有屏幕亮光时，我发现自己更容易入睡。

senses.english: the state or activity of sleeping
senses.exampleEnglish: A good night's sleep helped her concentrate during the workshop, which involved several hours of careful practical work.
senses.exampleChinese: 睡了一夜好觉帮助她在工作坊专注，那需要连续数小时仔细动手。

senses.english: to have room for a particular number of people to sleep
senses.exampleEnglish: The cottage can sleep six people comfortably, provided two guests are happy to share the room upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要两位客人愿意共用楼上房间，小屋就能让六个人舒适住宿。

senses.english: animal that swims and lives in the sea
senses.exampleEnglish: We saw a silver fish near the bank, where the water was clear enough to reveal the stones below.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在岸边看见了一条银色的鱼，那里的水清得能看见底下的石头。

senses.english: to try to catch fish
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors may fish in the lake during summer, but they must return certain species to the water immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客夏季可在湖里钓鱼，不过某些鱼种必须立即放回水中。

senses.english: to say you will certainly do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not promise to finish by Friday unless you are sure the materials will arrive in time.
senses.exampleChinese: 除非你确定材料会及时送达，否则请不要承诺周五前完成。

senses.english: a statement that you will certainly do something
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept her promise to help with the garden, even though the weather was much worse than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管天气比预期糟得多，她仍履行了帮忙打理花园的承诺。

senses.english: signs that someone or something may succeed
senses.exampleEnglish: The young designer showed promise during the course, especially when asked to solve problems using limited materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位年轻设计师在课程中展现潜力，尤其是被要求用有限材料解决问题时。

senses.english: capable of happening or becoming reality
senses.exampleEnglish: The plan offers potential benefits for local businesses, although residents are concerned about the extra traffic.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项计划可能给当地企业带来好处，不过居民担心增加的交通量。

senses.english: the possibility or ability to develop and succeed
senses.exampleEnglish: The empty hall has great potential as a community space once the roof is repaired and heating is installed.
senses.exampleChinese: 修好屋顶、装上暖气后，这座空礼堂很有潜力成为社区空间。

senses.english: the physical or mental strength needed to do things
senses.exampleEnglish: After a busy week at work, I rarely have the energy to cook a complicated meal on Friday evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 忙碌地工作一周后，周五晚上我很少有精力做复杂的饭菜。

senses.english: (v) to cause (n) difficulty, worry, or bother to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We had trouble finding the entrance because the sign was hidden behind a large delivery van.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们很难找到入口，因为标牌被一辆大型送货车挡住了。

senses.english: to worry someone or cause inconvenience
senses.exampleEnglish: I do not want to trouble you during the meeting, but the visitors cannot find their booking details.
senses.exampleChinese: 我不想在开会时打扰你，不过访客找不到预订信息。

senses.english: manner in which people, groups, or countries behave toward one another
senses.exampleEnglish: The relation between the two groups improved after they began working together on the village garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个团体开始合作打理村庄花园之后，彼此关系改善了。

senses.english: a connection between things
senses.exampleEnglish: We studied the relation between sunlight and plant growth by keeping the other conditions as similar as possible.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们尽量保持其他条件相近，研究光照与植物生长的关系。

senses.english: a member of someone's family
senses.exampleEnglish: A distant relation offered to show us around the village where several generations of our family had lived.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位远亲提出带我们参观家族几代人生活过的村庄。

senses.english: to feel an object with your fingers, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not touch the painted surface until it is completely dry, even if it looks ready.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使表面看起来已经好了，在油漆完全干燥前也不要触摸。

senses.english: to make someone feel a strong and usually gentle emotion
senses.exampleEnglish: The students' thank-you letters touched her because they showed that her quiet support had made a real difference.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们的感谢信让她感动，因为信中表明她默默的支持确实有用。

senses.english: the act or sense of feeling something physically
senses.exampleEnglish: The display lets visitors identify materials by touch before they look inside the boxes to check their answers.
senses.exampleChinese: 展示让游客先靠触觉辨认材料，再看盒内核对答案。

senses.english: a small amount of a quality or substance
senses.exampleEnglish: The room needed only a touch of colour to feel warmer, so we added bright cushions near the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间只需一点色彩就更温馨，所以我们在窗边加了亮色坐垫。

senses.english: to officially submit or record a document
senses.exampleEnglish: You must file the application before the closing date if you want the council to consider your request.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果希望市政委员会考虑你的请求，就必须在截止日期前提交申请。

senses.english: a collection of documents stored together
senses.exampleEnglish: The file contains every letter about the repairs, including the original estimate and the final safety report.
senses.exampleChinese: 档案里有全部维修往来信件，包括最初估价和最终安全报告。

senses.english: a unit of information stored on a computer
senses.exampleEnglish: Save the file under a different name so that the original version remains available if anything goes wrong.
senses.exampleChinese: 用不同名称保存文件，以便出问题时仍能找到原版。

senses.english: a tool with a rough surface for smoothing material
senses.exampleEnglish: The carpenter used a file to smooth the edge before allowing the children to handle the wooden pieces.
senses.exampleChinese: 木匠用锉刀磨平边缘，之后才让孩子们拿木块。

senses.english: to smooth or shape something using a file
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to file the rough edge carefully before fitting the small wooden piece into the frame.
senses.exampleChinese: 把小木块装进框架前，我们需要仔细锉平毛边。

senses.english: place that is halfway between two things
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped in the middle of the bridge to look at the boats passing slowly beneath us.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们停在桥中间，看着船只在脚下缓缓驶过。

senses.english: in the centre between two ends or sides
senses.exampleEnglish: The middle shelf is easier for children to reach, so we keep the most frequently borrowed books there.
senses.exampleChinese: 中层书架更方便孩子够到，所以我们把最常借的书放在那里。

senses.english: to officially prevent someone from entering a place or doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The rules bar visitors from entering the work area unless a member of staff is accompanying them.
senses.exampleChinese: 规则禁止游客进入作业区，除非有工作人员陪同。

senses.english: a place that serves alcoholic drinks and often other refreshments
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel bar stayed quiet until the concert ended, when visitors arrived to talk about the performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会结束前酒店酒吧很安静，之后访客前来聊演出。

senses.english: a long narrow piece of solid material
senses.exampleEnglish: A metal bar across the window prevented it from opening wide enough for the large box to pass.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗户横着一根金属条，无法开得足够大让大箱子通过。

senses.english: a counter where drinks or food are served
senses.exampleEnglish: You can order at the bar if the tables are full, and a member of staff will bring your food over.
senses.exampleChinese: 座位满了可以在吧台点餐，工作人员会把食物送来。

senses.english: to experience pain, illness, difficulty, or something unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: People may suffer from tiredness when their working hours change suddenly and they cannot maintain a regular routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 工时突然改变、无法保持规律作息时，人们可能会感到疲倦。

senses.english: careful plan or method for achieving a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Our strategy was to finish the most difficult tasks first, leaving simpler work for the final afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们的策略是先完成最难的任务，把较简单的工作留到最后一天下午。

senses.english: going far down from the surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The lake is too deep near the old bridge, so swimming is only allowed in the marked area.
senses.exampleChinese: 老桥附近的湖水太深，所以只能在指定区域游泳。

senses.english: strongly felt or serious
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt a deep sense of responsibility after being asked to look after the younger students during the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 被要求在旅行中照顾低年级学生后，她感到深深的责任。

senses.english: low in sound or dark and strong in colour
senses.exampleEnglish: His deep voice was easy to hear across the hall, even when the microphone briefly stopped working.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使麦克风暂时失灵，他低沉的声音在大厅各处也容易听清。

senses.english: far into or below something
senses.exampleEnglish: The path leads deep into the woods before returning to the river beside the old stone bridge.
senses.exampleChinese: 小路深入树林，再回到旧石桥旁的河边。

senses.chinese: 除...之外（用于所言不包括的人或事物前）
senses.english: not including; other than
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone except my sister joined the morning walk, because she had already arranged to meet a friend.
senses.exampleChinese: 除了我姐姐，所有人都参加了早晨的徒步，因为她已约好去见朋友。

senses.english: used before a clause describing the only exception
senses.exampleEnglish: The trip went as planned, except that we reached the museum after the guided tours had already finished.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅行按计划进行，只是到博物馆时导览已经结束。

senses.english: being free from dirt or marks because it was washed
senses.exampleEnglish: The kitchen looked clean when we arrived, but we still washed the surfaces before preparing any food.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时厨房看起来很干净，但准备食物前还是擦洗了台面。

senses.english: to remove dirt or unwanted material
senses.exampleEnglish: We will clean the tools before storing them so that they are ready for the next group to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 收好工具前我们会清洁它们，让下一组能直接使用。

senses.chinese: 清白的；没有不良记录的
senses.english: free of offences or other unwanted things
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver had a clean record before this incident, which the committee considered when reviewing what had happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 事件前司机记录清白，委员会复核经过时考虑了这一点。

senses.english: to regularly behave in a certain way
senses.exampleEnglish: Children tend to ask more questions when they can touch the objects being discussed in the lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们能触摸课堂上讨论的物品时，往往会提出更多问题。

senses.english: to look after someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Volunteers tend the garden every weekend, checking young plants carefully before deciding how much water they need.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者每周末照料花园，仔细查看幼苗后再决定浇多少水。

senses.english: to move forward in a certain direction
senses.exampleEnglish: The group could not advance beyond the bridge until the guide had checked that the path was safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导确认小路安全之前，这个团队无法继续前进越过桥梁。

senses.english: progress or a development that makes something better
senses.exampleEnglish: The new material represents an important advance because it can be repaired more easily than the old version.
senses.exampleChinese: 新材料是一项重要进步，因为它比旧版更容易修复。

senses.english: money paid before work is completed or normally due
senses.exampleEnglish: The builder asked for an advance to buy materials, with the rest payable after the work was checked.
senses.exampleChinese: 施工者要求预付款买材料，余款在工程检查后支付。

senses.english: done or given before something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: Advance booking is recommended because the small workshop cannot accept more visitors once all the places are filled.
senses.exampleChinese: 建议提前预订，因为小工作坊名额满后无法再接待访客。

senses.english: to make something full
senses.exampleEnglish: Please fill the bottle before we leave the campsite, because there may be no water along the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开营地前，请把水瓶装满，因为沿途可能没有水。

senses.english: a bright planet of gas in the night sky
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide pointed out a bright star that sailors once used to help them find their direction.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游指给我们看一颗亮星，水手们曾靠它来判断方向。

senses.english: a person famous for performance or achievement
senses.exampleEnglish: The young tennis star returned to her old school to talk about training and answer questions from students.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位年轻网球明星回到母校，谈训练并回答学生问题。

senses.english: a star-shaped symbol, often showing a rating
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel received an extra star after improving its facilities, but visitors still praised the friendly staff most.
senses.exampleChinese: 改善设施后酒店多获一星，不过访客最赞赏的仍是友善员工。

senses.english: to have or give someone an important role in a film or play
senses.exampleEnglish: She will star in the school play after helping behind the scenes for the past two years.
senses.exampleChinese: 过去两年一直做幕后工作后，她将在学校戏剧中担任主角。

senses.english: system of connections
senses.exampleEnglish: The town has a network of paths that connects the school, library and park without crossing busy roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 镇上有一套步道网络，连接学校、图书馆和公园，无需穿越繁忙道路。

senses.english: to connect computers or other systems together
senses.exampleEnglish: The school plans to network the classroom computers so that students can share files without carrying separate memory sticks.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校计划把教室电脑联网，让学生无需各带存储盘就能共享文件。

senses.english: to meet people who may be useful professionally
senses.exampleEnglish: The conference gives new teachers a chance to network with colleagues who are developing similar classroom activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议让新教师有机会结识正在开发类似课堂活动的同事。

senses.english: usually; as a rule; by, to, or for most people
senses.exampleEnglish: The route is generally quiet in the morning, although it becomes much busier when the weekend market opens.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条路线早晨通常很安静，不过周末市场开门时就热闹得多。

senses.english: functioning; use
senses.exampleEnglish: The operation of the new heating system is simple once you understand how to set the timer.
senses.exampleChinese: 一旦弄清楚如何设定定时器，这套新供暖系统的操作就很简单。

senses.english: a medical procedure performed by a surgeon
senses.exampleEnglish: The operation was scheduled for the following week, after the doctor had explained what the patient should expect.
senses.exampleChinese: 医生解释病人需要了解的情况后，手术被安排到下一周。

senses.english: a planned activity or organization carrying out work
senses.exampleEnglish: The rescue operation continued until everyone who had been walking near the flooded river was safely accounted for.
senses.exampleChinese: 救援行动持续进行，直到确认所有在洪水河流附近徒步的人都安全。

senses.english: a mathematical process such as addition or division
senses.exampleEnglish: The students checked which operation was needed before using the numbers given in the problem to calculate an answer.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们先判断需要哪种运算，再用题中数字算答案。

senses.english: a sports competition between two people or teams
senses.exampleEnglish: The match was delayed by heavy rain, so the players waited inside until the pitch was safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 比赛因大雨推迟，所以队员们在室内等待，直到场地恢复安全。

senses.english: a small stick used to start a flame
senses.exampleEnglish: He used a match to light the camping stove after checking that it stood safely away from the tent.
senses.exampleChinese: 确认炉子放在远离帐篷的安全位置后，他用火柴点燃了它。

senses.english: someone or something that goes well with another
senses.exampleEnglish: The quiet garden was a good match for our plans, since the children needed room to explore safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 安静花园很符合计划，因为孩子们需要可安全探索的空间。

senses.english: to be the same as or suitable for something
senses.exampleEnglish: The number on your ticket should match the number above your seat, so check before putting your bags away.
senses.exampleChinese: 票上号码应与座位上方相符，放好行李前先核对。

senses.english: to put suitable people or things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will match beginners with more experienced students so that everyone has someone to ask for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师会把初学者与经验较多的学生配对，让人人都能寻求帮助。

senses.english: to prevent from happening, or stay away from
senses.exampleEnglish: We left the main path to avoid the crowds, but soon discovered that the quieter route was much steeper.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们离开主路避开人群，却很快发现较安静的路线陡得多。

senses.english: something on which a person can sit
senses.exampleEnglish: I offered my seat to a passenger who was carrying a baby and several heavy shopping bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 我把座位让给了一位抱着婴儿、提着几个沉重购物袋的乘客。

senses.english: a position held by an elected representative
senses.exampleEnglish: The candidate won a seat on the council after promising to improve the paths used by children walking to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 候选人承诺改善儿童上学步道后，赢得了市政委员会席位。

senses.english: to give someone a place to sit or have room for people
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will seat each group near the display before explaining how the old machine was used.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游会先安排各组在展品旁就座，再解释旧机器的用法。

senses.english: to use your arm to make a thing fly through the air
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to throw the ball gently enough for the younger children to catch it without moving too far.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽量轻轻地扔球，让较小的孩子不用移动太远也能接住。

senses.english: to organize a party or celebration
senses.exampleEnglish: The neighbours decided to throw a small party when the repaired hall finally opened for community activities again.
senses.exampleChinese: 修好的礼堂终于重新供社区活动使用时，邻居们决定办个小聚会。

senses.english: big or small piece of work someone has to do
senses.exampleEnglish: The task became easier once we divided it into smaller parts and agreed who would do each one.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把任务拆成小部分，并商定各自负责哪一部分后，任务变容易了。

senses.english: to give someone a particular job
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will task each group with checking one part of the route before we combine the results.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师会让每组检查一段路线，然后把结果合并。

senses.english: standard or regular way of doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: It is normal to feel nervous before speaking to a new group, even if you know the subject well.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使你很熟悉主题，在新群体面前讲话前感到紧张也很正常。

senses.english: something you try to do or achieve; an aim
senses.exampleEnglish: Her main goal was to finish the course, but she also hoped to make a few new friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的主要目标是完成课程，不过也希望交几个新朋友。

senses.english: a sports target or a point gained by sending a ball into it
senses.exampleEnglish: The goalkeeper stood near the goal while the younger players practised passing the ball to each other accurately.
senses.exampleChinese: 年幼球员练习准确传球时，守门员站在球门附近。

senses.english: partner in professional work (e.g., in law)
senses.exampleEnglish: Her business associate offered to handle the orders while she travelled abroad to meet a new supplier.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的商业伙伴提出，在她出国会见新供应商期间负责处理订单。

senses.english: to connect people or things in your mind
senses.exampleEnglish: Many visitors associate the village with its famous bridge, although local people are equally proud of the surrounding gardens.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多游客把村庄与名桥联系起来，不过当地人也同样以周围花园为荣。

collocations.chinese: 把某物与另一物联系起来

senses.english: to spend time with particular people
senses.exampleEnglish: She prefers to associate with people who discuss ideas openly rather than criticising everyone who disagrees with them.
senses.exampleChinese: 她更愿意与坦诚讨论观点的人交往，而不是与批评所有异议者的人相处。

senses.english: having a connected or less senior professional position
senses.exampleEnglish: The associate director will run the workshop while the director visits another school to discuss future projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 主任去另一所学校讨论未来项目时，副主任会主持工作坊。

senses.english: color of the clear sky
senses.exampleEnglish: The bright blue walls made the room feel cheerful, even when the sky outside was grey.
senses.exampleChinese: 鲜蓝色的墙壁让房间显得很欢快，即使外面的天空灰蒙蒙的。

senses.english: sad or unhappy; informal
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt a little blue after the course ended because she missed seeing the group every week.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结束后她有点失落，因为想念每周见到大家的日子。

senses.english: good or useful in qualities, constructive, confident
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher gave positive feedback that helped the students understand what they had done well in the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师给了积极反馈，帮助学生明白自己在项目中哪些方面做得好。

senses.english: completely sure
senses.exampleEnglish: I am positive that we left the map beside the window, although someone may have moved it afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 我确信我们把地图留在窗边，不过之后可能有人移过它。

senses.english: showing that a tested substance or condition is present
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained that a positive result meant the sample contained the substance they had been testing for.
senses.exampleChinese: 导览员解释，阳性结果表示样本含有要检测的物质。

senses.english: greater than zero, or relating to one type of electrical charge
senses.exampleEnglish: The final value was positive because the money raised exceeded the amount spent on materials for the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 最终数值为正，因为筹得金额超过活动材料开销。

senses.english: possibility out of several that can be chosen; choice
senses.exampleEnglish: Taking the train is the cheapest option, although the bus stops much closer to our final destination.
senses.exampleChinese: 坐火车是最便宜的选择，不过公交站离我们的最终目的地近得多。

senses.english: a container with (usually) four straight sides and a lid
senses.exampleEnglish: We put the photographs in a strong box so that they would not get damaged during the move.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把照片放进一个结实的盒子，防止搬家时损坏。

senses.english: to fight someone as a sport using gloved hands
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to box at the sports centre, where the instructor emphasised technique and control rather than strength alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在体育中心学拳击，教练强调技术与控制，而非单靠力量。

senses.english: very very large
senses.exampleEnglish: The new library has made a huge difference to families who previously had nowhere nearby to borrow books.
senses.exampleChinese: 新图书馆给以前在附近无处借书的家庭带来了巨大改变。

senses.english: piece of information that is sent from to a person
senses.exampleEnglish: I left a message explaining where we had gone, in case the others arrived before we returned.
senses.exampleChinese: 我留了言，说明我们去了哪里，以防其他人在我们回来前到达。

senses.english: the main idea communicated by a work or event
senses.exampleEnglish: The story's message is that small acts of kindness can matter even when they do not change everything.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事的寓意是，小善举即使不能改变一切，仍有意义。

senses.english: to send someone an electronic message
senses.exampleEnglish: Please message me when your train arrives, so that I can meet you outside the station without waiting too long.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车到站时请发消息给我，好让我不用久等就能去站外接你。

senses.english: one of a particular group given as an example
senses.exampleEnglish: There are several ways to reduce waste; for instance, you can repair things instead of replacing them.
senses.exampleChinese: 减少浪费有几种方法；例如，你可以修理物品，而不是换新的。

senses.english: the particular way something is done or made
senses.exampleEnglish: The restaurant's relaxed style makes it popular with families who want a meal without too much formality.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家餐馆轻松的风格，让想自在吃顿饭的家庭很喜欢。

senses.english: to arrange the appearance of something
senses.exampleEnglish: She will style the display using old photographs and bright labels so that children can follow the story easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 她会用老照片和亮色标签设计展陈，让孩子容易理解故事。

senses.english: to talk about or write about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The article does not refer to any particular school, although its findings may be useful to many teachers.
senses.exampleChinese: 这篇文章没有提到任何特定学校，不过研究结果可能对许多教师有用。

senses.english: having a very low temperature
senses.exampleEnglish: The water was too cold for a long swim, so we stayed near the shore and returned quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 水太冷，不适合长时间游泳，所以我们待在岸边附近，很快就回来了。

senses.english: a common illness affecting the nose and throat
senses.exampleEnglish: He stayed home with a cold rather than joining the walk, which involved several hours outside in the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 他感冒留在家中，没有参加需在雨中走几小时的徒步。

senses.english: cold weather or a lack of warmth
senses.exampleEnglish: We went inside to escape the cold while waiting for the coach that would take us back to school.
senses.exampleChinese: 等回学校的大巴时，我们进屋躲避寒冷。

senses.english: not showing warmth or friendliness
senses.exampleEnglish: Her cold reply surprised the new member, who had only asked where to put the borrowed equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 她冷淡的回答让新成员吃惊，对方只是问借来的器材该放哪里。

senses.english: to force something away from you
senses.exampleEnglish: You will need to push the door firmly because the wind is pressing against it from outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 你需要用力推门，因为外面的风正顶着门。

senses.english: to encourage or pressure someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach will push the team to practise more carefully without asking them to ignore their other responsibilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练会督促团队更认真练习，但不会要求他们忽视其他责任。

senses.english: a determined effort to achieve something
senses.exampleEnglish: We need one final push to finish the painting before the hall opens for the weekend's activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 礼堂周末活动开始前，我们还需最后加把劲完成粉刷。

senses.english: one of four equal parts of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Only a quarter of the group had visited the museum before, so the guide began with a general introduction.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队中只有四分之一的人以前参观过博物馆，所以导游先作了概括介绍。

senses.english: one of four periods of three months in a year
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop plans to review its opening hours each quarter so that they continue to match customers' needs.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店计划每季度检查营业时间，确保继续符合顾客需求。

senses.english: a particular part of a town
senses.exampleEnglish: The old quarter is best explored on foot because many narrow streets cannot be reached by car.
senses.exampleChinese: 老城区最好步行游览，因为许多窄街汽车无法进入。

senses.english: to believe, based on the evidence; suppose
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not assume that every visitor knows the building, because some people may be coming here for the first time.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要以为每位访客都熟悉这栋楼，因为有些人可能是第一次来。

senses.english: to take on a duty, role, or responsibility
senses.exampleEnglish: She will assume responsibility for the garden when the current organiser leaves at the end of the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 现任组织者夏末离开后，她将接手负责花园。

senses.english: very young child, who cannot yet speak
senses.exampleEnglish: The baby fell asleep during the journey, so we spoke quietly when we finally reached the hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 婴儿在路上睡着了，所以终于到酒店时，我们说话很轻。

senses.english: having the desired effect or result
senses.exampleEnglish: The event was successful because local residents helped plan activities that people of different ages could enjoy.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次活动很成功，因为当地居民帮助策划了适合不同年龄人群的活动。

senses.english: to make musical sounds with your voice
senses.exampleEnglish: The children began to sing as they walked, which made the final part of the journey feel shorter.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们边走边唱，让旅程最后一段感觉没那么长了。

senses.english: not being sure of something; lack of certainty
senses.exampleEnglish: There was some doubt about the date, so we checked the invitation before booking our train tickets.
senses.exampleChinese: 日期有些不确定，所以我们订火车票前核对了邀请函。

senses.english: to be uncertain about something or think it unlikely
senses.exampleEnglish: I doubt that we can finish before lunch unless someone helps us move the remaining boxes upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 除非有人帮忙把余下箱子搬上楼，否则我怀疑午饭前做不完。

senses.english: fighting against others when trying to win something
senses.exampleEnglish: The competition attracted young designers who were asked to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场比赛吸引了年轻设计师，要求他们用原本会被丢弃的材料设计实用物品。

senses.english: the situation of trying to succeed against others
senses.exampleEnglish: Competition between the two shops increased after both began offering repairs for the same types of bicycles.
senses.exampleChinese: 两家商店都开始修相同类型的自行车后，彼此竞争加剧了。

senses.english: idea or set of ideas that try to explain facts or events
senses.exampleEnglish: The theory seemed convincing, but we needed an experiment to find out whether it matched what actually happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个理论似乎很有说服力，但我们需要实验来判断它是否符合实际情况。

senses.english: to offer or put forward an idea for consideration
senses.exampleEnglish: I propose that we try the new timetable for a month before deciding whether to keep it permanently.
senses.exampleChinese: 我建议先试行新时间表一个月，再决定是否永久保留。

senses.english: to ask someone to marry you
senses.exampleEnglish: He decided to propose during a quiet walk rather than at the large party their friends had arranged.
senses.exampleChinese: 他决定在安静散步时求婚，而不是在朋友们安排的大聚会上。

senses.english: to mention or cite a source of information
senses.exampleEnglish: Remember to reference the original report whenever you use its figures, so that readers can check the source themselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 使用原报告中的数字时，记得注明出处，方便读者自行核查来源。

senses.english: a mention of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The speech included a reference to the volunteers who had kept the project running through a difficult winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 演讲提到了在艰难冬季坚持推动项目的志愿者。

senses.english: a source used for information or an indication of that source
senses.exampleEnglish: Every reference at the end of the report should help readers find the information used to support its conclusions.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告末尾每条参考文献，都应帮助读者找到支撑结论的信息。

senses.english: a statement about someone's suitability for a job
senses.exampleEnglish: Her former manager provided a reference explaining how well she worked with customers during the busy holiday season.
senses.exampleChinese: 前经理提供推荐信，说明她在繁忙假日季与顾客相处得多好。

senses.english: a discussion in which you disagree with another's opinion
senses.exampleEnglish: Their argument about the route ended when they checked the map and discovered that both roads reached the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们查看地图、发现两条路都通往湖泊后，就不再为路线争论了。

senses.english: a reason or set of reasons supporting a view
senses.exampleEnglish: The strongest argument for the new crossing is that children currently have no safe route to the school gate.
senses.exampleChinese: 支持新人行横道最有力的理由，是孩子们目前没有安全到校门的路线。

senses.english: person or animal that is fully grown
senses.exampleEnglish: Every adult accompanying the group received a copy of the plan and a list of emergency contact numbers.
