senses.exampleChinese: 每位随团成人都领到了一份计划和紧急联系电话表。

senses.english: fully grown or intended for grown people
senses.exampleEnglish: The course offers separate activities for adult learners, who may want to connect new skills with their work experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程为成年学习者提供不同活动，他们可能希望把新技能与工作经验联系起来。

senses.english: to travel through the air using wings
senses.exampleEnglish: The birds fly south when the weather becomes colder, returning only when there is enough food again.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气变冷时，这些鸟飞往南方，直到食物再次充足才会返回。

senses.english: a small flying insect with two wings
senses.exampleEnglish: A fly kept landing on the fruit, so we covered the bowl before carrying it outside for the picnic.
senses.exampleChinese: 一只苍蝇总落在水果上，所以拿出去野餐前，我们把碗盖好。

senses.english: to travel in or operate an aircraft
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose to fly to the island because the ferry would take most of the first day of our holiday.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选择飞去岛上，因为渡轮会占去假期第一天的大部分时间。

senses.english: the opening at the front of trousers
senses.exampleEnglish: The tailor repaired the fly before shortening the trousers, making sure the new fastening was comfortable to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 裁缝先修好裤门襟再改短裤脚，确保新扣件用起来舒适。

senses.english: official (printed) record that gives information
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep a copy of the document somewhere safe, in case the original is lost during the move.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把文件副本妥善保存，以防原件在搬家时丢失。

senses.english: to record facts in writing, pictures, or another lasting form
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will document the changes in the garden by taking photographs from the same spot each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生会每周从同一位置拍照，记录花园变化。

senses.english: a series of actions or designs that can be repeated
senses.exampleEnglish: We noticed a pattern in the answers, although we needed more information before we could explain it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在答案中发现了一种规律，不过还需要更多信息才能解释。

senses.english: a design or model used as a guide for making something
senses.exampleEnglish: She followed the sewing pattern carefully but changed the pockets to make the jacket more useful for travelling.
senses.exampleChinese: 她仔细照缝纫纸样做，但改了口袋，让夹克更适合旅行。

senses.english: formal request for a job, building permission, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: Your application should explain why you want to join the course and what you hope to learn.
senses.exampleChinese: 你的申请应说明为什么想参加课程，以及希望学到什么。

senses.english: a computer program for a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The application stores your notes on the device so that you can read them without connecting to the internet.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个应用把笔记存到设备上，让你不用联网也能阅读。

senses.english: the practical use of an idea, skill, or method
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explores the application of simple scientific ideas to problems that students may notice in their homes.
senses.exampleChinese: 这堂课探讨如何把简单科学概念用于学生在家可能发现的问题。

senses.english: the act of putting a substance on a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: A second application of paint may be needed if the original colour still shows through after the wall dries.
senses.exampleChinese: 墙面干后如果原色仍透出，可能需要再涂一遍。

senses.english: having a high temperature
senses.exampleEnglish: The classroom became so hot in the afternoon that we moved our discussion to a shaded area outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午教室变得很热，于是我们把讨论移到了外面的阴凉处。

senses.english: having a strong spicy taste
senses.exampleEnglish: The sauce was too hot for the children, so the restaurant brought a milder version to the table.
senses.exampleChinese: 酱汁对孩子太辣，所以餐馆端来了一份较温和的版本。

senses.english: very popular, exciting, or much discussed
senses.exampleEnglish: The new exhibition became a hot topic after visitors shared photographs of its unusual outdoor displays online.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客网上分享特别的户外展品照片后，新展览成了热门话题。

senses.english: in a way that is easy to see or understand
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were obviously confusing, because several groups made the same mistake despite reading them carefully twice.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明显然令人困惑，因为几个小组仔细读了两遍，还是犯了同样的错误。

senses.english: not easy to understand; not obvious
senses.exampleEnglish: The reason for the delay remains unclear, although the company has promised to provide more information tomorrow.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误原因仍不清楚，不过公司承诺明天提供更多信息。

senses.english: a piece of paper showing what you have to pay
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the bill carefully because it included a dish that nobody at our table had ordered.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仔细核对了账单，因为上面有一道我们这一桌无人点过的菜。

senses.english: a proposed law discussed by a legislature
senses.exampleEnglish: The bill would require public buildings to provide clearer information for visitors who cannot easily use the stairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项法案将要求公共建筑为不方便走楼梯的访客提供更清楚的信息。

senses.english: a piece of paper money; chiefly American English
senses.exampleEnglish: He paid with a twenty-dollar bill because the machine would not accept his card at the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 车站机器不收他的银行卡，所以他用一张二十美元纸币付款。

senses.english: the hard pointed mouth of a bird
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide showed us how the bird uses its long bill to reach insects hidden beneath the mud.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导展示了这种鸟如何用长喙找到藏在泥下的昆虫。

senses.english: to send someone a request for payment
senses.exampleEnglish: The company will bill us after the repairs are checked, rather than asking for the full amount before work begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司会在维修检查后开账单，而不是开工前收全款。

senses.english: to carefully look for something
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to search the garden first because that was where the children had last seen the kitten.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定先搜寻花园，因为孩子们最后一次见到小猫就是在那里。

senses.english: an attempt to find someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The search took longer than expected because the missing key had slipped behind the drawer in the kitchen.
senses.exampleChinese: 寻找花的时间比预想长，因为丢失钥匙滑到了厨房抽屉后。

senses.english: to divide into parts, or to make something divide into parts
senses.exampleEnglish: Please separate the broken pieces from the rest of the equipment so that nobody uses them by mistake.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把损坏的部件与其他设备分开，免得有人误用。

senses.english: not joined or belonging together
senses.exampleEnglish: The groups need separate tables because one activity involves wet paint while the other uses delicate paper models.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个小组需要分开的桌子，因为一个活动用湿颜料，另一个用精细纸模型。

senses.english: being in the middle
senses.exampleEnglish: The central courtyard provides a quiet place to sit, even though busy classrooms surround it on every side.
senses.exampleChinese: 中央庭院四面被忙碌的教室环绕，但仍提供了安静的休息场所。

senses.english: most important to an idea, activity, or situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The central question is whether the new timetable will help families who cannot drive to the hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 核心问题是，新时刻表是否能帮助无法开车去医院的家庭。

senses.english: a particular occupation in professional life
senses.exampleEnglish: She changed her career after discovering that she enjoyed teaching practical skills more than working in an office.
senses.exampleChinese: 她发现自己比起办公室工作更喜欢教授实践技能，于是换了职业。

senses.english: a word people use to change the topic of a conversation
senses.exampleEnglish: We had almost forgotten about the delayed parcel; anyway, what time are we meeting at the station tomorrow?
senses.exampleChinese: 我们差不多忘了那个延误的包裹；对了，我们明天几点在车站见面？

senses.english: despite what has just been said
senses.exampleEnglish: The forecast was uncertain, but we decided to go anyway and choose a shorter walk if the rain arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气预报不确定，但我们仍决定去，如果下雨就改走短路线。

senses.english: expression of ideas or opinions
senses.exampleEnglish: She prepared a short speech to thank the volunteers who had worked so hard to restore the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 她准备了一篇简短讲话，感谢那些为恢复花园而辛勤工作的志愿者。

senses.english: the ability or act of speaking
senses.exampleEnglish: The game encourages speech by giving children a reason to describe objects that their partners cannot see.
senses.exampleChinese: 游戏让孩子描述搭档看不到的物品，从而鼓励他们开口说话。

senses.english: an animal with four legs that is used for hunting, guarding, or as a pet.
senses.exampleEnglish: The dog waited by the gate until its owner returned from collecting the children at the nearby school.
senses.exampleChinese: 狗在门边等待，直到主人从附近学校接孩子回来。

senses.english: to continue causing problems for someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Technical problems continued to dog the project until the team replaced the old equipment and simplified the testing process.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到团队更换旧设备并简化测试流程，技术问题才不再持续困扰项目。

senses.english: a person with an important position in an organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The safety officer checked the hall before the concert to make sure that all the exits were clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 演唱会前，安全负责人检查了大厅，确保所有出口畅通。

senses.english: over or across an entire thing or place, or in every part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers remained cheerful throughout the afternoon, even when the rain made their outdoor work more difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个下午，志愿者们都很愉快，即使下雨让户外工作更困难。

senses.english: thick, black liquid in the ground used as fuel
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how oil is taken from deep underground before it is processed into different fuels.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆介绍了石油如何从地下深处被开采出来，再加工成不同燃料。

senses.english: a thick liquid used in cooking, lubrication, or other purposes
senses.exampleEnglish: Heat a little oil in the pan before adding the vegetables, following the order suggested in the recipe.
senses.exampleChinese: 按食谱顺序，先在锅里热少许油，再加入蔬菜。

senses.english: to put oil on something to make it work smoothly
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to oil the hinges before the workshop, because the door makes a loud noise whenever someone opens it.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊前需要给铰链上油，因为每次开门都很响。

senses.english: women's garment with a top part and a skirt
senses.exampleEnglish: She wore a dress that her grandmother had made, adding a jacket when the evening grew cooler.
senses.exampleChinese: 她穿了一条祖母做的连衣裙，傍晚天气转凉时又加了件夹克。

senses.english: to put clothes on yourself or someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: The children learned to dress themselves for the walk, checking the weather before choosing their jackets and shoes.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们学着自己穿好徒步服装，选夹克和鞋前先看天气。

senses.english: clothes of a particular style or for a particular occasion
senses.exampleEnglish: The invitation asks for informal dress because most of the celebration will take place outside in the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 邀请函要求便装，因为庆祝活动大部分会在花园室外举行。

senses.english: to clean and cover a wound
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained how she would dress the wound before checking that the patient understood the follow-up instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士解释了如何包扎伤口，再确认病人理解后续说明。

senses.english: to gain money or an advantage from something
senses.exampleEnglish: Local businesses may profit from the festival because visitors often stay overnight and spend money in nearby shops.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地商家可能从节庆中获利，因为游客往往会留宿，并在附近商店消费。

senses.english: to gain money or another benefit from something
senses.exampleEnglish: Small businesses can profit from sharing equipment because it reduces costs while giving them access to tools they rarely need.
senses.exampleChinese: 小企业可从共享设备中获益，降低成本并使用不常需要的工具。

senses.english: to give an answer without knowing if it is correct
senses.exampleEnglish: I could only guess how long the journey would take, because I had never used that route before.
senses.exampleChinese: 我只能猜测路程要多久，因为以前从未走过那条路线。

senses.english: an answer or opinion given without certainty
senses.exampleEnglish: My first guess was wrong, but the next clue helped me understand which part of the map to examine.
senses.exampleChinese: 我第一次猜错了，不过下一条线索让我明白该查看地图哪部分。

senses.english: (n) activity that is (adj) amusing and enjoyable
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop was a fun way to learn about science, especially because we could try the experiments ourselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊是一种有趣的科学学习方式，尤其是我们可以亲自尝试实验。

senses.english: pleasure or enjoyment
senses.exampleEnglish: The children had fun creating the models, even though none of them looked exactly like the examples.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们做模型玩得很开心，尽管没有一个与示例完全相同。

senses.english: to defend someone or something from harm or danger
senses.exampleEnglish: We planted a row of trees to protect the young vegetables from the strong winds crossing the field.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们种了一排树，保护幼嫩蔬菜免受穿过田野的强风侵袭。

senses.english: essential supply of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The library is a valuable resource for students who need reliable information but cannot afford to buy every book.
senses.exampleChinese: 对于需要可靠信息却买不起所有书籍的学生来说，图书馆是一项宝贵资源。

senses.english: knowledge of the physical world based on facts
senses.exampleEnglish: Her interest in science grew when she began asking why the plants in different parts of the garden grew differently.
senses.exampleChinese: 她开始追问为什么花园不同位置的植物生长不同后，对科学的兴趣增加了。

senses.english: illness that affects a person, animal, or plant
senses.exampleEnglish: Scientists study how the disease spreads between plants so that farmers can protect the rest of their crops.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学家研究这种疾病如何在植物间传播，以帮助农民保护其余作物。

senses.english: to make two or more things equal
senses.exampleEnglish: She tries to balance work and family life by keeping her evenings free whenever the schedule allows.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要日程允许，她就尽量腾出晚间时间，以平衡工作与家庭生活。

senses.english: to remain steady or make something steady
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to balance the tray with both hands while walking slowly across the uneven floor of the old hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 慢慢走过旧礼堂不平地面时，试着用双手稳住托盘。

senses.english: the ability to remain steady without falling
senses.exampleEnglish: The activity helps children improve their balance before they try moving along the narrower beam near the wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项活动帮助孩子提高平衡能力，再尝试沿墙边较窄的平衡木移动。

senses.english: money remaining in an account or still owed
senses.exampleEnglish: The balance in the club's account should cover the materials, but we must keep enough for unexpected repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部账户余额应该够买材料，不过必须留够意外维修的钱。

senses.english: a suitable combination of different things
senses.exampleEnglish: The course offers a good balance between discussion and practical work, so students can test the ideas they hear.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程平衡安排讨论与实践，让学生能检验听到的概念。

collocations.english: a balance between work and rest

senses.english: physical harm that is done to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The storm caused considerable damage to the roof, although the rooms below remained dry throughout the night.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重破坏，不过下面的房间整夜仍然干燥。

senses.english: to harm something or make it less useful
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not leave the books beside the open window because rain could damage them before anyone notices.
senses.exampleChinese: 不要把书留在敞窗旁，因为还没人发现就可能被雨淋坏。

senses.english: money legally paid for harm or loss; plural damages
senses.exampleEnglish: The court awarded damages after deciding that the company had caused the loss through its failure to maintain the equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 法院认定公司未维护设备造成损失后，判给了损害赔偿金。

senses.english: starting situation, fact, idea to develop from
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey provides a useful basis for discussion, but we should hear residents' views before making a decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查为讨论提供了有用基础，但我们在决定前应听取居民意见。

senses.english: person who writes books, plays, poems, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The author visited our school to explain how a childhood memory had inspired her most recent story.
senses.exampleChinese: 作者来到我们学校，解释一段童年记忆如何启发了她最新的故事。

senses.english: to write or create a document or work
senses.exampleEnglish: She helped author the report after spending several months interviewing residents about their journeys to school and work.
senses.exampleChinese: 花几个月采访居民上学、通勤情况后，她参与撰写了报告。

senses.english: at the most important or easiest (beginner) level
senses.exampleEnglish: The course covers basic skills such as measuring and cutting, before moving on to more complicated projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程先介绍测量、切割等基本技能，然后进入更复杂的项目。

senses.english: the simplest and most important elements, usually in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The first session covers the basics before students move on to the tools they will use in later projects.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一课先讲基础，再进入后续项目将使用的工具。

senses.english: to make someone more determined or confident
senses.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to encourage more families to cycle by showing them safer routes around the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望通过介绍镇上更安全的路线，鼓励更多家庭骑车。

senses.english: long thin strands on your head or body
senses.exampleEnglish: She tied her hair back before starting the experiment, as the safety instructions required everyone to do.
senses.exampleChinese: 她开始实验前把头发扎到后面，安全说明要求所有人都这样做。

senses.english: characteristic of boys or men
senses.exampleEnglish: The wildlife guide explained how male birds sometimes use bright feathers to attract attention during spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 野生动物向导解释了雄鸟有时如何在春天用鲜艳羽毛吸引注意。

senses.english: a male person or animal
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained that the male of this bird species often has brighter feathers than the female.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释，这种鸟的雄性羽毛通常比雌性更鲜艳。

senses.english: to be working or being used
senses.exampleEnglish: Only trained staff can operate the machine because its moving parts could be dangerous if used incorrectly.
senses.exampleChinese: 只有受过培训的员工才能操作这台机器，因为使用不当时其活动部件可能危险。

senses.english: to use or control a machine or system
senses.exampleEnglish: Only trained staff should operate the lifting equipment because a small mistake could damage the heavy display cases.
senses.exampleChinese: 只有受训员工才能操作起重设备，因为小错误也可能损坏沉重展柜。

senses.english: to perform a surgical procedure
senses.exampleEnglish: The surgeon will operate tomorrow after the team has checked the results and explained the procedure to the patient.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队核查结果并向病人解释流程后，外科医生明天会做手术。

senses.english: to bounce back off a surface (e.g., light)
senses.exampleEnglish: The large windows reflect the afternoon sunlight, making the building appear brighter when viewed from across the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 大窗户反射午后的阳光，从河对岸看时，大楼显得更明亮。

senses.english: to show something about a situation or feeling
senses.exampleEnglish: The new timetable should reflect what residents actually need, rather than simply repeating the arrangements used several years ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表应反映居民实际需要，而不是照搬几年前的安排。

senses.english: to think carefully about something
senses.exampleEnglish: We will reflect on what went well after the event, then decide which parts should change next year.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动后我们会反思哪些做得好，再决定明年哪些部分需要改变。

senses.english: to work out to become stronger and healthier
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular exercise became easier to maintain once she found a walking group that met near her home.
senses.exampleChinese: 找到一个在家附近集合的步行小组后，她更容易坚持定期锻炼了。

senses.english: a task used to develop a skill or understanding
senses.exampleEnglish: The final exercise asks students to explain their choice, rather than simply choosing an answer from the list.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一道练习要求学生解释选择，而不是只从列表选答案。

senses.english: to do physical activity to improve health or fitness
senses.exampleEnglish: She prefers to exercise with friends because they encourage each other to keep going when the weather is poor.
senses.exampleChinese: 她更喜欢和朋友锻炼，因为天气差时大家会互相鼓励坚持。

senses.english: to use a right, ability, or authority
senses.exampleEnglish: Members can exercise their right to vote once they have read the proposal and asked any questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 会员阅读提案并提出疑问后，可以行使投票权。

senses.english: that can help with a particular task
senses.exampleEnglish: The map proved useful when our phones lost signal and we needed to find another route home.
senses.exampleChinese: 手机没有信号、我们需要寻找其他回家路线时，这张地图派上了用场。

senses.english: place where you can order, buy and eat a meal
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a restaurant that served local dishes, although we had to wait until a table became available.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了一家供应当地菜的餐馆，不过不得不等到有空桌。

senses.english: earned money from work, investments, or business
senses.exampleEnglish: Their income changes from month to month because both parents work on projects rather than receiving fixed salaries.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们家的收入每月不同，因为父母双方都按项目工作，而不是领固定工资。

senses.english: things, buildings, or pieces of land owned by someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The property includes a small garden, which the previous owner used to grow vegetables for the family.
senses.exampleChinese: 这处房产包括一个小花园，前任屋主曾用它为家人种蔬菜。

senses.english: a characteristic of a substance or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The students compared the properties of different materials before deciding which one would keep the water warm longest.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生比较不同材料的性质，再决定哪种保温最久。

senses.english: a building or piece of land that is owned
senses.exampleEnglish: The property includes a small workshop, which could be useful if we decide to repair bicycles at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 这处房产带有小工作间，如果决定在家修自行车会很有用。

senses.english: existing or happening before the present time
senses.exampleEnglish: My previous job involved travelling frequently, whereas my current role allows me to work much closer to home.
senses.exampleChinese: 我上一份工作需要经常出差，而现在的职位让我能在离家近得多的地方工作。

senses.english: having little or no light; not light in color
senses.exampleEnglish: The room became too dark to read comfortably, so I moved my chair closer to the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间变得太暗，无法舒服地阅读，所以我把椅子挪到了窗边。

senses.english: close to black or having a strong deep colour
senses.exampleEnglish: The dark curtains block the afternoon sunlight, but they also make the small room feel less spacious.
senses.exampleChinese: 深色窗帘挡住午后阳光，却也让小房间显得不够宽敞。

senses.english: a state with little or no light
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited in the dark until the caretaker found a torch and showed us where the spare lights were kept.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在黑暗中等着，直到管理员找到手电，带我们去备用灯存放处。

senses.english: to think creatively about; form a mental picture of
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to imagine how the village looked before the bridge was built and most visitors arrived by boat.
senses.exampleChinese: 试着想象建桥以前村庄的样子，那时多数访客乘船到来。

senses.english: to suppose that something is probably true
senses.exampleEnglish: I imagine the museum will be busy tomorrow, since several schools have booked visits for the same afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 我猜博物馆明天会很忙，因为几所学校都预订了同一下午参观。

senses.english: yes; alright
senses.exampleEnglish: Okay, we can change the meeting time, provided everyone receives the new details before they leave home.
senses.exampleChinese: 好的，我们可以改会议时间，前提是所有人在离家前都收到新安排。

senses.english: acceptable or in a satisfactory condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The room is okay for a short meeting, although we would need more chairs for a larger group.
senses.exampleChinese: 这间屋用于短会还可以，不过人更多就需要加椅子。

senses.english: in a satisfactory way
senses.exampleEnglish: The printer works okay with plain text, but photographs come out too dark unless we change the settings.
senses.exampleChinese: 打印机印纯文字还行，但照片不调设置就会太暗。

senses.english: to get money for work
senses.exampleEnglish: She began to earn extra money by repairing clothes for neighbours after finishing her evening sewing course.
senses.exampleChinese: 完成晚间缝纫课程后，她开始为邻居修补衣服，赚取额外收入。

senses.english: to obtain something deserved through work or behaviour
senses.exampleEnglish: She worked hard to earn the team's trust after joining halfway through a project that was already difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在一个已很困难的项目中途加入，努力赢得团队信任。

senses.english: a female child of someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Their daughter chose to volunteer at the museum because she wanted to learn more about local history.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的女儿选择在博物馆做志愿者，因为她想更多地了解当地历史。

senses.english: to send a letter or package using the post office
senses.exampleEnglish: I will post the signed form tomorrow, so it should reach your office before the closing date.
senses.exampleChinese: 我明天把签好的表格寄出，应该能在截止日期前送到你的办公室。

senses.english: the system of sending letters or the letters delivered
senses.exampleEnglish: The documents arrived in the post just before we left, so we had time to check the final details.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前文件刚好邮到，所以我们有时间核查最终细节。

senses.english: a job or official position
senses.exampleEnglish: She applied for a teaching post that would allow her to work closer to home and spend less time travelling.
senses.exampleChinese: 她申请了一个能在家附近工作、减少通勤时间的教师职位。

senses.english: a strong upright piece used as a support or marker
senses.exampleEnglish: The sign was fixed to a wooden post beside the path so that walkers could see it from either direction.
senses.exampleChinese: 标牌固定在路边木柱上，让行人从两个方向都能看到。

senses.english: a message or item published online
senses.exampleEnglish: The post included a map and clear directions, which helped visitors find the hall without contacting the organisers.
senses.exampleChinese: 帖子含地图和清楚指引，让访客不用联系组织者就能找到礼堂。

senses.english: to publish a message or content online
senses.exampleEnglish: We will post the updated timetable on the club's website as soon as the station confirms the new train times.
senses.exampleChinese: 车站确认新时刻后，我们会立即在俱乐部网站发布更新的时间表。

senses.english: to send someone to work in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: The company may post her abroad for a year, so she is checking how the move would affect her family.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司可能派她出国一年，所以她在考虑搬迁对家庭的影响。

senses.english: sheets of paper (or online) containing news stories
senses.exampleEnglish: The local newspaper published an article about the volunteers who had restored the old path beside the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地报纸刊登了一篇文章，介绍那些修复河边旧小路的志愿者。

senses.english: to explain the meaning of words
senses.exampleEnglish: Before we begin the discussion, we should define the key terms so that everyone understands them in the same way.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论开始前，我们应该定义关键术语，让所有人的理解保持一致。

senses.english: judgment or opinion after thinking for a while
senses.exampleEnglish: We reached the same conclusion after comparing the results, although we had used different methods to collect the information.
senses.exampleChinese: 比较结果后，我们得出了相同的结论，尽管收集信息的方法不同。

senses.english: the final part or end of something
senses.exampleEnglish: At the conclusion of the workshop, each group explained which design had worked best and what they would change.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊结束时，每组说明哪种设计最有效，以及会改哪些地方。

senses.english: a device that shows the time
senses.exampleEnglish: The clock above the entrance had stopped, so nobody noticed how late it was until the caretaker arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 入口上方的钟停了，所以直到管理员到来，才有人注意到已经这么晚了。

senses.english: every person; everyone
senses.exampleEnglish: Everybody brought something for the picnic, which meant we had far more food than we could finish.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都带了些野餐食物，结果食物远远多得吃不完。

senses.english: Saturday and Sunday
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent the weekend repairing the garden fence, taking breaks whenever the rain became too heavy to continue.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们整个周末都在修花园围栏，每当雨大到无法继续时就休息。

senses.english: to carry out an action or task
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will perform a short experiment to show how different materials react when they are heated.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们将做一个简短实验，展示不同材料受热时如何反应。

senses.english: to entertain an audience by acting, playing, or singing
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will perform in the garden if the weather is fine, with the hall available as a backup.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气好时学生将在花园表演，礼堂则作为备用场地。

senses.english: about a job such as a doctor, lawyer, accountant, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: She sought professional advice before signing the contract because some of its conditions were difficult to understand.
senses.exampleChinese: 签合同前，她寻求了专业意见，因为其中有些条款难以理解。

senses.english: showing the skill, care, and behaviour expected from trained workers
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers gave a professional welcome, making sure every visitor knew where to go before the event began.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者接待得很专业，确保活动前每位访客都知道该去哪里。

senses.english: paid to take part in an activity rather than doing it as a hobby
senses.exampleEnglish: She became a professional musician after years of playing at local events while working in another job.
senses.exampleChinese: 她一边做其他工作、一边在当地活动演奏多年后，成为职业音乐家。

senses.english: a trained worker or someone paid for a skilled activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The course invites a professional to explain which repairs beginners can attempt safely and which require specialist help.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程邀请专业人士说明初学者能安全尝试哪些维修、哪些需专人帮助。

senses.english: that thing that belongs to me
senses.exampleEnglish: The notebook beside your bag is mine, but you are welcome to use it if you need paper.
senses.exampleChinese: 你包旁边的笔记本是我的，不过需要纸时你可以用。

senses.english: a place where valuable material is taken from underground
senses.exampleEnglish: The old mine is now a museum, where visitors can learn how difficult work underground used to be.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧矿井如今成了博物馆，游客可了解地下工作过去有多艰难。

senses.english: to take minerals or valuable information from a source
senses.exampleEnglish: The display explains how people used to mine coal before machines made some parts of the work less demanding.
senses.exampleChinese: 展示解释机器减轻部分工作强度前，人们过去如何采煤。

senses.english: an explosive device placed on or below the ground or water
senses.exampleEnglish: The history guide explained that the area had been closed while experts checked for mines left from the war.
senses.exampleChinese: 历史导览员解释，专家检查战争遗留地雷时，该区域曾被关闭。

senses.english: general public discussion of a topic
senses.exampleEnglish: The debate about the new sports centre continued for weeks, with residents expressing different views about its location.
senses.exampleChinese: 关于新体育中心的辩论持续了数周，居民对选址表达了不同观点。

senses.english: to discuss different views or consider choices carefully
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee will debate the proposal after residents have explained how the change might affect their daily journeys.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民说明变化可能如何影响日常出行后，委员会将讨论提案。
